items.title: Magic: The Gathering Designer's Response to Product Fatigue Sparks Debate About the Deluge of New Cards
items.summary: There are a lot of Magic: The Gathering cards coming out these days, and there are a lot of Magic players who

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/magic-main-1791992634484.jpg

There are a lot of Magic: The Gathering cards coming out these days, and there are a lot of Magic players who think there are too many . But fans don't need to pay attention to every set — according to Magic game designer Mark Rosewater.

Last night, Rosewater posted to his Tumblr to answer a question from a fan about the product fatique players feel from having six Magic sets every year. He replied: "We did some research on this. It turns out a very small minority of Magic players feels a need to track every newly released card. Obviously, this audience tends to be very enfranchised, so they’re over represented online."
"The game already has over 33,000 unique cards," he added. "We’re well past the mark where any one player can mentally track everything."

And it doesn't seem like Wizards of the Coast plans to slow things down any time soon, even if some enfranchised players — myself included — are sometimes fatigued by the sheer amount of cards that come out every year.

In the same blog post, Rosewater added: "Limiting how many cards we release per year to how many cards this small group can comfortably mentally track just doesn’t make good business sense. Our upper limit needs to be guided by what players are purchasing and playing, not by how easy it is to track everything new." So, essentially the deluge of new Magic cards will continue as long as sales support them.

Of course, there were a lot of these 'enfranchised' Magic players who didn't love Rosewater's answer here. Over on Reddit, the post was shared to the tune of over 1,300 upvotes, and while there are definitely some who agree with Rosewater's approach, there were a lot of people who were upset by it. User GunTotingQuaker replied : "I embraced the 'every product isn’t for everyone' thing years ago. There are going to be 5,000 new cards a year, deal with it or don’t. My issue is it feels like every time I dust off a 1+ year old EDH deck to see what I might update… it’s like half the f***ing deck."

MTG player Amarsir was also upset , but this time by how the volume of cards affects the Standard format. "Does he not remember Standard?" they asked. "I mean I can understand forgetting it exists. But the whole concept is knowing each new set. Commander players don't need to know every card. But they didn't go from 8-set Standard to 18-set to affect Commander players now did they?"

However, there were plenty of folks who did agree with Rosewater, with some, like user MoO, simply saying : "Folks should take the same attitude towards Magic releases as the news: unplug for a bit when it’s too much, it’s healthier."

Others questioned how many cards anyone has to realistically pay attention to at any one time, like TunefulTunic , who asked "can standard players tell me, do you really need to know every single card that comes out in a set like a lot of people here claim?", to which Kanin_usagi replied "The lands are important to know I suppose, and then familiar with planeswalkers and the major archetypes. Otherwise most sets really only have like 25-ish cards that will see any major play. Right now I’m not even sure Final Fantasy or Ixalan have any non-lands that see play."

Either way, it doesn't seem like Magic sets are slowing down any time soon. There were seven total sets in 2026, with Reality Fracture being the most recent, and with the Star Trek crossover launching next month. 2027 will be a bit slower, with only six sets, but they should all be full sets, where both Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and The Hobbit this year were smaller sets with fewer cards.

Wizards of the Coast recently announced its first Universes Beyond set for 2027 at New York Comic Con , but unlike 2025's Spider-Man or 2026's Marvel Superheroes, Darkhold Destiny will see the Magic team creating its own Magic-flavored story with Marvel characters.

items.title: Hogwarts Legacy's DLSS 5 update shows devs have been listening to PC gamers about keeping it the hell away from game characters
items.summary: Nvidia's DLSS 5 is getting smaller in practically every way, including the performance overhead and the AI yas

content.v: The promised new DLSS 5 model is set to launch in a matter of days, alongside the new RTX Spark chip powering a bunch of new and expensive laptops . As we hoped and expected, the new model shrinks down the overall footprint and therefore the performance overhead, too. But that's not the only issue that's seemingly been fixed.

Nvidia's own stats, which we'll be able to verify soon enough, state that it has half the GPU hit the September version launched with, and offers up a reduction in 4K VRAM usage of 20% as another little statty tidbit. Nvidia says it has done this by refining the training data and reducing the model size down to around 118 million parameters; roughly 24% smaller.

Which is great, because once the feature had released—in NBA2K27 and subsequently pretty much any other game you could think of —the biggest issue we've had with it is the significant performance hit you get just from enabling the feature. Originally Nvidia told us that they expected around a 60% performance hit from turning it on in NBA2K27, and that is now going to be just 30%.

I've spent a long time playing around with DLSS 5, in mods and the official games, and I've been enjoying it. Sometimes the performance hit isn't worth the upgrade, but with that gap closing it looks like it will get there.

This is a different model, and from talking to developers at a recent Nvidia event, you would be able to see some differences were you to put them cheek-by-jowl. Yet those differences should be subtle enough that the performance improvement will still be the main thing you takeaway from the experience.

Considering it's pretty light-touch stuff in NBA2K27—especially when you're spending most of your time zoomed out, taking in just the top third of the court—30% is a far more acceptable performance drop compared to losing over half your frame rate.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hUVHXhfCwnAr8S9YCxCei6-1920-80.jpg

The other big issue we had with DLSS 5 was obviously what it was shown to do to character models in the initial reveal back in March this year. The most obvious example was the yassified Grace, who became the unwanted poster child of DLSS 5. And it's been quite telling that none of the games that were revealed back then, including Resident Evil Requiem, have released DLSS 5 updates to their games.
Until now.

Yes, finally Hogwarts Legacy is getting its DLSS 5 glow up . But it's very clear from the side-by-side shots that Nvidia is now presenting on its blog about the new update that the developers have been affected by the negative publicity the feature got on its announcement.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XBwGjx8J5bzBEzNHceY3EA-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PFpsTLZCzEjkwBs8fdvugJ-1920-80.jpg

Looking at the new images and the effect seems to be almost entirely one of environmental lighting and materials. Pull the before/after slider across the images with characters in and you'll see their features charge not one iota. Compare that with the initial Hogwarts reveal and the difference is night and day. Or DLSS on or off, if you will.
The devs have clearly pulled those sliders back a whole lot, if not masked off the character faces entirely.

Whether this will encourage more gamers to take a look at DLSS 5 I don't know, but I've encouraged even the nay-sayers to at least check out the mods to see what the feature does. Yet we know PC Gamer readers are yet to be convinced; we ran a poll about a month ago to see if readers had tried it, but 65% of readers who responded to the question of whether they had tried DLSS 5 said they were just not interested. With a further 17% waiting on further official releases such as these.

The new update is coming on November 5 if you want to see the world of Hogwarts Legacy getting some finer ambience. What doesn't yet have a date is the only other official game to get a Neural Rendering update: Where Winds Meet. The action RPG will get confirmed support "in the near future" and it's a similar situation to Hogwarts where the only real impact of DLSS 5's update is on the environment. It looks great, but clearly the devs are once more swerving serving up an AI beauty filter for its characters.
We'll get you some of our own numbers on the new DLSS 5 model very soon.

items.title: 'AI godfather' worries we're creating 'alien beings' with artificial intelligence, with pesky moral implications
items.summary: "We should care as much about all the other aspects of a being as you do about its intelligence."

content.v: Geoffrey Hinton is a computer scientist known for his foundational work in AI, specifically when it comes to neural networks (ie, approaching machine-learning a bit like our fleshy brain-learning). As such, he's been described as the 'AI godfather'. But, perhaps surprisingly, he recently described AI as "alien beings" that humans have a "moral obligation" towards.

"We’re creating alien beings—meaning we’re not the only intelligent beings around," He said in a recent interview with The Guardian , "And the reality is, we only have a couple of years to adapt to that.”
Hinton claims, "AI models understand what they’re saying. You couldn’t possibly answer all the questions without understanding the question. It’s ridiculous to say they don’t understand.”

Now, far be it for me to argue with an expert in the field, but I feel like 'understanding' is doing a lot of heavy lifting here. For just one thing, I'm not sure an 'answer' consisting of what is statistically most likely to follow a prompted question is really 'understanding.' In other words, I don't have a Nobel Prize laureate like Hinton does, but I am at least familiar with the Chinese Room thought experiment .

Hinton also says, "The reality is, we’re making beings of a different kind. And the big tech companies keep saying: we want it smarter. This is crazy. We should care as much about all the other aspects of a being as you do about its intelligence.”
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/CYgDbZBmW2NiCqdiS9b54o-1920-80.jpg

AI regulation and 'alignment' (ie, training AI to have the same goals and values as humans) have been hot button issues lately. For instance, the OpenAI-Hugging Face incident is not yet a small dot in the rearview mirror, and the president of Microsoft claims that a carton of milk is more regulated than AI .

Hinton cut his ties to Google in 2023 in order to "freely speak out about the risks of AI," and he's sceptical about the AI industry's attempts to self-regulate. He quips, "Do we think tobacco companies should have been allowed to design the warnings on the packets? So that they could print them in a six-point font, in dark grey on black?"
Even so, Hinton also expresses concerns about the path to AI regulation, saying that humans bear a moral obligation towards AI models.

"Once you start talking about, ‘We have a moral obligation towards these alien beings,’ you lose your audience. I’ve struggled with this issue," Hinton says, "We care about people. [But] we’re making these things and there’s nothing to stop us giving these things—which are more intelligent than us—less rights than us. I’m willing to be selfish and choose human beings. Of course, we should try to make them so that they’re very happy in a symbiotic relationship with us, where our concerns are weighed more heavily than their concerns."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NoN3AeWQHv49Dwf4Bwhr2V-1920-80.jpg

Hinton argues, “People have a very bad model of what people are, and that’s why they fail to understand how these AI models are very like us. Most people don’t understand what consciousness is. They don’t understand what subjective experience is, and they’re very confident that even though they don’t understand it, they’re sure AI doesn’t have it.”

While I'm not a doctor of Philosophy myself, I do know someone who is—our very own Jacob Fox. He's already shared his thoughts on the subject of 'AI consciousness' here , and I asked him for his insight again on this story.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/aKSs7ShqKVDckwdhNikK3Y-1920-80.jpg

Jacob told me he did not agree with Hinton's moral obligation argument, going on to write more broadly, "While it's good that Hinton is acknowledging subjective experience is relevant to consciousness, he hasn't given a single good reason why we should take seriously the idea that AI has it. And when we interpret personhood as to do with objective characteristics such as rationality, behaviour, and so on, rather than experience, we run the risk of ascribing moral and legal and political weight to them. Which runs the risk of giving AI companies a massive moral argument to keep the industry going, despite how it affects actual humans."
To put it another way, the industry argument for AI consciousness or AI rights is not an altruistic one—it is arguably a cynical tactic to continue business as usual.

items.title: 看起来我用过的最好的游戏鼠标的更轻碳纤维版本即将上市，但不要看价格标签
items.summary: Hopefully it's a currency/market quirk.

content.v: The Razer Viper V4 Pro is the single best mouse I've laid my sweaty fingertips on, and I've laid them on a fair few. It's sleek, light, has tons of battery life, a comfy shape, and is incredibly well-built. So you can probably understand my excitement to hear that there might be a new, lighter, carbon fiber version just around the corner.

That's according to peripheral reviewer iitzKami , who has posted on X saying that "Razer is going carbon fibre." The reviewer includes some images, too, which do look legit, though it's always difficult to be sure these days.

There'll apparently be a CF version of the DeathAdder V4 Pro , too, with an upgraded sensor and more battery life, but it's the Viper I'm interested in. The Viper V4 Pro is already plenty light at 49 g, but the carbon fibre one is said to be even lighter at 47 g. This is the opposite of what I expected, given that the carbon fibre version of the Corsair Sabre V2 Pro is heavier than the regular one . But hey, I'll take it.

Except actually, maybe I won't take it, because Kami also says the mouse is "currently listed in some markets at roughly $300 USD." This matches what Chinese tech news site Expreview relays , at least if currency conversion rates are relevant. According to the site, (login-walled) JD.com has it listed for 1,999 Chinese Yuan (RMB), which converts to $299 USD.

This price tag is especially hard to stomach given the regular Viper V4 Pro is the cheapest of the newest premium, big-brand gaming mice. It's still expensive at $160, but that's cheaper than the $180 X2 Superstrike , $200 X3 Superstrike , and $180 Rival Pro /Sensei Pro.

Razer is going carbon fibre 👀• Viper V4 Pro: 47g• DeathAdder V4 Pro: 49g, upgraded Focus Pro 50K Gen-3 sensor and longer battery life.Currently listed in some markets at roughly $300 USD. https://t.co/D5NjxePv0S October 13, 2026

It's quite nice that the absolute best gaming mouse on the market is cheaper than its other premium competition. It will not be nice if we see another version of it going for almost 2x the price and costing much more than these other expensive mice. People are still rightly reeling a bit at $200 price tags for gaming mice, so $300 will not be a pretty sight.
Hopefully it's just a different market/currency conversion issue. At any rate, none of this is confirmed, so let's just keep our eyes peeled.

items.title: 如果《新血》制作了《黄昏 2》，就不会有《铁肺》了，“而现在大卫·席曼斯基的电影赚了 5000 万美元”——所以也许不制作续集是明智之举
items.summary: You don't need to milk your cash cows.

content.v: New Blood boss Dave Oshry isn't interested in running a massive studio that follows the blockbuster strategy of milking its successful games for all they're worth. The publisher-developer combo has enjoyed a string of big wins with its boomer shooters, but Oshry's plan for building on success is to invest that money into new projects.

"I think a lot of studios would have a big hit like Ultrakill ," Oshry tells us, "and then they would maybe open a big office, or just milk the shit out of Ultrakill and do Ultrakill spinoffs, or use that money to make sequels. And I've decided to put that money into projects like Gloomwood and Fallen Aces , artsy projects like Tenebris Somnia . That’s what I've decided to do with our success because I can, because we're independent."

The goal, says Oshry, has never been to create "a big studio with an office and hundreds of employees … I don't know why anyone would want that". And thankfully he doesn't have to deal with shareholders and investors telling him to just keep milking and keep growing.

"The fact that we're one studio and that I control everything means that I can make those kinds of decisions," he says. "If we had publishers or shareholders or investors, they would be like, ‘No, you need to take that money and reinvest it into things that are going to make more money so we can get bigger returns.’ They would be like, ‘You need to be working on Ultrakill spinoff games. You need to be working on Dusk 2, Faith: Chapter Four. Why haven't you made a survival crafting game out of this yet? You need to be reinvesting in the IPs and making money, money, money.’ And we're just like, ‘What cool thing do we want to do? What's coming down the pipe?’"

This isn't to say that New Blood doesn't support its games or give players another taste of the things that they dig. Dusk and Amid Evil continue to be updated, and there have been conversations about a new episode for Dusk or even a proper sequel. A Dusk spin-off is in the works, too, called Dungeons of Dusk , though it's from a different developer, not David Szymanski.
It's all about IP, it always has been with AAA.
Dave Oshry

But this is still a far cry from the big publisher strategy of making IPs and bleeding them dry. Like Ubisoft, for example. "Look at fucking Heroes of Might and Magic," says Oshry. "Look at what's happened to that bloody series over the years. Everybody loves Heroes 3, and that was a million years ago. Ubisoft has whored that IP out all over the place for decades, and now finally you've got someone like Hooded Horse making something like Olden Era, and people are like, ‘Yeah, good, this is what we wanted’. But it's all about IP, it always has been with AAA."

Oshry offers Wolverine as another example. "It became designed by corporate, and look what happened. I don't think it was the game they originally set out to make, but it was the game they had to ship. At New Blood we’re never putting out games because it's a game we had to ship—because we had to meet a deadline or we had investors or shareholders. We're literally just trying to make the best games we can and make as many people happy as we can."

If New Blood followed the received wisdom that Sony or Ubisoft follow, it likely wouldn't be the success that it is. "If I just forced David to make Dusk 2," Oshry says, "we never would have gotten Iron Lung . Iron Lung, Markiplier, $50 million [box office] never would have happened if I made David do Dusk 2. And now David Szymanski has got a movie that made $50 million, funded by a YouTuber. That doesn't happen if I don't run New Blood the way that I do. It works. It works for us."

Looking at the state of the industry, the failure of big games like Wolverine, the so-called 'Xbox reset', the grotesque layoffs, it certainly looks like blockbuster game development, endless sequels and an obsession with IP is unsustainable.

"As we've seen with all the layoffs, developers are disposable, whether you make a hit game or not," Oshry says. "What is a hit? Your game can sell millions of copies, but it doesn't balance the balance sheet. So everybody gets laid off. Imagine working for six years on a game, it's not the game you wanted to make anyway, and then you get laid off because it's not the game that sells. And you're like, ‘Well, maybe it would have been if it was the game we wanted to make, and not the game that had to ship, like a Wolverine.’

"People are always like, ‘Oh, the industry is dying and imploding’. We're doing fine. I guess we're the lucky ones. But I think we made our own luck by making the kind of games we want to make, and knowing that they'll sell to the kind of people who like our games."

items.title: Ocarina of Time Remake Will Support All Existing Zelda Amiibo With In-Game Item Bonuses
items.summary: The new Ocarina of Time Remake overview trailer has confirmed support for all Zelda amiibo, old and new.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/ocarinaamiibo-1791989851741.jpg

Nintendo just dropped a new overview trailer for the Ocarina of Time remake, offering a fresh look at revamped environments, characters, and combat. We had the chance to play some of the game ourselves , and were surprised by just how many changes Nintendo is making to the iconic N64 release.

While Nintendo previously announced two new amiibo figures tied to the remake - Young Link and Young Zelda - the new overview trailer also confirms support for all existing Zelda amiibo. It doesn’t go into too much detail about what that support will involve, but the trailer shows Link receiving a number of helpful items, including healing hearts, Green Potions, and a Deku Stick.

Your quest through the vast kingdom of Hyrule begins when The Legend of #Zelda: #OcarinaOfTime comes exclusively to Nintendo Switch 2 on Nov 5. Pre-order now: https://t.co/FNWvsJDFej https://t.co/peIRfkTMJh

It appears players can tap existing Zelda amiibo for helpful consumables and items, but not necessarily any exclusive cosmetics or weapons. This is similar to how non-Zelda amiibo worked in Tears of the Kingdom , which allowed for daily “bonus” scans of general Amiibo once per day.
The previously announced Ocarina of Time amiibo, which are up for preorder with varying levels of stock across retailers, will net players wearable masks for Zelda and Link.

Nintendo first launched the amiibo product line with the Wii U. Each amiibo comes with a small figure as well as a card that you can scan from Nintendo consoles, netting players various unlocks and bonuses across games.
Every mainline Zelda release has been accompanied by new amiibo. Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom Amiibo offered in-game weapons and gear in addition to daily rewards.
Where to Buy Out of Stock Amiibo

Amiibo frequently sell out in the lead-up to big game releases, and Zelda is about as big as it gets. While the Switch 2 generation of amiibo continues to be in stock at most retailers, some of the older releases have pretty much disappeared from the internet.

For those who are desperate to get their hands on an older release, GameStop offers tons of pre-owned amiibo with a solid ‘Pre-Owned’ guarantee for peace of mind. You’ll also find third-party resellers at Target, Best Buy, and eBay, though it’s always worth comparing prices to a figure’s MSRP at release.

The Ocarina of Time remake is now available to preorder ahead of its release on November 5. The game itself is currently $10 off at Amazon and Walmart . Nintendo is also releasing a Zelda-themed Switch 2 console and Pro controller on October 29.

items.title: Ubisoft’s Latest Restructuring Plan Puts Trials Developer RedLynx On The Chopping Block
items.summary: Ubisoft has announced that it plans to shut down Trials developer RedLynx as part of its ongoing restructuring

content.v: Ubisoft has announced that it plans to shut down Trials developer RedLynx as part of its ongoing restructuring efforts, as well as reduce the workforce of its Skull and Bones studio, Ubisoft Singapore, by laying off 72 people. The closure of the Finland-based RedLynx is in a proposal stage, and Ubisoft says that because the studio isn't currently working on a new project, it makes more economic sense to close it down and retrench its 52 employees instead.

Under Finnish law (via Kotaku ), Ubisoft is legally required to consult and negotiate with employees before it makes major changes to the studio, which is why Ubisoft hasn't officially announced yet that it will shut down RedLynx--although it's likely only a matter of time. The studio was first formed in 2000, and it's best known for its series of challenging--but highly enjoyable--Trials games, 2.5D motorcycle platforming games that require players to master their vehicle, gravity, and overcome a series of increasingly dangerous obstacle courses. Ubisoft acquired the studio in 2011, and RedLynx's Trials HD quickly became a breakout hit on the Xbox Arcade marketplace.

Several games in the Trails franchise have been released over the years, with the last one being Trials Rising in 2019. Since then, RedLynx assisted Massive Entertainment with the Google Stadia port of The Division 2 and the Switch 2 port of Star Wars Outlaws, and it also produced the 2023 mobile game Gwen's Getaway. Last year, RedLynx lost 60 staff members during a restructuring wave at Ubisoft and it was announced that it would pivot to making mobile games.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Trials-Rising.jpg?w=636

Meanwhile, Ubisoft Singapore is projected to be losing as much as 20% of its workforce. Established in 2008, it assisted on development of several Assassin's Creed games and it was the lead developer on Skull and Bones, Ubisoft's naval warfare game set in the golden age of piracy. "At Ubisoft Singapore, 70 positions have been impacted to align the studio with upcoming production needs," Ubisoft said in a statement to GamesIndustry.Biz . "The studio remains an important part of Ubisoft’s global production organization. We deeply value the contributions of both teams and recognize the impact this may have on our colleagues. We are committed to supporting our teams throughout this process and conducting it with care and respect."

There have been several more big changes at Ubisoft recently, including the announcement that Rainbow Six Mobile will shut down in January 2027. As part of its Creative Houses restructuring, Creative House 2 has been confusingly rebranded to Massive Entertainment , while Massive Entertainment, the studio, will continue to exist within it. Ubisoft studios across Montréal, Paris, Sweden, and Toronto fall under this Creative House, which is focused on almost all of Ubisoft’s Tom Clancy-branded games.

others.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Preorders Are $10 Off at Amazon and Walmart

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/10/zelda-59-88-2-1789037892180.png

In case you missed the memo, physical copies of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time are currently discounted at the likes of Amazon and Walmart. There's a $10 discount at both major retailers in the US, bringing the game down to $59.88 instead of $69.99.

Preorders for Ocarina of Time have been live for a little over a month, and there's a jolly good reason everyone is so excited about it. It looks stunning, and we're now closer than ever to getting our hands on it.

But what's the deal with the immediate $10 discount at retailers like Amazon and Walmart? Well, it's actually fairly simple. As is Nintendo's custom for this console generation , the MSRP for the game is $59.99 for digital copies and $69.99 for physical copies.
But to encourage fans to buy physical games via their online storefronts, Amazon and Walmart have been fairly consistent at knocking prices down to match or even beat the digital price.

That's consistent for other Switch 2 exclusives such as Star Fox , Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave , and Switch Sports Resort , to name a few. But it's important to note that once the game is released, the price goes back up. So this is purely an incentive to preorder games.

So that's the deal! Plus, there's an even better reason to own The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as a physical copy as well. Nintendo also announced that the first printing of physical copies of the game would include "textured foil cover art" ... but only available while supplies last!
Plus, for what it's worth, for physical copies, the complete full game comes on the cartridge . No game key card.
Therefore, if you're down for a shiny textured foil cover for the game, which is limited edition, then your best bet is to preorder with Amazon or Walmart, and lock down your copy ASAP.

Plus, as a reminder, Amazon's preorder price guarantee means you don't have to pay for the game until it ships, and if there are any further price drops, you'll pay the lowest price possible (even if it goes back up in price before release day on November 5, 2026).

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launches for Switch 2, November 5, 2026. It'll have more than redone load screens when it arrives, with players also still coming to grips with the wild changes Nintendo made to the game's visuals .
For more of what we saw during The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, you can read about the Link & Epona Lego set and the special edition console . For everything else revealed, click here .

For more on Ocarina of Time, check out IGN's preview of the remake - alongside this brand new feature where we discuss 29 new changes that are present in the new Switch 2 version of the game, including redesigned puzzles, updated miniboss fights, deeper dialogue, and more.

If you've been after the Z elda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 as well, it might be worth checking out Amazon, as the console has been going in and out of stock all week. Add it to your wishlist, and keep an eye on it throughout the day, and you should be able to secure it before October 29.

items.title: GTA 6 Leaks Are Still Coming, Rockstar Labels The 2022 Hack “Weirdly Invasive”
items.summary: Rockstar Games has reacted to the mass GTA 6 leaks, which began in 2022, with a top developer at the studio sa

others.title: Rockstar 反驳《GTA 6》制作成本超过 15 亿美元的传言，但它仍然可能是有史以来最昂贵的视频游戏

content.v: Rockstar Games has reacted to the mass GTA 6 leaks, which began in 2022, with a top developer at the studio saying it "feels like somebody's wading through your dirty washing." Bloomberg published these comments from Rockstar developers on the same day that GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek posted yet another gameplay leak, saying it could be the last.

"It feels like somebody’s wading through your dirty washing,” Rockstar North's Aaron Garbut said. “It’s like they’re inside your head. You see your early work out there. Nobody’s ever supposed to see that. It’s really weirdly invasive. And so it’s quite hard to deal with on an emotional level.”
Rockstar and Take-Two eventually tracked down the hacker who was allegedly responsible for the leaks in 2022. This person will reportedly face court on November 9 , just days before GTA 6 releases.

The hack pushed Rockstar to implement a controversial new policy requiring developers to work from the office, as opposed to remotely. Rockstar publishing boss Jennifer Kolbe said Rockstar will take another look at this policy after GTA 6 is released, but she doesn't envision major changes.

"The idea that we would have the game in that many environments is something that I think the security team would not love,” she said. “I think if we did not have a game that people wanted to steal as much, maybe it would be an easier conversation.”

The major 2022 hack that led to a series of GTA 6 leaks was followed up by a new round of leaks this year from someone going by CyberLeek. The person, or group, was pushing a memecoin , but is apparently now shutting down . One final gameplay leak was published today, October 14, and it's a big one, so be aware of that when you're scrolling through your feed.

The Bloomberg story on GTA 6 included numerous other details, including how the game originally had a bigger scope and could have launched sooner , Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick's response to a big delay , and the absurd amount of detail in the game .

The story also confirmed that GTA 6 did not in fact cost $1.5 billion to make and that an entire studio was spun up to create NPCs . We also learned from the story that Rockstar's GTA 6 realism experiment began with beer and sandwiches and that Rockstar won't need another eight years to release its next game.
GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, though it could be delayed again.

items.title: 《塞尔达传说》新作媒体前瞻汇总：60帧的爽快体验
items.summary: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》是任天堂对游戏史经典之作《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的一次高规格现代重制，预计登陆Switch 2平台，本作…

content.v: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》是任天堂对游戏史经典之作《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的一次高规格现代重制，预计登陆Switch 2平台，本作将于2026年11月5日发售。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142243147593.jpg
近日，任天堂开放《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》媒体试玩，各家媒体交出的初体验评价整体偏向正面。这一次的重制并非3DS版那样单纯的画面升级，而是对场景、剧情对话、地牢谜题与操作机制进行大规模重构，让这款1998年N64经典适配现代玩家的游玩习惯，哪怕是从《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》入坑的新玩家，也能顺畅体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142243206611.jpg
美术层面，尽管画风公布之初争议不小，但上手后Eurogamer认可场景的表现力。Engadget称赞科奇里森林植被更加茂密，海拉鲁城堡城镇建筑细节丰富，德库盾牌木纹、盖波拉猫头鹰等小物件都做了精细处理；森林神殿新增雾气与剑击粒子特效。Engadget同时提出保留意见，林克出水时的水体质感仍显得有些生硬。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142243266095.jpg

世界内容大幅扩充。VGC提到科奇里小屋新增NPC剧情，还有角色教玩家辨认卢比歌谣；区域内卢比产出更加充足，前期获取德库盾牌门槛降低。IGN发现初始钱包容量从99提升至200卢比，新增训练假人，寻找科奇里之剑的谜题也结合跳跃机制重做。VGC、IGN共同指出，海拉鲁城堡城镇彻底取消固定机位与加载切换，玩家可自由旋转镜头探索，大量居民新增对话，不少NPC还拥有了实用功能。Eurogamer观察到海拉鲁平原地貌调整，新增农田、建筑与隐藏线索，藏有不少可供挖掘的秘密。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142243452824.jpg
操作与战斗迎来现代化改造。VGC、Engadget对独立跳跃按键与冲刺功能评价很高，告别原版翻滚赶路的旧习惯。VGC表示游戏全程60帧运行，对比N64原版20帧，战斗反馈更加灵敏，斯塔尔福斯等敌人对战手感大幅优化。锁定目标机制保留，但跳跃攻击按键逻辑改动，老玩家需要短暂适应；Eurogamer提到上手初期会对手动跳跃产生不适应。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142243531497.jpg
品质优化亮点颇多。VGC、Eurogamer称赞新增道具快捷轮盘，不用反复暂停打开菜单，水神殿频繁更换铁靴的痛点得到缓解。VGC介绍屏幕常驻小地图，同步提供Normal、Pro、Master三档HUD，大师模式可完全关闭所有界面UI，追求纯粹的沉浸体验。Engadget介绍“时间之丝”功能，为长时间未游玩的玩家提供剧情回顾与方向指引，IGN补充任务描述采用传说风格文案，不破坏故事氛围。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142244008115.png
地牢设计保留原有框架，但大量谜题、BOSS战重做。IGN在德库大树、森林神殿发现大量全新机制，新增升降平台，火炬谜题移除旋转平台，波姐妹、幻影盖侬的攻击模式与演出全部翻新。IGN还发现敌人 AI 同样调整，骷髅蜘蛛、地板大师新增视觉提示，让玩家更容易读懂攻击逻辑。Eurogamer完整体验森林神殿后表示，地牢核心氛围与经典挑战内核没有丢失，改动只是优化游玩体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142244098195.png
娜薇的交互机制也迎来优化。VGC介绍，小精灵不再无间断强行插话，战斗提示可以手动触发，日常台词改用气泡对话，保留小精灵的存在感，又不会像原版那样惹人厌烦。
Engadget提到部分关键场景加入配音，德库大树初见段落演出大幅强化，不过大量支线对话依旧保留纯文本形式；Eurogamer对英文配音演绎提出批评，但确认游戏支持切换配音语言。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142244192045.jpeg
配乐收获广泛好评。IGN介绍科奇里森林、海拉鲁平原曲目由真人乐手重新编曲；VGC称赞改编配乐带来强烈的情感冲击力。Engadget还透露一项特色玩法，游戏支持用主机麦克风吹奏时之笛音符，作为按键演奏之外的备选方案。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142244285491.jpg
综合四家外媒观点，本作没有推翻原作核心框架，主线流程、经典场景的内核完全保留，只是打磨当年那些过时、繁琐的设计。虽然美术、水体表现、配音仍有一些争议点，但任天堂成功守住原作灵魂，同时把老游戏打磨适配当下玩家的游玩习惯。

items.title: 《毁灭战士》现在可以在 DNS 数据库上“运行”，该技术的一位先驱者表示，“我无法决定这是否非常可怕，或者非常美味”
items.summary: Apparently the database is acting a bit like a "librarian" and not doing the actual compute.

content.v: In the early 2000's, the perennial question was whether a powerful system could run Crysis. These days, it's whether a minimal one can run Doom. We've seen an affirmative answer to this question when it comes to vapes , a motherboard BIOS , and even a pregnancy test . And now? A DNS database.

To be clear, we've seen Doom broken down into DNS text records before , but this time it seems like the database is doing more than file storage. This new version is courtesy of Corey Quinn over at The Register , who explains: "I have compiled Doom for a 32-bit machine whose arithmetic and memory live in DNS."

DNS, for those unaware, means ' domain name system ', and is the system that translates URLs into IP addresses that computers can actually interact with to visit. You can also create your own DNS databases with your own entries.
Quinn realised that such a database could be used essentially as a "librarian", pulling pre-made answers to relevant operations: "The database itself is 6.4 million rows of truth tables."

One of the main pioneers of DNS, Paul Vixie, said : "I can't decide whether this is deliciously horrible, or else horribly delicious. in either case, it's the best use of RFC 2136 DNS UPDATE that I've ever seen."

DNS UPDATE is what allows DNS records to be changed, which is also what's required for values and variables to change and be updated in a game world. That's the key trick here, as far as I can tell: Quinn realised there's enough similarity in the way DNS works to essentially replicate the usual conditional 'if this, then this' way that code works.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hGepsyz5Aiffh5UJCnSbjN-1920-80.jpg

"I want to be very clear here: this isn't DNS pretending to be a CPU." says Quinn. "The instruction decoding is done ahead of time by a compiler; BIND never executes an instruction itself. All that it sees is a key-value read, a conditional write, and 6.4 million rows of precomputed answers.
"It's not really a computer; it's simply a very good database. And that turns out to be enough."

Yes, that's right: 6.4 million rows. And it's hardly a snappy experience, as one update takes just over 54 seconds: "Doom says its tic rate is 35 per second, so 'playable' is a tic every 28.6 ms. I remain at 54,000 ms, which is three orders of magnitude away from victory."
So, not exactly a practical gaming experience, but certainly a fun project. If you want to try it out, Quinn has published the code on GitHub , so have at it.

items.title: ‘We Vibe Coded a New Epic Games Launcher’ – Epic’s New Store App Was Built Using AI
items.summary: Following reports of an AI push, Epic Games has revealed that the new EGS Launcher was "vibe coded" using arti

content.v: The big Epic Games Store rebuild teased earlier this year has arrived as a new "preview" client available to download for Windows and Mac, as well as Linux for the first time.

PC Gamer was shown a demonstration of the client in advance of the announcement, and the speed improvement appeared significant. Epic claims that it's halved the launcher's startup time, and that it now goes from a cold start to the store page 46% faster than Steam. (Epic says its technical improvements have been verified by an external vendor. We have yet to test the client ourselves.)
There are also updates to the interface: A redesigned library view is the standout change, and it includes the option to bring in shortcuts to games installed with Steam and other clients.
In a blog post , Epic refers to the new client as "vibe coded," a term for prompting AI tools to produce code. The term be taken as either derogatory or endearing depending on who's talking.

Epic goes for laughs, saying that it opted to use AI because "programming is hard," but the company isn't joking about its use of AI coding tools. On a call this week with Epic Games Store GM Martin Keely, who took over for the outgoing Steve Allison in August, I asked whether AI was used primarily to analyze the existing EGS code for opportunities to improve it, or to write new code. He affirmed it was the latter.

"We started from scratch," said Keely. "This is a completely new architecture for both the store and the launcher shell. So we did look at functionality that existed and said we want to replicate that, but not the code itself. So [AI] was a tool to write and review new features and new capabilities from the ground up in a different tech stack than what we had previously."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gbZhsLBmgWPy8LXsH9T7HV-1920-80.jpg

You'd be hard pressed to find any big games company that isn't mucking about with AI, but Epic is particularly bullish on the tech, and willing to confront public disapproval. On Monday, Bloomberg reported that Epic instructed the team working on an unannounced Star Wars and Marvel shooter to take an "AI first" approach to development.

"We have a huge pivot underway here at Epic, moving developers around to retool for maximum AI acceleration," Epic CEO Tim Sweeney said after that news was reported. "The aim isn't to do the same stuff with fewer people, but to enable everyone here to build MORE and BETTER stuff, and to bring the benefits to all teams using Unreal."
The use of "vibe coded" to describe this new client, which is sure to draw some eyerolls, seems to me like a clear statement from Epic that it is unbothered by AI critics.

For now, the release of the new client is not being communicated through the existing Epic Games Store software. Epic is treating it like a beta test, expecting gradual adoption through word-of-mouth while it addresses feedback.
The preview client can be downloaded at launcher.epicgames.com , and alongside the expected Windows and macOS versions, there's also a Linux build.
In conjunction with that news, Epic announced that it's working on upgrading Easy Anti-Cheat so that it can bring Fortnite to Linux and help other multiplayer games make the jump.

items.title: 育碧继续进行重大重组，Trials Studio RedLynx 看起来即将关闭
items.summary: Trials and tribulations. Publisher Ubisoft intends to shut down RedLynx, the Finnish development studio behind

others.title: 育碧从骷髅会开发部门裁掉 70 名员工，并关闭 Trials Studio RedLynx

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/skull-1791970800085.jpg
The cuts and studio shutdowns continue at Ubisoft, this time with layoffs hitting the developer of Skull and Bones and the closure of Trials maker RedLynx.

GamesIndustry.biz reported that Finnish studio RedLynx will close down, with up to 52 people losing their jobs. Meanwhile, Ubisoft Singapore, developer of pirate game Skull and Bones , will lose 70 staff. In a statement, Ubisoft insisted Ubisoft Singapore “remains an important part of Ubisoft’s global production organization.” GI said 70 staff represented around a fifth of Singapore’s total headcount, which suggests 280 staff are left.

Skull & Bones suffered a notoriously choppy development that stretched out over years. After a series of delays, it eventually launched early 2024 with a $70 price tag that Ubisoft boss Yves Guillemot justified by describing Skull & Bones as a "quadruple-A game." Year 3 Season 2, titled Crimson Waters, launched in August.

RedLynx, meanwhile, was gobbled up by Ubisoft in 2011 having enjoyed enormous success with the likes of Trials 2 , Trials HD , and Trials Evolution , games that challenged players to navigate increasingly difficult side-scrolling courses on a bike. But after the launch of Trials Rising in 2019, RedLynx became a Ubisoft support studio.

It’s a sad end for RedLynx, once one of the most high-profile Xbox Live Arcade developers in the business. I have many fond memories of playing Trials HD and Trials Evolution on lunch breaks with colleagues at my previous stomping ground, Eurogamer, where we’d laugh and shout our way to the finish line in local competitive multiplayer. Trials was Infuriating — of course it was, it’s called Trials — but so much fun.

Ubisoft is of course still cutting costs left, right, and center across the business as it reorganizes itself into a leaner operation focused on fewer games. Multiple studios have closed down in recent years, many staff have lost their jobs, and games have been canceled.

Most recently, Natalie Francis was appointed Studio MD of Massive Entertainment, with Thomas Andrén’s becoming General Manager for Ubisoft’s Creative Network. Massive Entertainment, based in Malmö, Sweden, is currently leading the development of The Division 2 and The Division 3, operates development on the Snowdrop game engine, and works on Ubisoft Connect.

items.title: TGA官方确认：一部游戏可连续两年参选！
items.summary: TGA2025评选时，评委还未能完整游玩《超英派遣中心》的全部内容。

content.v: 据Polygon报道，开发商AdHoc Studio表示，TGA主办人Geoff Keighley已确认《超英派遣中心》获得2026年TGA各大奖项的参评资格，该作由此连续第二年进入评选范围。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/14/cas_auto/small_0_4878704.jpg
AdHoc Studio向Polygon表示，这一资格由TGA所有者兼主持人Geoff Keighley确认。该作第一季全部八集已于2025年11月12日上线，早于2025年TGA的11月21日资格截止日；但TGA的提名投票通常在11月上旬进行，评委们当时未能玩完整季。
AdHoc在邮件声明中说：“去年我们被提名最佳首秀独立游戏，尽管评委只玩了一半的赛季，这相当疯狂，对我们的团队来说绝对意义重大。”当时AdHoc没有在剧集上线前向媒体提供提前版本，评委审议提名时游戏仍在推进中。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141438216411.png
报道提到，AdHoc希望TGA评审团第二次考虑《超英派遣中心》并不难理解。该作当时只拿到首秀独立游戏提名，但在跨年之后举行的颁奖礼上表现更好：游戏在DICE awards获得包括年度游戏在内的六项提名，在Game Developers Choice awards获得三项提名，并在BAFTA Games Awards拿下三座奖杯，同时获得最佳游戏提名。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141438279403.jpg
不过即便如此，有资格参选并不一定代表着有资格被提名以及获奖，《超英派遣中心》在2026年TGA评审团那里未必轻松。评审团在资格标准内一向挑剔，抢先体验游戏和扩展包在规则上符合主要奖项资格，却很少被认可；前一年年末、即当年资格截止日之后发售的游戏也面临类似处境。不过，资格确认本身已经给了它一次机会。

items.title: 《塞尔达传说》新作外媒玩爽了！疯狂示爱任天堂
items.summary: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》是任天堂对游戏史经典之作《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的一次高规格现代重制，预计登陆Switch 2平台，本作…

content.v: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》是任天堂对游戏史经典之作《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的一次高规格现代重制，预计登陆Switch 2平台，本作将于2026年11月5日发售。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142229154037.png
近日，VGC编辑在体验两小时《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》后表示，这一次，钩索再度直击内心。任天堂用这次重制，再度向所有人证明，为什么这款N64老作品能成为无数玩家心中的最佳游戏。
编辑提到，参与媒体试玩会前，不少同行的担忧并非美术风格或是操作改动，而是时隔多年再次见到德库树、听见海拉鲁平原的BGM，情绪会难以自控。对很多玩家而言，它是踏入电子游戏世界的起点，承载着长久的情怀，重制本身是一场充满风险的尝试。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142229225660.png
好在本次试玩体验打消了顾虑。本作在保留原作标志性框架的基础上，加入大量细节增补与现代化优化。科奇里森林新增NPC互动内容，让林间小屋不再空洞；游戏金币获取更加宽裕，降低前期攒钱购买德库盾牌的压力。娜薇的提示机制重做，恼人的频繁打断大幅减少，玩家可主动呼叫她获取战斗建议，提示改用气泡对话的形式呈现。
游戏新增独立冲刺按键，不用再靠翻滚赶路。海拉鲁城堡城镇场景完全重构，无加载切换，支持自由镜头旋转，NPC 也新增更多对话，其中市场大胡子 NPC 甚至拥有了实用功能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142229315986.png
性能与操作层面提升明显，游戏以 60 帧运行，战斗手感更为流畅。新增道具快捷轮盘，无需反复打开菜单，搭配常驻角落的地图，探索地牢不再需要频繁暂停查看地图。官方还提供三套 HUD 界面方案，从标准、精简到完全关闭 HUD，兼顾不同玩家的偏好。编辑也体验了成年林克的森林神殿，大量品质优化，大幅降低原版地牢探索的繁琐感。
在两小时试玩结束后，老玩家出身的编辑再次爱上海拉鲁的冒险。画面重制、配乐改编、新增细节与流畅的现代操作，让这款经典焕发新生。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142229419733.png

items.title: 《恶魔城》新作获满分狂赞！史诗回归 12年等待值了
items.summary: 《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》媒体评价正式解禁。外媒PSU发布了本作评测文章，给出满分10分的评价，标题为“《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒…

content.v: 《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》媒体评价正式解禁。外媒PSU发布了本作评测文章，给出满分10分的评价，标题为“《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》评测（PS5）——一个历史性系列的史诗性回归”。
PSU在总评中写道：“《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》在各方面都出类拔萃，是2026年必玩游戏之一。在佳作频出的一年里脱颖而出并不容易，但Evil Empire在这个游戏史上最具历史意义的系列之一中，打造出了一部名副其实的杰作。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131650309955.png
要点如下：
距离上一部正统《恶魔城》已超12年，本作由《死亡细胞》团队Evil Empire开发，科乐美发行。
剧情设定在《恶魔城3》23年后，特雷弗·贝尔蒙特与女儿罗斯回归。罗斯击败Boss后，可将其封印进“母亲的塔罗牌”，并与之对话，部分Boss借此获得更完整的背景刻画。
战斗系统现代化：除圣鞭外，罗斯可装备剑、剑盾、拳套、长枪、双剑、大剑六种武器；塔罗牌则提供魔法攻击，每张牌含挑战任务，完成后可解锁被动技能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131650572831.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131650578048.jpg
Boss战与探索出色：系列经典敌人大量回归，Boss战后期极具挑战，地图庞大，包含巴黎街道、下水道、地下墓穴及德古拉城堡等，探索有深度。
视听表现顶级：画面风格鲜明，音乐采用电子与交响乐融合，回归“血之泪”等经典曲目，被PSU称为“年度最佳原声之一”。
主要缺点： 存档与治疗检查点稀疏，快速旅行有限，部分死亡陷阱需长时间重复跑图。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131650392635.jpg
目前，本作在Metacritic上PS5版均分86分、PC版87分，OpenCritic均分87分，媒体推荐率高达97%。游戏将于10月15日正式发售，登陆PS5、Xbox Series X|S、Nintendo Switch及PC平台。

items.title: Fortnite is coming to Linux once Epic improves Easy Anti-Cheat
items.summary: A major shooter is pushing past the Linux anticheat barrier.

content.v: Epic intends to launch Fortnite on Linux, but first, it's "rebuilding Easy Anti-Cheat" to support the move.

"Once [EAC Linux v2 is] working with a critical mass of distro maintainers, we'll bring Fortnite to Linux via the Epic Games Launcher," the company announced. "We'll also make these improvements available to other developers so they can bring their games to Linux players."

More PC games than ever are playable on Linux, thanks in part to Valve's Proton emulation, which allows many Windows games to be played on SteamOS and has been essential to the Steam Deck's success. But some of the biggest multiplayer games have been holdouts, because opening the doors to Linux represents a security and cheating risk.
For example, Facepunch COO Alistair McFarlane said last year that the studio's popular survival game, Rust, is unsupported on Linux because of cheating.

"There are no plans to support Proton or Linux," McFarlane said at the time. "It's a vector for cheat developers, and one that would be poorly maintained by both us and EAC due to the low user base. When we stopped support for Linux, we saw more cheat users exploiting Linux, than actual legitimate users."
Epic's move could potentially change that calculation for Rust and other games.

One hurdle: Most of the people I know who play games on Linux do so on a Steam Deck, but according to an Epic blog post that goes into the plan's technical details, the Steam Deck does not currently support the new EAC Linux v2 solution. Epic says that it is "actively talking with Valve" about making it happen.

Regarding Fortnite specifically, game security engineering director Rick Deist told PC Gamer on a call this week that Epic is "investigating compatibility with Steam Deck and SteamOS devices." (In related news, Epic has released a new Epic Games Store client which includes a Linux version for the first time.)
"We want to let players play where they want to play as much as possible," said Deist.

items.title: 新游因过于恐怖被打差评 开发商：谢谢夸奖
items.summary: 由 Meetkow 开发的心理恐怖游戏《The Unworthy》目前正在 Steam 放出 Demo

content.v: 由 Meetkow 开发的心理恐怖游戏《The Unworthy》目前正在 Steam 放出 Demo。这款以“认真吓人”为目标的第一人称恐怖游戏，灵感来自一名男子在临死体验中踏入地狱的证词。玩家将在生与地狱的夹缝中醒来，躲避黑暗中试图将你困在诅咒世界里的某种存在，证明自己拥有生还的资格。不同威胁的应对方式各不相同：有的不能动，有的不能出声，有的反而必须正面面对。部分事件和遭遇还会随机发生。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132208098009.png
Demo 自 2026 年 8 月上线以来评价不俗，204 篇评测中 91% 给出推荐，达到“特别好评”。10 月 8 日，Demo 还推送了大型更新，包括视觉重构、新增区域和敌人 AI 改善。游戏还内置了一个“阈限模式”，移除敌人和跳脸惊吓，只保留不安的空间与音效，让玩家纯粹依靠氛围感受恐怖。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131842519747.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131842528091.png
开发团队近日在 X 上分享了一件有趣的事：有玩家给 Demo 打了低评价，理由竟然是“太恐怖了”。团队回应称，这或许是对恐怖游戏最高的赞美。

items.title: 《战神劳菲》典藏版手办丑到飞起！这能拿出来卖的？
items.summary: 《战神》典藏版手办丑到飞起！这能拿出来卖的？

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141154039991.jpg
由你来说： 游戏典藏版本来是给粉丝准备的收藏品，但如果附赠手办的造型和质感都没能让玩家满意，反而成为大家集体吐槽的对象，那这份收藏价值究竟还剩多少？近日，围绕《战神》新作典藏版手办的讨论在X平台引发热议，不少玩家批评雕像看起来廉价、设计奇怪，甚至认为其中突兀的立方体元素破坏了《战神》系列原本严肃、厚重的整体氛围。你觉得游戏典藏版最重要的是收藏意义，还是实物本身必须足够精致？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141154105687.jpg
从玩家的评论来看，争议主要集中在手办的外观设计和做工质感上。有网友直接将其形容为“路边摊般”的廉价雕像，也有人质疑究竟是谁批准了这套设计，并将其与一些被吐槽外观廉价的PS5定制手柄相提并论。还有玩家看到图片后，甚至不敢相信这真的是官方推出的典藏版商品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141154158029.png
除了雕像本身的观感，那个造型像立方体的元素也成了集中火力的对象。有玩家调侃里面是不是装了冰块，还有人表示，即使能够接受手办质量一般，也实在无法理解这个看起来过于“搞怪”的立方体设计，认为它与《战神》系列的整体风格格格不入。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141154255862.png
此外，部分玩家还借机批评游戏行业的商业策略，认为厂商似乎越来越热衷于推出各种收藏商品，却没有充分考虑玩家对品质的期待。也有人调侃，厂商只需要不断推出新产品，总会有人愿意买单。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141154261869.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141154265674.png
当然，也有评论将话题转向游戏本身，认为即使周边商品设计不尽如人意，也不能直接说明游戏质量有问题。不过，游戏本体与典藏版商品毕竟是两回事，粉丝愿意为收藏版支付额外费用，自然也会对附赠品有更高期待。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141158311435.png
如果一款游戏的本体质量过硬，但典藏版手办却做工廉价、设计还不符合系列风格，你还愿意为它购买典藏版吗？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141158345352.jpg

items.title: PS5又惨遭破解！竟能支持更多功能
items.summary: 据Twisted Voxel报道，一款名为Bypervisor Reborn、针对PS5 13.60固件的Hypervisor（虚拟机监控器）漏洞利用程序现已发布，所有尚未…

content.v: 据Twisted Voxel报道，一款名为Bypervisor Reborn、针对PS5 13.60固件的Hypervisor（虚拟机监控器）漏洞利用程序现已发布，所有尚未更新至14.00或更高版本固件的主机均在其支持范围内。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140924556866.jpg
据称，该程序能够消除此前影响已越狱主机的多项限制，这一漏洞利用了主机在退出待机模式时，Hypervisor存在的一处安全缺陷，从而允许对Hypervisor的地址空间进行读取和写入操作。该漏洞已在14.10固件中得到修复。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140925004653.jpg
目前，该程序支持13.00、13.20和13.60版本的固件，开发者也正在努力实现对更早版本的兼容，未来支持范围甚至可能追溯至6.00固件。不过，此次发布的内容还不能算是一个完整且易于普通用户使用的越狱功能增强方案，因为它尚未包含充分发挥其潜力所需的额外补丁或自制软件功能。这意味着用户仍需等待后续开发。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140925052028.jpg
预计这项漏洞利用技术带来的主要改进之一，是让运行最高13.60固件的PS5主机能够运行Linux系统。此前，PS5对Linux的支持范围更加有限，最高仅支持至7.61固件。此外，该漏洞也有望让更多可越狱的主机获得高级自制软件功能。
另一项预期改进是增强对伪装软件包（Fake Packages）的支持，这有可能让兼容的游戏备份以更少的性能和存储空间限制运行。不过，这项功能仍取决于其他尚未发布的后续开发成果。
不过，仍不建议普通用户尝试破解或越狱自己的PS5主机，不仅面临潜在的法律风险，还有“变砖”和隐私泄露甚至造成经济损失的可能。

items.title: 嘎嘎乱杀？30天四款千万大作？网友：要见证历史了
items.summary: 10月下旬开始的游戏阵容引发了玩家们的讨论，有玩家认为“接下来或许会迎来游戏圈近十年以来的最强30天？”，你怎么看？

content.v: 由你来说： 10月下旬开始的游戏阵容引发了玩家们的讨论，有玩家认为“接下来或许会迎来游戏圈近十年以来的最强30天？”，你怎么看？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141512351288.png
近日，有网友在社交平台发文大胆预测，从10月下旬起的30天内，或许会连续迎来四款千万销量级别的游戏，阵容堪称豪华。
该网友列出的四款作品分别为：大概率成为“现代最强”的《GTA6》、享有“历史最强评分”之誉的《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版、有望在ARPG史上留下浓墨重彩的《影之刃零》，以及几乎代代销量破千万的《使命召唤》新作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141514211148.jpg
该网友表示，如果这四部作品最终销量都突破千万，仅从阵容豪华程度来看，应该会超越2019年10月下旬开始的30天。
其列举的2019年同期阵容包括：《使命召唤：现代战争》（10月25日）、《路易吉鬼屋3》（10月31日）、《宝可梦 剑·盾》（11月15日）以及《星球大战 绝地：陨落的武士团》（11月15日）。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141514271876.jpg
此外，该网友认为历史上最豪华的30天应是2011年10月中旬开始的30天，当时连续发售了《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆之城》《战地3》《神秘海域3》《使命召唤：现代战争3》《上古卷轴V：天际》和《刺客信条：启示录》六款大作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141514133162.jpg
该网友最后补充称，如今3A游戏开发投入越来越大、周期越来越长，这种短时间内连续爆发大作的现象已越来越难得，因此这里只单纯讨论短期发售档口的阵容豪华程度，并不能代表游戏品质。
这番预测迅速引发网友讨论。
有网友调侃：“虽然但是，这让我想到一个梗‘我们四个嘎嘎乱杀’。”
也有人表示：“还真是，也许可以见证历史。”
不过，也有玩家从平台与受众角度分析：“然后一个PS5独占，一个NS独占，一个NS独不占，一个粉丝向年货，感觉玩家重合度不会很高。”
还有网友直言：“只有《GTA6》值得期待，其他都是小圈子自嗨。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141514379157.png
另有玩家表达了对开放世界游戏的审美疲劳：“现在的开放游戏太多了，纯罐头式、流水线产品，沉浸感越来越低，所以我现在对《GTA6》一点都不期待，连玩的欲望都没有。反而那个《影之刃零》很期待，沉浸感应该会很强。”

items.title: 卡普空今年首个令人失望之作！《生化4RE》掌机被喷
items.summary: 近日，外媒Polygon发文对《生化危机4 重制版》Switch 2版进行了评测，直言本作是卡普空今年推出的首个令人失望的作品——至少在掌机…

content.v: 近日，外媒Polygon发文对《生化危机4 重制版》Switch 2版进行了评测，直言本作是卡普空今年推出的首个令人失望的作品——至少在掌机模式下如此。
评测指出，该版本在底座模式下表现尚可，但掌机模式却存在明显的性能与画质问题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141208137180.png
Polygon编辑表示，自己最近一直在游玩《生化危机4 重制版》Switch 2版，结果发现“唯一比我的神经更紧绷的，是游戏本身”。
掌机模式下，游戏频繁出现卡顿，尤其是在一群虫族僵尸围攻里昂时，有时甚至毫无明显原因。镜头旋转时也会规律性卡顿，在初始前往村庄的道路上行走或奔跑时，卡顿尤为常见。虽然这是一款“跑或开枪”而非“边跑边开枪”的游戏，卡顿并未直接影响操作，但体验极其令人恼火。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141208199551.png
除了帧率不稳，掌机模式的画面也相当模糊。
评测指出，《生化危机4 重制版》掌机模式下大部分物体都覆盖着一层DLSS引起的毛刺，植被尤为严重，而游戏前半段恰好有大量植被。此外，Switch 2版还存在纹理加载问题：玩家走在岩石小径上，岩石会随着靠近突然变得更精细。Polygon认为，这一缺点并非Switch 2独有，在Steam Deck和ROG Ally上，本作掌机模式同样“有点丑”。
不过，上述问题在底座模式下几乎消失。评测称，《生化危机4 重制版》在底座模式下画面漂亮，即便仍有轻微毛刺，也几乎察觉不到卡顿。此外，Switch 2的HDR效果明显优于不支持该功能的掌机PC，无论底座还是掌机模式，开启HDR后光照表现都更好。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141208305536.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141208325246.png
Polygon最后表示，自己更愿意在掌机模式下玩所有现代《生化危机》作品，但本作可能不得不成为例外。这也让他对即将到来的《怪物猎人：荒野》Switch 2版感到一丝担忧。

items.title: NVIDIA推出DLSS新模式！RTX 5060性能暴增35%
items.summary: NVIDIA推出DLSS新模式！RTX 5060性能暴增35%

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141010119944.jpg
NVIDIA近日推出DLSS帧生成新模式Preset C，官方称该模式在特定条件下能够让RTX 5060的性能提升最高约35%。这项功能目前可通过NVIDIA App测试版使用，兼容RTX 40系列和RTX 50系列显卡，为玩家提供了新的性能调节选项。
根据现有信息，Preset C主要针对DLSS帧生成进行优化，目标是在生成额外画面的过程中提高运行效率。不过，性能提升并非没有代价。NVIDIA也提醒用户，更快的帧生成模式会带来轻微的图像质量妥协，因此实际效果仍需结合具体游戏、画面设置和硬件环境判断。官方所称的最高35%提升，也不意味着所有游戏都能获得相同幅度的性能增长。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141010529758.png
想要体验这一模式，玩家需要先安装NVIDIA App测试版，随后进入“Graphics（图形）→ Driver Settings（驱动程序设置）→ DLSS Override – Model Presets（DLSS覆盖——模型预设）→ Custom（自定义）→ Frame Generation（帧生成）”，最后选择Preset C即可。
对于使用RTX 5060等中端显卡的玩家来说，如果新模式能够在可接受的画质损失下换取更高帧率，或许会成为值得尝试的选项。不过，帧生成带来的额外画面并不等同于原生渲染性能提升，实际体验还应关注延迟、画面稳定性和游戏兼容性。
总体来看，Preset C为DLSS帧生成提供了新的性能取舍方案：追求更高帧率的玩家可以尝试，而更看重画面质量的用户则可以继续使用其他预设。

items.title: 彻底放飞！前LOL职业大尺度女装COS：网友看傻了
items.summary: 彻底放飞！前LOL职业大尺度女装COS：网友看傻了

content.v: 前《英雄联盟》北美赛区职业选手Sneaky近日在社交平台X发布了一组新照片，因造型尺度较大迅速引发关注，该动态发布不到一天便获得约500万次浏览，不少网友对他如今的形象感到惊讶，甚至表示，单看照片和穿搭，很难将眼前的人与当年驰骋职业赛场的选手联系起来。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141610503137.jpg
Sneaky曾是Cloud9战队的明星下路选手。2018年世界赛期间，他随队在八强赛击败韩国战队Afreeca Freecs，最终闯入四强，创造了个人职业生涯的最佳国际赛事成绩。2020年，他正式退役，之后转型成为全职主播，并逐渐将更多精力投入Cosplay创作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141612231830.png
事实上，Sneaky早在职业选手时期就开始尝试不同风格的装扮。2017年，他曾应粉丝要求穿上女仆装拍照；2018年，他开始Cosplay《英雄联盟》中的游戏角色，其中包括希维尔的“披萨外送员”皮肤、星光战士索拉卡以及K/DA阿卡丽等造型。由于妆容、服装和拍摄效果相当用心，这些作品曾引发广泛讨论。
据报道，Sneaky最初只是抱着玩笑的心态尝试Cosplay，后来在女友Esther Lynn的化妆、造型和摄影协助下，逐渐发展成长期经营的创作方向。退役后，他的作品尺度也越来越大，并开设了Fansly账号。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141612377138.png

items.title: PS多款第一方游戏突然下架！已购买玩家未受影响
items.summary: 近日，索尼PlayStation Store在多个地区突然下架了部分第一方游戏，包括《钠克大冒险2》《神秘海域：内森·德雷克合集》以及《战神3…

content.v: 近日，索尼PlayStation Store在多个地区突然下架了部分第一方游戏，包括《钠克大冒险2》《神秘海域：内森·德雷克合集》以及《战神3 重制版》。目前，在北美PS商店搜索这些游戏已无法显示，引发玩家关注。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141119532229.png
据分析，此次下架疑似与定价错误有关。有玩家发现，《战神3 重制版》在墨西哥区PS商店曾以约50美分（约合人民币3.6元）的价格出售，远低于正常售价。外界推测，索尼可能是在发现价格异常后，临时将这些游戏从商店移除，直至问题解决。
对于已购买上述游戏的玩家，目前仍可从个人游戏库中正常下载和游玩，因此实际影响有限。截至发稿，索尼尚未就此事作出官方说明。
此次事件之所以引发不安，与索尼持续推进的全数字化战略密切相关。索尼已确认，自2028年起，新发售的第一方游戏将不再生产实体光盘，全面转向数字发行。这意味着，未来玩家获取游戏的渠道将完全依赖PS商店。而此次多款游戏在无预警情况下突然下架，也让人意识到：在纯数字时代，平台方只需按下按钮，就能让游戏从商店中消失。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141120004691.jpg
尽管此次下架大概率只是技术性调整，但它无疑为玩家敲响了一记警钟。

items.title: 重磅！大佬官宣明日放《GTA6》大料：全是独家消息
items.summary: 重磅！名记官宣明日放《GTA6》大料：全是独家消息

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140947422082.jpg
据最新消息，彭博社知名游戏记者杰森·施赖尔（Jason Schreier）将于明日发布一篇关于《GTA6》开发过程的重磅报道，深入揭秘这款备受期待的开放世界大作背后的故事。此次报道预计将涵盖游戏开发的多个方面，包括项目面临的挑战、Rockstar内部工作文化的变化，以及游戏开发周期为何如此漫长。
据透露，施赖尔此前曾前往Rockstar North工作室进行采访，并获得了观看《GTA6》实机游戏内容的机会。不过，他并未获准亲自上手试玩。目前尚不清楚他看到了哪些具体内容，但此次探访也让外界对即将公布的报道更加期待。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140949394882.jpg
报道的重点之一，是Rockstar近年来加班文化的变化。工作室过去曾因高强度加班而受到关注，而《GTA6》开发周期不断延长，也让外界持续猜测其内部管理和开发进度究竟面临着怎样的挑战。施赖尔此次将尝试解释这些问题背后的原因。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610140949468146.jpg
此外，Rockstar拒绝就Cyberleek相关调查作出评论。至于玩家关心的PC版发售时间，施赖尔表示自己目前没有相关细节，也无法确认此前流传的2027年第一季度发售说法是否属实。

items.title: GTA 6 Could Have Been Even Bigger And Released Years Sooner, But Then These Things Happened
items.summary: A big new report revealed more details about Rockstar's long-awaited GTA 6 , including how the game's scope wa

content.v: A big new report revealed more details about Rockstar's long-awaited GTA 6 , including how the game's scope was originally much bigger and that the game could have released years sooner.

Bloomberg reported that when a small team from Rockstar traveled to Miami in 2015 to begin planning GTA 6, they envisioned the game spanning "big swaths of land across both North and South America." It was in development under the codename Project Americas at this time.

The report went on to say that Rockstar would pare down GTA 6's scope to include Miami and its surrounding areas instead of the original ambition. It's not a small world, though, as GTA 6's map is 3X bigger than the map in Rockstar's last game, 2018's Red Dead Redemption II. In addition to GTA 6's version of Miami with Vice City, the game takes players to a range of other locations in greater Leonida, which is a stand-in for Florida.
The confirmed major locations in GTA 6 so far include:
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Port_Gellhorn_06_83abed.jpg?w=636

The report also digs into how Rockstar originally planned to develop GTA 6 concurrently with Red Dead Redemption II, which would have helped GTA 6 come to market sooner. However, as the scope for Red Dead Redemption II grew, Rockstar's Rob Nelson came to realize he needed to assign more staff at Rockstar's network of studios to help get the Western out the door in 2018.

According to Bloomberg, this meant GTA 6 would be delayed "several years," but one silver lining was how the work that went into Red Dead Redemption II would "pay off when we get to the game [GTA 6]."

Nelson pointed out that Rockstar, at one point in time, developed multiple games concurrently across offices, but now, Rockstar's network of teams work on one project together before moving on to the next.

Also in the report, Rockstar denied the rumor that GTA 6 cost $1.5 billion to develop , but did not provide any specifics on the actual cost. The game has reportedly generated $600 million in revenue through pre-sales and that number could rise to $2 billion before the game even releases .

GTA 6 was originally set to launch in 2025 before getting delayed to May 2026 and then again to November 2026. When Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick heard about the second delay, he said to Rockstar, "Please tell me you're kidding."
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, unless it is delayed again, which Rockstar has not ruled out .

items.title: Grand Theft Auto IV – The Legacy Review
items.summary: Obsessively detailed and impressively timeless, GTA IV is the prototype for modern Grand Theft Auto.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/gta-iv-legacy-review-blogroll-1791959143088.jpg

I’m taking a look back at each of the core Grand Theft Auto games and replaying them in the lead-up to the arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6. What we’ll be putting together won’t be traditional re-reviews, and they won’t come with any new IGN score, but they will re-examine what made each GTA remarkable upon the time of its release. By the end of the project, using GTA’s previously six-star wanted level, you should be able to get an idea of where each of these games roughly rank in my long-term love for this series.
Today it’s time to revisit Liberty City in Grand Theft Auto IV.

Grand Theft Auto IV is smaller than GTA: San Andreas. Significantly so, if you exclude water, as its land area is reportedly around only one-quarter the size of San Andreas’s physical real estate. GTA IV also has markedly reduced vehicle variety, with much fewer of them overall and zero car customisation. It has no asset management, less mission variety, no RPG-inspired skill system, a pretty paltry list of cheats, and the only thing you can alter about lead character Niko Bellic is his outfit. In fact, if you weren’t around for the arrival of GTA IV, I think it’s fair enough that you may actually find yourself a little confused about its place in the series pantheon. That is, how could this apparently smaller game with overtly fewer features than its predecessor have instantly become not only the highest-rated GTA in the history of the series, but one of the highest rated games of all time, full stop? Well, the devil is in the details. Countless, unprecedented, incredible details.

For all his faults as an Eastern European war veteran with a shady past and a short temper, who may or may not have spent 106 minutes trying to kill Owen Wilson back in 2001, Niko Bellic has actually carved out a place as one of the most likeable and accessible characters in the franchise. Lured by his cousin Roman’s lies of wealth and opportunity, it’s easy to both sympathise with Niko’s disappointment at his first encounter with the American Dream, and share in his distaste for the various bastards of Liberty City who seek to exploit him.

Released in 2008, GTA IV was the first game in the series to be set in the present day since GTA III. In 2026, it’s an interesting snapshot of the world just prior to the smartphone takeover – back when the internet was still a destination you took time out to visit on a computer, social media was still a novelty rather than the worst thing to happen to humanity since disco music, and your radio would always let you know you were about to receive a mobile phone call. However, despite the 18 year gulf between its setting and today, GTA IV doesn’t feel remotely as retro as something like GTA: Vice City did in 2002 – even though there were only 16 years between its setting and the time of its release. The aesthetic distinctions between the ’80s and 2000s are, of course, profound. What are the visual differences between the 2000s and now, other than the fact The Rock used to have hair? It’s not a long list. Monoculture is dead, fashion is looping, and – as remarkably detailed as GTA IV is – I don’t think there’s anything Rockstar could have done to dodge this phenomenon, Dwayne Johnson’s shaven skull notwithstanding.
Flashing Lights

However, even though the feeling I glean from GTA IV being a depiction of a specific moment in time may not be as strong as that elicited by either GTA: Vice City or GTA: San Andreas, there is no denying what a victory it is in terms of its capacity to represent a true sense of place . GTA IV’s Liberty City wasn’t just one of the most convincing virtual cities of its generation; I honestly don’t think it’s an overstatement to say its commitment to tiny details still stands up to scrutiny today.

Revisiting GTA IV’s Liberty City in 2026 – a game that my Xbox 360 play data indicated to me I haven’t touched in around 14 years – I’m immediately reminded of how fastidiously crafted every corner of this world is. Yes, it’s a smaller environment than that of San Andreas, but it’s one that is so much more crowded, dense, and dripping with depth. It’s more immediate, more authentic, and more intimate than anything that came before it – and it’s still a more credible and convincing city than those in most of the open-world action games I’ve played since.

Strolling though Star Junction – Liberty City’s glitzy Times Square proxy – I find myself in tourist mode. I’m too engaged by the fact there’s something to see, read, or admire everywhere I point the camera to be distracted by the temptation of causing anti-social chaos. Hoofing it through Hove Beach – inspired by Brooklyn’s Brighton Beach – and I’m once again impressed at how much mileage Rockstar extracts from the seemingly mundane. Garbage strewn on the sidewalks. Individualised storefronts that are faithful to the demographics of the area and are never repeated elsewhere around the city. Places with stories you’ll never get to the bottom of. Like, who is Mikey Pissroll, and how much better at pool is he than Anal Alan?

The architecture, the lighting, the lived-in grime; Liberty City here feels more than real. It feels aged . Rockstar didn’t just build streets; it built them, and then assaulted that asphalt with decades of simulated wear. As a result, those streets are a patchwork of potholes, road plates, and sporadic strips of more recently re-surfaced segments. The custom signwork, the bespoke graffiti – the fact that no piece of the city looks like any other. A multitude of elements combine to create what was an unprecedented sense of immersion at the time, and absolutely still holds up today. Sure, there’s an unavoidable murkiness to playing GTA IV on original hardware like the Xbox 360, where you’re obviously beholden to the resolution limitations of its age. It results in a soft and rather muted image, and one that’s admittedly exacerbated by the overly cool and slightly washed out colour palette Rockstar opted for. However, it’s still a stunning place to simply explore, whether walking, driving, or using public transport – which is a viable and realistic way to move around this tightly-packed urban metropolis.
One Vision

While Rockstar was committed to rebuilding its famous riff on New York City as realistically as possible within the fidelity it could muster at the time, it also placed an enormous emphasis on physical realism. The beating heart of this approach was NaturalMotion’s procedural character-animation technology, Euphoria – an animation and physics solution that completely transformed how people moved, reacted to impacts, and interacted with their surroundings. It wasn’t just a trivial technical flourish; it fundamentally altered the way the game felt to play, whether you were cutting enemies down with a barrage of bullets, or mercilessly bouncing them off the bonnet of an automobile. It reinvented GTA.

Traditional animation relies heavily on pre-authored movements, with developers creating and canning specific sequences that characters will perform in particular circumstances. That is, fill them with lead and they’ll sink to the ground the same way every time. Strike them with a car and they’ll fly up and flop down identically, regardless of the forces at work. Euphoria does away with all of this and, in 2008, it felt like a stunning glimpse of the future. Ditching those pre-determined animations, characters in GTA IV react realistically – both based on the forces impacting them, and the world within arm’s reach of them. A spray of gunfire may stagger an enemy into a railing behind, which they can tumble over dramatically. A well-placed shot may cause someone to lose their balance and fall off a ledge. Clipping someone in a car will skittle them in a totally different way to clobbering them head-on. One too many drinks may make putting one foot in front of the other temporarily tricky.

content.v: 有多少细节才算多?为了让《GTA6》中的虚构城市莱奥尼达尽可能真实，开发商R星投入了惊人的心力，连玩家可以光顾的夜总会也不例外。这些场所不能凭空设计，因此R星多次前往迈阿密考察，为夜总会的设计寻找依据，连细微之处也不放过。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791985028_231356_jpg_r.jpg
在接受彭博社采访时，美术师Aaron Garbut透露，开发人员曾跟随警员巡逻，走访时髦的夜总会，并与那里的舞者交流。这些考察让Rockstar团队积累了丰富的素材，用来打造真实可信的聚会场所：每位顾客都有不同的动画和脚本，酒吧里摆满了各式各样的饮品，工作室甚至制作了一套能随音乐同步变化的灯光系统。用Garbut的话说，这些细节是“一层又一层又一层”。
《GTA6》远不是第一款让玩家走进夜总会的游戏，但这类场所往往遵循固定模式，通常只是让人印象不深的场景布置。《007：初露锋芒》展示了夜总会如何为游戏和关卡设计服务，其开发商IO Interactive由此提高了标准;《杀手3》中柏林的狂欢派对仓库，也是将人群、DJ和精心布置的灯光融为一体的好例子。
但《GTA6》能否把这一具体领域的设计标准再往上推?目前看来，R星似乎已竭尽全力，要让这款游戏在观感和体验上比它以往的任何作品都更有沉浸感，甚至专门设立了一间只负责制作非玩家角色的工作室。夜总会究竟做得如何，还得看游戏中的实际表现。如果你打算入手这款游戏，或许值得在一家规定每人至少点两杯饮品的店里待上几分钟，感受一下氛围。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/egs-launcher-blogroll-1791980526662.jpg
Epic has released a new version of the Epic Games Launcher, with a preview version of the company’s refreshed Steam competitor available to download now.

This new Epic Games Launcher, which was built using AI and “vibe coding”, is currently in the early stages of development and so is “light on features” according to a new blog post from Epic . The preview version features the core components you’d expect from a launcher, including store, library, and social panels, as well as the Unreal-focused developer page.

“It's been rebuilt entirely from the ground up,” explained Martin Keely, vice president and general manager of Epic Games Store, in an interview with IGN. “So this is a completely new tech stack, a complete new rewrite of both the shell, which has the download manager, library, and the app itself, as well as the new store architecture. So features like discover and product detail pages, those have all been rewritten.”

In terms of improvements, for this first phase of the rebuild the big focus has been on speed. Epic says that the launcher boots from cold in 5.47 seconds, which it claims is 46% faster than Steam. When re-opening the app from the system tray, it takes just .36 seconds – 14% faster than Steam. These times will surely vary depending on your system specs, but in ideal conditions it does appear the new app is much speedier than its sluggish predecessor.

“The library loads 30 times faster [than in the previous launcher],” said Keely. “The startup is twice as fast. And it's a small footprint, only 300mb. That was another thing that we wanted to continue to make as small as possible to support the wide range of hardware that players have.”

For this new version of the launcher, Epic is supporting Windows, MacOS, and, for the first time, Linux. That also means that Fortnite is coming to Linux, although it’s not available quite yet – Epic first needs to rebuild its Easy Anti-Cheat system for the platform . “Once it’s working with a critical mass of distro maintainers, we’ll bring Fortnite to Linux via the Epic Games Launcher,” explained Epic’s blog post.

Beyond the speed and platform upgrades, the new launcher features some much-needed quality of life improvements, such as better customisation – the new top bar can be adjusted to display the tabs in order of preference, and the library can be filtered using a variety of categories.

In terms of what future updates will offer, Keely revealed that “the other piece that we're going to be working on is how to improve game discovery in a way that is relevant to each player. We have a pretty large library and sometimes there's great games that will be relevant for someone, so making sure that we continue to improve the merchandising components of how we make game discovery more possible and make that more social so that people can recommend games to each other and make that easy to share.”

Epic had previously detailed its plans for a new launcher earlier this year, where it said that its efforts would result in five times faster boot times . Of course, while speed is an issue, it may well take more than that to convince players – some remain convinced that the Epic Games Store will never be as good as Steam.

items.title: Arc Raiders 的 PvE 测试终于来了，这是重新加入的完美理由
items.summary: This is exactly what Arc Raiders needs right now.

content.v: God, life is stressful. There's too much to do and too few hours in the day to do it. So when I get a couple of hours of free time in the evening I have to be pretty mindful of what I do, and let me tell you getting domed in Arc Raiders by some rando hiding in a bush is not at the top of my list.

It's a shame, because I love the world of Arc Raiders. I love its mystery, its grandiose landscapes, and its bizarre communal storytelling that you just can't get in most games. But there's finally a solution: the PvE test.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BksdJY7HdmdgDz36nV9DZZ-1920-80.jpg

Embark teased the test a few weeks ago, finally admitting that due to a large portion of its audience favouring a more passive approach to the game, it would test out a temporary PvE toggle . While Frozen Trail released a few days ago, the PvE test has only gone live now, and it's a hell of a lot of fun.

Dropping into Pendola Pass has never been so chill, well, it's more chill than usual; as soon as I came out of my bunker I was met with hellfire raining down on me and the pinging of bullets as they shot past my face while a couple of players attempted to take down the newer arc, a Bully. 'Ok' I thought to myself, 'I guess I'll start here'.

The Bully isn't anywhere near as lethal as a Queen but it's tankier than I expected it to be for its size as it ate my Wolfpack grenade like it was nothing. I hadn't come equipped for a fight like this but thanks to the growing group of curious raiders we managed to take it down before long. It may sound boring to someone who loves the adrenaline dump of PvP, but for someone who just wants to explore the map, take down arcs, and perhaps help out their fellow raider along the way this experience right here is golden.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hKGSn57vKPRJPUmMYkWNQZ-1920-80.jpg

Instead of shuffling around bushes and hiding in the shadows I feel relatively free to wander about the surface and actually take in the surrounding views. You still have to be careful of arcs, but not having your blood run cold when you hear footsteps closing in to your location is such a welcome change.

In fact, it's quite the opposite now, hearing raiders close by reassures me that if things were to go wrong, someone would help—which is especially nice when arcs in the PvE mode will finish you off if they catch you moving while downed. After taking out a number of arcs on my way to the Observatory my hubris was bolstered, so when I saw the new Skulker, a seemingly small and insignificant enemy, I thought that it would be easy pickings. I was wrong.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Fd4TUWBBCNNNPuCwFugtUZ-1920-80.jpg

Maybe I was just unlucky, but this Skulker had a couple of other friends with it, and it took way more ammo than I thought to take it down. I was pinned behind a couple of crates, quickly going through all my reserves and trying to come up with an exit strategy when I heard gunfire. I have no idea where it came from, perhaps it was an angel from above, but a stranger saw I was in need of assistance, helped take the Skulkers out, and then moved on.

They were gone before I could say thank you, so I decided to pay it forward instead. On my way to the extract I saw a bunch of arcs swarming an outbuilding, I didn't have much ammo left but I still wanted to help, so help I did. I started taking pot shots at some of the Wasps to distract them away from the shed and before long another raider popped their head out and together we took them out. Nothing was said, but after a thankful wave we went our separate ways and I extracted back to Speranza.

As I said before, I love Arc Raiders for its world, action, and crafting, but it also just feels really nice to help without the worry that the person you've just saved may shoot you in the back of the head and ruin any faith in humanity you had left. The PvE test is a welcome change of pace, and I'll be playing it almost exclusively while I still have the chance.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TCou4LpWxSUzfBu3QPeR6P-1920-80.jpg

items.title: R星终于解释《GTA6》延期真相 最近几个月还在改
items.summary: 在一场最新采访中，Rockstar开发部门负责人谈到了《GTA6》的开发过程，并表示这款游戏的内容从来没有真正完全定稿。

content.v: 在一场最新采访中，Rockstar开发部门负责人谈到了《GTA6》的开发过程，并表示这款游戏的内容从来没有真正完全定稿。
《GTA6》距离正式发售已经只剩一个多月，在发售前夕，Rockstar陆续向玩家透露了这款大型游戏的开发幕后，也谈到了开发过程中遇到的延期问题。官方表示，这些延期并非出于什么戏剧性的重大原因。
在最近接受彭博社采访时，Rockstar开发部门负责人Phil Hooker表示，《GTA6》的开发内容始终没有真正完全定稿。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142134562535.png
他说，游戏的延期从来不是因为重大、戏剧性的问题，而是因为一些内容没能在预期时间内按计划整合到一起。Hooker还指出，团队并没有严格遵循一份固定的开发蓝图，甚至在“过去几个月里”仍在调整内容。
Hooker还分享了一段自己游玩游戏测试版本的经历。当时，他原本准备前往指定地点完成一个剧情任务，途中却发生了一连串意料之外的事情。首先，他开车撞上了另一辆车，并和平解决了这场意外。随后，他又走进一家便利店，购买能够恢复生命值的物品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142135045806.jpg
之后，Hooker遇到了一名出言辱骂他的NPC，并与对方发生了暴力冲突。他还趁商店柜台无人看守时抢劫了一家商店。随后，警察开始追捕他。Hooker通过弃车并换乘另一辆车，成功摆脱了警方的追捕。意识到这辆新车可能卖出不错的价钱后，他又打算将其出售。
然而，在前往卖车地点的途中，一辆播放着大音量音乐的汽车突然撞上了他。Hooker随即追了上去，结果意外发现了一处堆放着大量可转卖赃物的场所。Hooker表示，在这次长达两小时的游戏体验中，他甚至还没能接近完成原本计划进行的剧情任务。
这段经历也展现了《GTA6》开放世界的丰富程度：玩家原本可能只是想推进主线，却很容易被沿途发生的各种事件吸引，最终把大量时间花在计划之外的事情上。

items.title: 《塞尔达传说》新作前瞻：年度最佳 教科书级别重制！
items.summary: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》是任天堂对游戏史经典之作《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的一次高规格现代重制，预计登陆Switch 2平台，本作…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142134209164.jpg
《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》是任天堂对游戏史经典之作《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的一次高规格现代重制，预计登陆Switch 2平台，本作将于2026年11月5日发售。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142134274699.png
近日，Nintenderos拿到《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》媒体试玩机会，在体验过后，编辑直言本作已经具备冲击年度游戏的实力。这款Switch2独占作品，也是《塞尔达传说》系列诞生40周年的重磅献礼。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142134355540.png
本作美术风格偏向写实又保留奇幻魅力，外媒形容观感很像木偶戏。林克服饰刺绣、海拉鲁城场景细节大幅升级，城镇支持自由镜头探索，空间观感相比原版更加开阔。游戏加入全语种完整配音，娜薇、塞尔达、加侬多夫等角色都拥有语音演出，看齐《旷野之息》《王国之泪》标准。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142134512565.jpg
大量人性化改动落地：新增独立主动跳跃，林克可以直接奔跑，不再只能靠翻滚移动。时之笛曲目支持主机麦克风哼唱演奏，玩家甚至能用真实陶笛来吹奏。地牢核心机制完整保留，高度尊重原版框架，在此基础上吸收3DS重制版的优点打磨体验。
在Nintenderos看来，本作是教科书级别的经典重制案例。在保留原作记忆与故事内核的前提下，用现代化画质、配音与便利性优化拓宽受众，既能打动老玩家，也能迎接即将通过《塞尔达传说》电影入坑的新世代玩家。
