items.summary: 近几个月，“大葱哥”CyberLeek因发布一系列据称与《GTA6》有关的图片和视频而受到关注。近日，这名颇具争议的爆料者发表了一份分为三部分的声明，宣布暂时停止爆料。他在声明中称，自己掌握了《GTA6》的完整结局，但为

content.v: 近几个月，“大葱哥”CyberLeek因发布一系列据称与《GTA6》有关的图片和视频而受到关注。近日，这名颇具争议的爆料者发表了一份分为三部分的声明，宣布暂时停止爆料。
他在声明中称，自己掌握了《GTA6》的完整结局，但为了保留悬念、不破坏玩家的体验，决定不予披露。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791984573_463604_jpg_r.jpg
这份题为《旅程的终点》的声明主要谈及三个话题：围绕其加密货币的争议、他此前声称可能发布容量超200GB的游戏版本一事，以及《GTA6》的剧情剧透。
在第一部分，CyberLeek回应了对其项目相关加密货币的批评。他解释说，CL代币只出售过两次，目的都是支付交易手续费;他声称，这一点从一开始就已说明。在他看来，首次出售代币引发了其他持有者的恐慌性抛售，批评者因此错误地将价格暴跌和市场崩盘主要归咎于他。
他强调，所有交易都可以在区块链上公开追踪，并声称自己拥有、出售或交付给用户的一切都符合先前的承诺CyberLeek还表示，CL代币从推出第一天起就只是捐款工具，并非投资品，因此他从未向购买者承诺或保证投资回报。
声明的第二部分谈到《GTA6》的剧情。CyberLeek再次声称自己掌握游戏的完整结局，也曾考虑将其公开。据他说，这可能会对Take-Two Interactive造成致命打击，但也会永久破坏数百万玩家的游戏体验，而这些玩家与他和该公司之间的纠纷毫无关系。
他最终决定不披露结局，并写道：“Take-Two对CL不会有丝毫仁慈。那我们为什么要对他们仁慈?尽管如此，我认为Take-Two到目前为止受到的惩罚已经足够了。因此，游戏结局不会公布。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791984563_150314_jpg_r.jpg
CyberLeek接着声称，他最近泄露的画面实际上包含游戏后期一些关键任务的片段，但他有意剪辑这些片段，并脱离剧情背景发布，以免泄露关键情节。
他还表示，自己启用了一种名为“Dead Man’s Switch”的安全机制。按照他的说法，这套自动系统只包含重大剧情剧透，只有在有人或某个机构试图除掉、逮捕或阻止他时才会启动。目前没有独立来源证实这套系统确实存在，也没有证实其中包含他所声称的内容。
在声明的第三部分，CyberLeek再次谈到《GTA6》完整游戏版本。他此前曾发出最后通牒，称如果与其项目相关的加密货币市值达到3000万美元，就会在互联网上发布一个容量超过200GB、可以完整游玩的《GTA6》版本。
如今，他宣布，由于这一目标没有实现，他不会发布任何游戏版本。他认为，匿名上传超过200GB的机密数据有极高的安全风险;只有获得所需的3000万美元，用于资助另一个秘密项目，他才愿意承担这些风险。
CyberLeek表示，这项约定的条件从一开始就很明确。既然目标群体未能满足3000万美元这一条件，他也决定遵守事先定下的规则，放弃发布游戏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

others.title: 《幕府将军2》新版翻车！Steam差评如潮:一无是处

content.v: 经典策略游戏《全面战争：幕府将军2》的重制版遭到玩家的强烈批评。除了被指由AI生成的画面外，大量的Bug和优化问题也引发了玩家的猛烈抨击。在Steam平台上，1855条评论中仅有18%为好评。这对开发商来说无疑是一场灾难。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791984127_562633_jpg_r.jpg

《全面战争：幕府将军2》是一款绝对的经典之作，自2011年发售以来便俘获了无数策略游戏爱好者的心。10月13日，Creative Assembly、MATABOO和世嘉联合发布了《全面战争：幕府将军2》的完全版，这款游戏是对这款近15年前的策略游戏的现代化升级。除了所有扩展内容外，新版本还更新了纹理、支持64位处理器、改进了操作方式，并新增了超过50个可玩派系。听起来不错?粉丝们可能也这么认为——直到他们真正体验了这款重制版。
在Reddit上，《幕府将军2》重制版遭到了猛烈抨击。一张对比图显示，画面重制后，武士的脸看起来更像机器人而非人类。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791984126_403033.jpg
据报道，新版插图中还出现了六指的葡萄牙士兵。许多Reddit用户怀疑开发商使用了AI技术来提升画面分辨率，却几乎没有检查结果。
用户u/mr-english写道：他们肯定用了两年前某个非常糟糕的AI模型，因为我把原图导入现在免费版的Chatgpt，结果就变成了这样：
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791984126_484884.jpg
然而，糟糕的画面似乎只是冰山一角。在Steam评论中，玩家反映游戏存在大量bug、单位操控迟缓以及优化低下等问题。
据报道，《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版即使在高配置硬件上也难以流畅运行。例如，一位用户反映，即使使用RTX 5090显卡，在4K分辨率下也只能达到30到40帧。此外，从Steam创意工坊迁移到Mod.io也引发了批评，因为许多旧版MOD现在需要额外设置才能正常运行。
令人沮丧的是，售价40美元的完整版竟然取代了Steam上的原版游戏。原版游戏或许才是目前大多数玩家的更佳选择，它仍然包含在完整版中，但现在获取价格却高得多。

items.title: GTA 6 被推迟的部分原因是 NPC 的数量“令人恐怖”，需要一个充满编剧的专门工作室来处理
items.summary: "We [could have] hit that schedule, but it won’t be the game we want to make."

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 , originally slated to be released back in May, was delayed to November —the reason given at the time was "to finish the game with the level of polish you have come to expect and deserve". And while that still very much holds true, the reality of the game's scope and stature was apparently kinda terrifying from a production standpoint.

Speaking with Bloomberg , co-head of development Rob Nelson commented on one reason for the delay—the amount of NPCs that were required to populate Leonida: "The projections they were giving us were horrifying." The solution? A kind of NPC emergency room, an entire studio set up in LA solely designed to handle the workload.

Another development co-head, Phil Hooker, comments: "I think when it became apparent that some areas weren’t going to make it, that’s when we decided to make the shift of date. We could hit that schedule, but it won’t be the game we want to make."

Being perfectly candid, for a moment: This fills me both with a sense of dread and relief. The former is acquired from the same residual existential fear I felt back in May of last year. Namely, the fact that videogames probably aren't meant to look this pretty or be this sprawling—that the industry simply cannot support them, and that GTA 6 is going to be the last of its kind.

The relief comes from the fact that, in an industry culture seemingly determined to figure out how to push creatives out of their seats as quickly as possible with AI ? That a bunch of actual writers and producers were brought in to handle the load. There's this perception that background details in video games can be automated because, well, they're background details—they're not important, surely?

But in my humble opinion, those are, in fact, the details you want to get right. The background chatter and worldbuilding of a game is important because it'll lend said game its texture, even if you're just parodying Florida.

GTA 6 will be a better game because, when its developers panicked, Rockstar (which doesn't have the brightest industry track record , let's be clear) didn't cheap out on the massive writing load it'd accidentally saddled itself with, and that's commendable in a vacuum.

Now, is it healthy or normal that an industry giant can be so large it can pop-up an entire studio in LA full of writers just to handle a temporary task? Probably not, and it's certainly not something that's gonna last, particularly not at the industry's current price-point .

others.title: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛 3D Remake》比你想象的更不一样 | IGN前瞻

content.v: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》是任天堂对游戏史经典之作《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的一次高规格现代重制，预计登陆Switch 2平台，本作将于2026年11月5日发售。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142121378116.png
今日，IGN放出《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》的媒体试玩前瞻，这款Switch2独占作品并非简单的1:1复刻，大量谜题、对话与场景逻辑经过重制，以戏剧舞台式的全新美学诠释海拉鲁的传奇故事。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142121463310.png
试玩内容仅包含前期剧情与成年林克阶段的森林神殿，不涉及后半段重大剧透。游戏全程稳定60帧，科奇里森林光影、植被、服饰细节大幅细化，配乐重新编排。NPC对话得到扩充，给角色增添更多细节，让海拉鲁世界更有血肉。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142122047886.png
关卡设计上，老谜题的底层逻辑被重新打磨。原版科奇里剑所在的迷宫，原本用来教学相机操作的滚石机关被修改，新增主动跳跃机制；森林神殿中不合逻辑的浮空陷阱也被替换成更符合世界观的酸池，敌人生成方式同步改动，保留战斗节奏的同时，让场景设定更自洽。操作手感向现代作品靠拢，支持独立跳跃、冲刺，弹弓可使用陀螺仪体感瞄准。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142121561040.png
本次重制的核心设计理念被IGN概括为“舞台剧”：海拉鲁就是舞台，村镇与地牢是布景，敌人与NPC是演员，林克便是主角。锁定敌人时会有舞台聚光效果，宝箱、地板之手登场都有戏剧化光影烘托；制作组甚至保留区域间加载画面，将其理解为舞台更换布景。制作团队没有强行放大海拉鲁平原，而是用叙事手法，让狭小的场景在故事层面显得宏大。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142122158883.png

items.title: 代号美洲计划 《GTA6》原本的构想比现在大太多了
items.summary: 彭博社记者Jason Schreier的一篇新报道罕见地揭秘了《GTA6》的开发幕后。R星最初为这款即将推出的开放世界大作制定了更为宏大的计划，但最终不得不缩减规模。该报道还刊登了来自R星北方位于爱丁堡工作室的独家照片。

content.v: 彭博社记者Jason Schreier的一篇新报道罕见地揭秘了《GTA6》的开发幕后。R星最初为这款即将推出的 开放世界 大作制定了更为宏大的计划，但最终不得不缩减规模。该报道还刊登了来自R星北方位于爱丁堡工作室的独家照片。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791983398_450762.jpg
彭博社记者杰森·施赖尔 (Jason Schreier)探访了位于苏格兰爱丁堡的R星北方工作室。除了游戏开发方面的新发现，文章还刊登了一些工作室内部的珍贵照片，这些照片已经在Reddit上引发热议。在深入探讨施赖尔报道中的重磅爆料之前，我们先来欣赏一下这些照片。
粉丝们欣喜若狂，终于得以一窥《GTA6》幕后工作室的运作。
“这就像参观五角大楼内部一样，”Reddit 用户u/WeaponizedAcoustic写道——考虑到R星极少向公众开放工作室，这个比喻可谓恰如其分。这些照片也引发了人们的猜测。其中一张照片展示了关于冲浪和伊比沙岛的书籍，一些粉丝已经将其解读为《GTA6》中可能出现的内容的暗示。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791983412_282078_jpg_r.jpg
“美洲计划”：《GTA6》最初的计划规模要大得多
多亏了粉丝制作的地图重建图，我们已经对《GTA6》的世界规模有了大致的了解。它似乎比《给他爱5》的地图要大，但比Rockstar最初的设想要小得多。
据Schreier透露，工作室最初设想的是一个横跨北美和南美大部分地区的庞大开放世界。这个内部代号为“美洲计划”（Project Americas）的雄心勃勃的概念最终被放弃，取而代之的是一个更加聚焦于罪恶 都市 及其周边地区的设定。报道并没有明确解释Rockstar放弃最初设想的原因。然而，考虑到工作室当时面临的技术挑战，或许是因为项目规模过于庞大，最终难以实现。
开发过程中遇到的困难、加班以及对未来更快发布的期盼
彭博社的报道本质上是对《GTA6》开发过程的幕后揭秘，揭示了这款游戏制作过程并非一帆风顺——游戏的多次延期已经充分证明了这一点。
据施赖尔透露，Rockstar经历了一段严重的内部动荡时期。其中一个特别棘手的问题是，工作室应该在《GTA6》中将真实性发挥到什么程度，据说开发人员在游戏的创作方向上存在分歧。
组织上的困难和技术上的挑战加剧了开发压力，尤其是在构建游戏复杂系统和为游戏世界添加NPC方面。有时，Rockstar的产能根本无法应对如此庞大的工作量，迫使公司在洛杉矶设立了一个新的部门。疫情又带来了新的障碍。这些挑战或许可以解释Rockstar最终缩减“美洲计划”（Project Americas）规模的原因，尽管Schreier的报告并未直接证实二者之间的联系。
不过，未来也有一些令人鼓舞的消息。为《GTA6》开发的技术或许能帮助Rockstar大幅加快下一代游戏的开发速度。开发人员希望他们的下一个项目无需再耗费八年时间。这种乐观情绪能否转化为更短的开发周期，还有待观察。

items.title: Hideo Kojima Reviews 2026’s Most Divisive Movie, Digger
items.summary: After publishing his review of Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie , Hideo Kojima-who says his body is 70% made

content.v: After publishing his review of Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie , Hideo Kojima-who says his body is 70% made of movies--has posted his review of one of the most divisive mainstream films of the year. Yes, we're talking about Alejandro Iñárritu's satirical black comedy Digger, which stars Tom Cruise.
Kojima said Digger is a "film that all of us living in today's world should see."
He added: "It is a work that remains with the audience, provoking reflection and sounding alarms."
Kojima doesn't get into detailed specifics in his Digger review, and that's likely because, if you've seen the movie or know the plot, you wouldn't want to spoil the film for other people, either.

In any event, Kojima said Digger and its message will stay with you for years to come. "As you absorb this film and carry it with you, a 'tool (a digger)' for delving deeper into the future will surely begin to take shape within you," he said.
Kojima and Iñárritu' sat down with Gizmodo to discuss Digger and more--you can read the conversation here , but note that it's in Japanese.

Digger reviews are all over the place , and the film bombed at the box office, bringing in just $37 million globally thus far. The studio behind it, Warner Bros., leaned into the divisiveness, altering the movie's marketing campaign after reviews came out to encourage people to see it and decide for themselves.

As for Kojima, he’s keeping very busy with the upcoming games OD and Phsyint , both of which are in the works for Xbox. Physint will also be adapted for film and TV , while Kojima’s Death Stranding is coming to the big screen as well.

items.title: 29 New Changes in the Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake — Redesigned Puzzles, Updated Miniboss Fights, and Deeper Dialogue
items.summary: I played more than an hour of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2, and as someone who’s finished

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/thelegendofzelda-ocarinaoftimeremake-changes-blogroll-1791981958266.jpg

I played more than an hour of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on Switch 2 , and as someone who’s finished the original several times, I noticed a lot of small changes that shine some light on the thought process behind recreating this adventure.

It seems everything was on the table when considering what to tweak: altered puzzles more closely fit the modern controls, redesigned miniboss fights spice things up across each round, and new shortcuts and context clues make navigation more intuitive. If you’re dying to learn every detail you can about Ocarina of Time before its November 5 release date , I’m going to list a bunch of notable differences I saw when comparing it to the N64 original. Before we start, a couple of notes:

First, this article is not my official preview – you can check out my more formal first impression of Ocarina of Time here , and watch this week’s Nintendo Voice Chat where I dive even further into it.

Second, this is far from an exhaustive list of differences. I’m mostly leaving out the really obvious things like controls, art style, and voice acting (you can read up on things like that in the prequel to this piece ), and this would take far too long to write if I catalogued every difference there is. I’m only bringing up a change I already pointed out if I was able to officially confirm it through gameplay or learned something new worth sharing.
Third, we’re restricted on how many screenshots we’re allowed to publish for this preview period, so for this piece, you’ll have to rely on the written word alone. We’re going old school!

Finally, and most importantly, there will be spoilers for the original Ocarina of Time as we dive into the changes I saw in Kokiri Forest, Inside the Great Deku Tree, Hyrule Field, Castle Town, and the Forest Temple. It’s kind of hard to discuss changes without explaining the source material! If you don’t know the original, don’t want to be reminded of it, or don’t want to see how some things play out differently, this is not for you! Okay, that’s more than enough preamble – let’s get started.
Kokiri Forest
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/switch2-zeldaoot-medaibroll-scrn-06-1791929999895.png
1. Link’s wallet can hold 200 rupees from the very beginning, as opposed to the N64’s starting limit of 99.
2. Jumping across the stone platforms next to the Kokiri Forest shop no longer rewards you with a secret five rupees. Instead, additional blue rupees are scattered throughout the forest.
3. Speaking of the shop, there’s a new scarecrow training dummy to the right of the counter. A villager uses it to run you through a quick tutorial on raising your defenses.

4. The challenge to obtain the Kokiri Sword has been overhauled. The treasure chest used to be tucked in the back corner of the room; now it’s placed high on a platform in the middle. You have to jump to it instead of practicing reorienting the camera to reach it. I dive into more of the philosophy behind this change in my preview .
Inside the Great Deku Tree (Child Link Dungeon)
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/switch2-zeldaoot-medaibroll-scrn-11-1791929999897.png

5. In the room where you get the slingshot, a second, smaller treasure chest used to hold a random recovery heart. It was always kind of a disappointing reveal, in my opinion. Now, it holds a few Deku Nuts. I think that’s a slight improvement!

6. You fight a lot of Skulltulas in the Great Deku Tree, and their attack patterns have changed. Rather than just deciding to occasionally reveal their weak spot to you, whacking them with your sword sends them spinning around, exposing their soft underbelly. This fits in line with Ocarina of Time’s newfound focus on logic: an enemy doesn’t give you an unearned opening anymore -- you have to trigger it.
Hyrule Field
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/switch2-zeldaoot-medaibroll-scrn-13-1791929999898.png

7. On N64, Lon Lon Ranch kind of looked like an impenetrable fortress from the outside, with high walls you couldn’t really see over. Now, it’s more naturally woven into the environment, and you can spy the horses grazing from outside.

8. Peahat enemies decorated the corners of Hyrule Field in the original, but on my way to Castle Town, I ran into a few that were more centrally located. A Hyrule Field populated with more enemies is a good thing in my book.

9. Near the new Peahats, I saw a cracked piece of the ground that looked perfect for a bomb. Most entrances to hidden rooms in the original were completely invisible to the naked eye – this is a much clearer hint towards a secret area. I can’t wait to see what those sparse caves look like now.

10. In my last “Biggest Changes” piece for Ocarina of Time, I noticed a new sign right outside of the Castle Town gate. I was wondering if it would provide new lore surrounding the history of Hyrule, the events of Skyward Sword, or something like that. But, it’s just a large sign pointing you in the direction of Hyrule Field’s biggest landmarks. Not really what I was hoping for, but a noteworthy change nonetheless.
Castle Town
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/switch2-zeldaoot-medaibroll-scrn-16-1791929999898.png

11. The biggest difference in Castle Town is its perspective shift. It’s no longer restricted to fixed camera angles; it’s in third-person with complete camera control the whole time. You can even seamlessly walk all the way from the town’s entrance to the Temple of Time with no loading screens or camera breaks.

12. Upon entering Castle Town, I spoke to a new NPC: a blonde woman who warns Link not to spend all his money, even though there are so many exciting options at the market. This is just the first visit to the town, so I’m hopeful she’ll have some sort of additional quest or dialogue later on.
Forest Temple (Adult Link Dungeon)
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/switch2-zeldaoot-medaibroll-scrn-20-1791929999900.png
Last spoiler warning here – some of the puzzle changes in the Forest Temple are fairly significant!

13. There are a ton of minor changes to how the Forest Temple looks and functions, and it starts right at the entrance. Instead of hookshotting onto a tree branch, Link aims at a more traditional hookshot target above the temple’s front door. Pairing this with a similar example, where in the Great Deku Tree Link shoots an eyeball target instead of a ladder, it seems the remake is more intent on teaching us how to use these items on recognizable, intended targets rather than parts of the world players might not think to interact with.

14. After completing a puzzle that involves pushing blocks and climbing ladders to get to the top of a room, you can now activate a brand new elevator that makes it so you don’t have to walk through all the same tunnels and climb the same ladders on repeat visits.

15. Floormasters – the iconic disembodied hand enemies that stalk Link from the ceiling – are now telegraphed by a bright spotlight that shines on Link and changes color just before the hand swoops down. It’s very cool, and fits this remake’s theatrical vibe I dive into in my preview .

16. This one is also from my preview: “An arena where Link fights a Stalfos used to have a giant hole in the middle. Link needed to avoid it or risk falling to the floor below, but the Stalfos could defy gravity and hover over the gap… Here, that hole has been exchanged for a shallow pool of acid. The skeleton enemies can still walk in it – they don’t have any flesh to lose – while Link takes damage if he enters it. This means the fight plays out the same as it used to: the Stalfos has access to the whole room while Link is constrained to its edges, but the way it’s constructed is more logical.”
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/switch2-zeldaoot-medaibroll-scrn-04-1791929999894.png

items.summary: Cyberleek has released a new GTA 6 gameplay video showing snippets of the ending, and declared "the end of the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/ultimate-edition-01-1791982031487.jpg

The GTA 6 leaker has allegedly released a new unauthorized gameplay video which reportedly shows parts of the ending of the story, sparking significant spoiler concern among fans online. IGN will not report on the details of the leaked video.

Meanwhile, Cyberleek — the person or group responsible for the high-profile GTA 6 leaks that began in the summer — has suggested they will now stop leaking the game. They also claim they will not risk releasing an alleged 200GB build of GTA 6 because their memecoin failed to hit the $30 million market cap target that had been set for its release.

However, Cyberleek claims to have a "dead man's switch" for story spoilers, which they have reportedly threatened to flip if they are threatened, presumably by either Rockstar Games or parent company Take-Two.

Yesterday, we reported on how GTA 6 fans were celebrating the crash of the Cyberleek memecoin after the leaker had tied various types of gameplay leaks to its market cap, ranging from $5 million to $25 million. The leaker also threatened to release a build of the game — supposedly over 200GB in size — if the memecoin hit a $30 million market cap.

Earlier this week, a number of gameplay clips were reportedly leaked after market cap goals were hit, including gameplay that allegedly shows Lucia fully naked, and, more recently, the alleged leak of a “Lucia closeup 4k” video.

Cyberleek then threatened to release a new unauthorized GTA 6 gameplay video every day, assuming the memecoin market cap targets were met, and launched yet another gameplay poll designed to encourage spending on the memecoin.

However, the Cyberleek memecoin crashed, with a current market cap of $1.2 million, down from a high of $7.8 million on October 11. With those targets now pretty much impossible, it sounds like Cyberleek's crypto scheme has come to an end.

In a new message reportedly posted to their website, Cyberleek declared "the end of the road." In the post, Cyberleek defended their actions from crypto scam allegations, and said Take-Two was "punished enough." "The ending stays unpublished," Cyberleek allegedly insisted in the message. They claimed that while the latest leak does show clips from the final missions of the game, out of context they do not spoil the story.
It's fair to say many fans have taken issue with that suggestion, and are already taking steps to avoid spoilers online.

Cyberleek's message also suggests that the build of GTA 6 they allegedly have access to will not be released because the $30 million market cap was not reached. Cyberleek had said they were raising funds for some mystery project, although many didn't believe the claim. "Uploading 200+ GB anonymously is a serious risk," they said, "worth it only if the milestone funded the secret project." They said the memecoin should have been considered a "donation," not an "investment," and hit out at "influencers" who claimed otherwise.
Then, the upshot: "The leeks stop here. For now."

Of course, Cyberleek may release further gameplay and continue with their crypto scheme anyway. They may even release the build they allegedly have. For now though, the more pressing concern is avoiding spoilers sparked by today's leaked video.

Fans had spent the last week calling on people not to spend money on Cyberleek, pointing out the leaker cashed out back in August and is likely to do so again ahead of GTA 6’s official release date, if they haven’t already. Analysis of cryptocurrency transactions in late August pointed to the GTA 6 leaker cashing out having earnt around $270,000.

Earlier this week, IGN reported on fan skepticism around the alleged leaked gameplay that reportedly showed both Jason and Lucia fully naked . A previous leaked gameplay video allegedly showed a tank spawning into the world, which suggests access to a dev menu of some kind. The leaked videos allegedly showing both Jason and Lucia fully naked also show NPCs failing to react to nudity in any way, which suggests this effect was achieved with either a dev menu or cheats and won’t be possible in the official release.

One theory is that Cyberleak was able to access this state for both Lucia and Jason because in at least one mission players will see both characters naked, perhaps in a nudist resort. As it stands, this is all speculation, and it is unknown if GTA 6 will feature either character naked at any point — officially at least.

Cyberleek appeared to go dark after a spate of high-profile GTA 6 leaks in August that sparked an investigation from Take-Two. The company issued subpoenas to the likes of Discord as part of the hunt for the person or group of people responsible. But Cyberleek reemerged last week with the release of a 24-minute GTA 6 gameplay video that reportedly showed cutscenes, story beats, playable characters Jason and Lucia naked (in the case of Jason, full-frontal nudity), and a first-person camera.

It remains unclear how the gameplay footage, or any potential build of the game it's taken from, escaped the confines of Rockstar's infamous tight security. Recent developments suggest Cyberleek remains at large and defiant in the face of potential legal action.

In August, Rockstar addressed the GTA 6 leaks , describing the situation as "heartbreaking" for its development team and "unfortunate" for fans. At the time, the developer acknowledged that its intended experience for players "may now be impacted by some spoilers," but reiterated GTA 6's previously-confirmed launch date of November 19.

Whether the culprit or culprits are ever caught may rest on how successful Take-Two's legal team and the relevant authorities are at forcing social networks or crypto exchanges to divulge any personal details they hold on those responsible.

items.title: Take-Two CEO’s Response To Second GTA 6 Delay: “Please Tell Me You’re Kidding”
items.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is finally coming out on November 19, but the game was originally set to release in 2025. Whe

content.v: Rockstar's GTA 6 is finally coming out on November 19, but the game was originally set to release in 2025. When the development team informed head of publishing, Jennifer Kolbe, that a delay to May 2026 was necessary, she made a call to Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick to let him know. Months later, she had to make that call again, informing Zelnick that a second delay to November 2026 was required to deliver Rockstar's full ambition for GTA 6.
His response? “I think he said, ‘You’re kidding. Please tell me you’re kidding,’” Kolbe told Bloomberg . “But once we talked through why, he got it."
Kolbe said she felt fortunate that Zelnick is "as reasonable as he is," because other executives might not budge and inform the team they need to find a way.
"We have been really, really lucky that we have not found ourselves in that place, because that happens to a lot of teams, and we’ve all played those games. It’s not great," she said.

For his part, Zelnick said said that for the most part, delaying a game is actually a "wise investment in time and financial resources" if the delay results in "the level of perfection it has the ability to reach."

GTA 6 is releasing on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, but another delay is not out of the question. Development head Phil Hooker said GTA 6 is "never completely settled," nor does Rockstar have an "exact blueprint."
"Even within the last few months, we’ve changed things," he said.

That being said, no one is expecting GTA 6 to be delayed any further. Take-Two will release its next earnings report on November 10, and the company is expected to reiterate the November 19 release date during that event.
GTA 6's physical copies, which include a code in the box and not a disc, will be available to buy at retailers on November 12, though the game does not unlock until a week later.

content.v: B社的游戏常有一种奇怪的情况：刚推出时骂声很大，后来却总有人玩得很久。玩到大约200小时，会有人说“后面会变得更好”。玩到1000小时，这话就不只是玩笑了：玩家已经把四十多天花在了同一个游戏世界里。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791981718_150495_jpg_r.jpg
一位PS5玩家就在《 星空 》中玩满了1000小时。《星空》于2023年9月登陆了PC和Xbox Series，直到2026年4月才登陆PS5。也就是说，这名PS5玩家大约在半年内玩出了这1000小时，平均每天超过五小时。
他还开玩笑写了一段“奥斯卡获奖感言”，感谢Bethesda Game Studios、一直没有放弃这款游戏的粉丝，以及把模组移植到PS5的作者。由于索尼给MOD设了15 GB的容量上限，因此被他特意排除在感谢名单之外。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791982501_697690.jpg
他能玩这么久，靠的是“新游戏+”。穿过“合一”后，船长会进入平行宇宙。玩家可以在每次进入新宇宙前更换MOD，用不同的方式体验这一轮游戏。像The Veil、Farseer这样的 剧情 模组，甚至可以留到第四轮再装。

不过，《星空》的新玩家常会遇到同一个问题。在《辐射》和《上古卷轴》里，从一个有东西可探索的地点走到另一个地点，路上也会发生不少事。《星空》里，这段过程更多是在飞船内、星图菜单和加载画面之间切换，所以有人玩了10到15小时就觉得腻了。有老玩家不同意这种看法。他们说，在《上古卷轴5》里，玩家也始终是在同一颗星球上到处跑;在他们看来，探索星球比采雪浆果做药水有趣，在飞船编辑器里也很容易不知不觉花掉很长时间。如果还是觉得 太空 旅行乏味，他们建议安装能让起飞和降落无缝衔接的模组，或者试试Starsim Beyond Space。
但在PS5上玩MOD也有麻烦。除了15 GB的容量上限，引擎还能容纳多少世界中的物体，也会限制MOD的使用。崩溃甚至频繁到有人在最初20小时里数出了约70次。使用性能模式、少留一些存档、再穿过一次“合一”，以及实在没办法时清理缓存并重新安装，都可能有所帮助。
还有一件事让玩家不太舒服：模组作者已经加入了一些B社没来得及做进游戏的功能，比如从尸体上取下护甲、无缝起飞，以及让任务给的经验值随等级提高。一位玩家直言：
“接触MOD越多，就越能看出这款游戏原本可以有多少内容，也越能看出如果没有模组作者，游戏里会少多少东西。”
《星空》的银河系很大，留给MOD模组的15 GB空间却不大。

others.title: 育碧将关闭《特技摩托》系列背后的工作室 RedLynx

content.v: 据VGC了解，育碧计划关闭RedLynx工作室，并缩减育碧新加坡工作室的规模。育碧一直在评估旗下各工作室，考量它们现有的项目，以及未来能否持续运营。
据悉，在评估位于芬兰的RedLynx工作室后，育碧认为，由于该工作室目前没有开发新项目，而且仅靠调整规模也无法维持其可持续运营，因此将提议关闭该工作室，影响约52名员工。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791981591_750572_jpg_r.jpg
这项提议将进入变更协商程序。在芬兰，雇用至少50名员工的公司如果作出影响员工职位的决定，就必须启动雇主与员工之间的讨论。
至于育碧新加坡工作室，育碧在考虑其未来的职责及其将在后续工作中承担的任务后，计划对该工作室进行重组和裁员，以使其今后能够更可持续地运营。这将导致70人失业。
RedLynx于2000年在芬兰赫尔辛基成立，最为人熟知的是《特技摩托（Trials）》系列。该系列最初登陆网页浏览器，后来推出了PC和主机版本。工作室凭借Xbox Live Arcade游戏《Trials HD》取得突破性成功，育碧随后于2011年收购了该工作室。
此后，该系列又推出了五款游戏：《特技摩托：进化》《特技摩托：前线》《特技摩托：聚变》《特技摩托：血龙》和《特技摩托：崛起》。不过，自《崛起》于2019年发售以来，工作室推出的作品有所减少。
2020年，RedLynx与Massive Entertainment合作，将《全境封锁2》带上谷歌云游戏平台Stadia。之后，它开发了手机游戏《Gwen’s Getaway》。该游戏于2023年限量上线，但在2024年12月关闭。该工作室还协助Massive Entertainment 开发了《星球大战：亡命之徒》的Switch 2移植版。
此前，育碧宣布，作为一项重组提议的一部分，将在RedLynx裁减最多60名员工。根据该提议，工作室的重心将从多平台游戏开发转向“专注于小屏幕”，即手机游戏，其中包括当时据称由该工作室主导开发的两款尚未公布的手机游戏。
育碧新加坡工作室由育碧于2008年创立，目的是在东南亚建立游戏制作网络。
该工作室参与支持了迄今发布的大多数《刺客信条》游戏的开发，并主导开发了《刺客信条4：黑旗重制版》和《碧海黑帆》。

items.title: GTA 6’s Nightclubs Have An Absurd Amount Of Detail, Right Down To The Lighting
items.summary: How much detail is too much detail? In the case of Grand Theft Auto 6 , developer Rockstar Games put an obscen

content.v: How much detail is too much detail? In the case of Grand Theft Auto 6 , developer Rockstar Games put an obscene amount of work into making the fictional city of Leonida as realistic as possible, including the nightclubs that players can frequent in the game. Those locations couldn't be pulled from thin air, and Rockstar embarked on several research trips to Miami to help inform the design of their party hubs, right down to the smallest detail.

Speaking to Bloomberg , artist Aaron Garbut revealed that the developers embarked on ridealongs with police officers, visited trendy nightclubs, and mingled with dancers at these establishments. The result of these excursions was that the Rockstar team could draw on a wealth of knowledge to create authentic hangout spots, with these locations featuring distinct animations and scripts for each patron, a bar full of unique drinks, and the studio even crafted lighting systems that work in sync with the music being played. "Layers and layers and layers of detail," as Garbut put it.

GTA 6 is hardly the first game to feature a nightclub as a destination, but these locations typically follow a fixed formula, and they serve as set dressing that seldom stands out. Hitman developer IO Interactive did raise the bar for just how good a nightclub location can be when it's designed in service of a game and a level, as seen in 007 First Light earlier this year--and Hitman 3's Berlin rave warehouse is also a pretty great example of mixing crowds, DJs, and elaborate lighting setups together.

But could GTA 6 raise the bar for this extremely specific segment of game design? So far, it looks like Rockstar has gone all in to make the game feel and look more immersive than anything else it has done before, even going so far as to create a studio focused exclusively on building non-playable characters. The proof will be in the nightclub pudding, so if you're planning on grabbing the game, it might be worth spending a few minutes in a two-drink-minimum establishment to soak up the atmosphere.

items.title: 天猫自营买到假PS5精英手柄 1300多竟是山寨坏货
items.summary: 近日，有贴吧网友发帖称，自己在天猫自营店购买了一款全新的PS5精英手柄，收到货后却发现产品疑似为山寨货，不仅存在明显的使用痕迹…

content.v: 近日，有贴吧网友发帖称，自己在天猫自营店购买了一款全新的PS5精英手柄，收到货后却发现产品疑似为山寨货，不仅存在明显的使用痕迹，还无法正常使用，引发玩家讨论。
该网友表示，自己原本认为自营店购物比较正规、可靠，没想到竟遇到了这种情况。由于开箱视频只录到了取出收纳盒的环节，他没有继续拍摄，结果打开一看便傻了眼。
从其分享的图片来看，手柄存在多处异常。其中，触控板区域的设计与正常产品存在明显差异，中央黑色触控板位置还有一块可以翻开的结构。此外，手柄表面也能看到明显的发黑、脏污等痕迹，疑似曾被使用过。该网友还称，收到的手柄不仅疑似为山寨产品，而且已经损坏，包装配件也不齐全。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142023478916.png
来自贴吧网友@净重：500克
据其晒出的订单截图显示，这款手柄由优品严选重庆自营店提供，实际付款金额为1362元。该网友还表示，自己联系商家后，对方不承认相关问题，并拒绝退货。目前，他已经申请平台介入处理。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142024166124.png
帖子引发讨论后，有网友吐槽：“天猫真是越来越离谱了。”也有玩家猜测，这可能是此前有顾客恶意退货，将损坏的山寨手柄退回，导致后续买家不幸收到问题商品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142024174031.png

items.title: 灵感源自游泳冠军臂展 山东超长钙奶饼干走红卖断货
items.summary: 山东老字号青食推出限定款1米超长钙奶饼干，在青岛大鲍岛门店首发，凭借趣味创意与怀旧情怀迅速出圈，国庆期间热度高涨，门店一度出…

content.v: 近日，山东老字号青食推出限定款1米超长钙奶饼干，在青岛大鲍岛门店首发，凭借趣味创意与怀旧情怀迅速出圈，国庆期间热度高涨，门店一度出现断货情况。
这款超长饼干的设计灵感，源自青岛游泳运动员张展硕的臂展，品牌还玩起“左手一盒、右手一盒，复刻冠军臂展”的趣味梗，吸引不少游客、市民专程前往打卡选购。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142018306002.jpg
有市民特意从崂山区跨区到大鲍岛门店购买，不少网友表示，此前超长蛋挞、超长糖葫芦等网红美食并未打动自己，但面对这款承载童年记忆的钙奶饼干，愿意买单。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142018313914.jpg
钙奶饼干是几代山东人的经典零食，民间一直流传着吃钙奶饼干有助长高的趣味说法，“从没牙吃到没牙”更是本地人的共同回忆。蘸热牛奶食用，软糯香甜，是流传多年的经典吃法。网友也自发分成不同吃法流派：热水派偏爱速泡，追求外软里脆的口感；热牛奶派习惯将饼干充分泡软，用勺子挖着吃；干嚼派则认为直接啃食最过瘾。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142018318410.jpg
继60厘米超长蛋挞、超长糖葫芦之后，网红美食迎来“超长”风潮。这款1米钙奶饼干，是传统本土零食结合新潮网红玩法的一次尝试。门店相关负责人介绍，超长款更多偏向趣味营销，适合打卡拍照，热度背后，真正打动消费者的，还是饼干本身浓郁奶香与童年情怀。
业内观点认为，此次超长钙奶饼干爆火，也折射出一种消费趋势：消费者不再一味追捧浮夸营销，开始重新发掘经过时间检验的老牌好物，消费目光逐步回归产品本身，老字号想要长久留住食客，守住口味与品质才是根本。

items.title: 《GTA6》泄密者葱哥宣布隐退！不放结局了 停止泄密
items.summary: 《GTA6》泄密者Cyberleek（玩家俗称葱哥）在个人网站发布题为《穷途末路》的三段式最终公告，宣布泄露活动到此告一段落。

content.v: 今日，《GTA6》泄密者Cyberleek（玩家俗称葱哥）在个人网站发布题为《穷途末路》的三段式最终公告，宣布泄露活动到此告一段落。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142022368296.png
公告中，Cyberleek解释了此前相关代币抛售风波，强调代币定位仅为捐赠而非投资品，链上交易记录完全公开，指责不少油管博主在不查阅链上信息的前提下，散播自己卷款跑路的谣言。
他证实自己掌握《GTA6》结局相关素材，曾考虑将其放出重创Take-Two，但考虑到会毁掉无辜普通玩家的游戏体验，最终决定不公开结局内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142022439320.png
同时他提到，死亡开关已经激活，仅绑定剧情剧透内容：在无人干预的情况下不会触发，只有当他本人被清除时，开关才会启动。
3000万目标金额没能达成，因此不会放出游戏完整工程文件。匿名上传200GB以上的文件风险极高，该计划就此搁置。Cyberleek表示，相关约定条款均已履行完毕，泄露就此暂停。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610142022522115.jpg

items.title: R星否认《GTA6》开发成本达15亿美元 但不肯透漏具体数字
items.summary: 众所周知，开发电子游戏比以往任何时候都更烧钱。在这个由热门大作驱动的行业里，有传闻称《GTA6》是史上制作成本最高的游戏。外界给出过各种估算，甚至有报道称，其开发费用高达15亿美元，大致相当于迪拜地标哈利法塔的建造预算。

others.title: Rockstar 表示《GTA 6》的制作成本并未达到 15 亿美元，但不会透露真实数字

content.v: 众所周知，开发电子游戏比以往任何时候都更烧钱。在这个由热门大作驱动的行业里，有传闻称《GTA6》是史上制作成本最高的游戏。外界给出过各种估算，甚至有报道称，其开发费用高达15亿美元，大致相当于迪拜地标哈利法塔的建造预算。
在接受彭博社采访时，Rockstar否认了15亿美元的说法，但尚未证实为了让游戏赶上11月发售，究竟投入了多少钱。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791980456_309522_jpg_r.jpg
这款游戏已开发多年，参与制作的工作室和员工众多，其中还包括一个位于洛杉矶、专门负责NPC的部门，因此最终成本很可能相当高。不过，预计《GTA6》会迅速收回成本，并开始为R星及其母公司Take-Two Interactive带来可观利润。
据报道，这款游戏的预购量已超过500万份，对应收入超过5亿美元;预计到发售当天，预购量将增至2500万份，对应收入达到20亿美元。需要注意的是，预购并不等于最终确定的销售额。Take-Two负责人施特劳斯·泽尔尼克也曾就此发表评论，因此这些数字仍可能变化。
即使尚未售出游戏本体，Rockstar似乎也已从周边商品中获得可观收入：售价400美元的《GTA6》收藏版在几周前开放预购后颇受欢迎，尽管它只是一个装有《GTA6》周边商品的盒子。
Rockstar Games尚未谈及《GTA6》的在线多人游戏部分，但有传闻称它将在2027年推出。
《给他爱5》的《GTA Online》模式每年带来数亿美元收入，因此预计《GTA6》的在线模式也会成为Rockstar和Take-Two的重要收入来源。但《GTA6》能把玩家从《GTA Online》吸引过来吗?曾在Valve任职的切特·法利谢克最近表示，这可能并不容易，因为许多《GTA Online》玩家已在游戏中投入大量心血，可能不愿放弃自己经营多年的社交空间。
无论Rockstar作出什么选择，都不可能让所有人满意。它必须找到一种折中办法，尽可能让更多玩家接受。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《GTA6》建立的引擎、工具和团队有助于加快后续游戏开发
items.summary: 尽管《GTA6》距离《给他爱5》问世已过去整整13年，Rockstar表示，未来的《GTA7》或其他项目不应再让玩家等这么久，因为公司已经具备了加快开发所需的条件。 Rockstar技术总监菲尔·胡克在接受彭博社采访时解

content.v: 尽管《GTA6》距离《给他爱5》问世已过去整整13年，Rockstar表示，未来的《GTA7》或其他项目不应再让玩家等这么久，因为公司已经具备了加快开发所需的条件。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791979694_280918_jpg_r.jpg
Rockstar技术总监菲尔·胡克在接受彭博社采访时解释说，团队在开发《GTA6》期间打下的基础，将帮助他们更高效地推进未来的项目，例如《GTA7》。毕竟，正如胡克所说，他们现在有了成熟的团队、引擎和可用的工具。
“我们在这个项目中打造的引擎、工具和团队，将让我们能够更快地推进工作，我相信，我们可以在此基础上继续发展，更多地向外拓展，而不是一味向上堆叠，从而制作出更有吸引力的内容。”
美术师亚伦·加布特也赞同这一看法：“我们在这个项目中从根本上改变了许多东西。既然这些工作已经完成，我们就不会再推倒重来。”说实话，他们又何必这么做呢?
目前还不清楚Rockstar所说的“更快”会体现在哪些项目上：是《GTA7》，还是像《罪恶 都市 》这样规模较小的衍生作品?
《罪恶都市》是在《GTA3》推出后不到一年内制作出来的。无论如何，这都是个好消息。等待两部《GTA》作品之间的漫长岁月，至少可以说相当煎熬，其间还伴随着大规模裁员和延期。听说我们或许不必再经历一次这样的等待，多少令人欣慰。
希望这一切都能成真。希望《GTA7》——或者Rockstar打算在《GTA6》之后推出的任何作品——能在不到十年、甚至五年内问世……不过，考虑到新一部《GTA》看起来规模如此庞大，我或许还是高兴得太早了。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《沙丘：觉醒》开发商创意总监：在游戏行业，唯一的不变就是变化
items.summary: 在热门电影IP衍生游戏《沙丘：觉醒》制作期间，挪威工作室Funcom的开发人员有机会与好莱坞大腕打交道，然而，双方只能通过项目管理软件Jira“隔空”交流。 游戏开发者与好莱坞打交道这件事，逐渐变得并不鲜见 ■ 彼此信任

content.v: 在热门电影IP衍生游戏《沙丘：觉醒》制作期间，挪威工作室Funcom的开发人员有机会与好莱坞大腕打交道，然而，双方只能通过项目管理软件Jira“隔空”交流。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-14/8926acf54240b17c.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 彼此信任
据Funcom首席创意官乔尔·比洛斯（Joel Bylos）介绍，《沙丘：觉醒》团队经常需要将设计稿提交给传奇影业审批。“我们通过Jira提交内容，传奇影业会在一定时间内完成审批。如果他们迟迟没有审批，我们就会跟进催促。通常情况下，整个流程相当自动化，运行起来非常顺畅。”

这种合作模式似乎有些平淡乏味，却恰恰表明双方建立了坚实的互信关系。比洛斯指出，Funcom已经赢得传奇影业的信任，对方相信《沙丘：觉醒》团队会妥善利用其宝贵IP。“一旦IP方相信游戏公司会尊重和用心对待IP，那么具体的审批流程就不是那么重要了。”因此，传奇影业在与Funcom合作时采用了极其简化的IP监修流程：《沙丘：觉醒》团队只需要管理Jira工单，而不会像许多同行那样，动辄接到愤怒的电影公司高管打来的电话。
对于《沙丘：觉醒》团队提出的各种请求，传奇影业自行决定是否将它们向上汇报，比如汇报给“沙丘”系列小说作者弗兰克·赫伯特的遗产管理公司，或者电影导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦。据比洛斯透露，维伦纽瓦曾经表示，他担心游戏名称“可能与《星球大战：原力觉醒》过于相似”。尽管如此，Funcom仍然坚持将《沙丘：觉醒》用作游戏名。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-14/1856acf54241287e.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
近年来，如今电影公司纷纷加大了对IP授权改编游戏的重视程度，与游戏公司之间的合作关系比过去任何时候都更加紧密。更有趣的是，未来游戏公司的运作模式可能会变得越来越像电影公司。按照游戏外包服务提供商Code Wizards首席执行官斯图尔特·马克利（Stuart Muckely）的说法，随着项目融资模式在游戏行业变得日益普遍，“游戏公司很可能会开始效仿电影公司的做法，为每款游戏设立单独的法律实体。”
比洛斯也能理解这种以项目为中心的商业运作模式。“在好莱坞模式下，不同项目的财务风险由各自的控股公司承担，对吧？这样一来，你就可以围绕单个项目进行融资，而不必让整家公司孤注一掷。例如，人们可以选择投资《沙丘：觉醒》这个项目，却未必直接投资Funcom公司。”
但至少在现阶段，前述情况还只存在于假想中。比洛斯强调，如果游戏公司想要转向基于项目的灵活组织方式，那么行业本身也需要做出相应的改变。“我认为，好莱坞模式之所以行得通，很大程度上是因为影视行业拥有既成熟又强大的演员工会。”他说，“如果一个行业没有强大的工会，从业者就很容易遭到剥削。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-14/3066acf5424206e9.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 与时俱进
比洛斯已经为Funcom工作了近20年。本世纪初，比洛斯迎娶了一位挪威籍女子，并从澳大利亚移居挪威。“我发现很难找到一份使用英语的工作，所以不得不学习挪威语。”比洛斯回忆，“在挪威生活的头3年里，我在一家租车行当洗车工……我在给人洗车时经常想：‘难道我这辈子都干这一行吗？我不甘心，毕竟，我可是在澳大利亚拥有大学学位的人。’”
2007年，比洛斯的人生迎来了转机，加入Funcom担任《柯南时代：西伯来人的冒险》的任务设计师。后来，比洛斯被Funcom任命为《流放者柯南》创意总监，并于2019年出任公司新设立的首席创意官。过去几个月间，他的工作重心是将《沙丘：觉醒》带到主机平台，同时在游戏中推出重大更新内容。
“我们添加了单人模式，这应该是《沙丘：觉醒》此次版本更新带来的最大变化。”比洛斯说。为了响应玩家反馈，Funcom还增设了多种选项，允许玩家调整游戏难度。“这基本上就像《我的世界》里的创造模式。随着时间推移，人们越来越希望能够获得丰富的自定义玩法和体验，这正逐渐成为游戏里的一种标配。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-14/5116acf542425ed6.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

对Funcom来说，为《沙丘：觉醒》开发主机版本和新内容的工作量相当大。“很显然，多人模式和单人模式在平衡性方面的需求完全不同。”比洛斯指出，“另外，我们也需要针对主机端对游戏进行优化。”他还提到，《沙丘：觉醒》的主机移植版让Funcom有机会尝试利用索尼DualSense手柄的触觉反馈和自适应扳机功能。“这款手柄很有特点。在《沙丘：觉醒》中，我们发现了一些非常契合其特性的设计点。例如，当玩家遇到沙虫来袭，或者在沙地上行走时，都会感受到令人身临其境的震动反馈。”
比洛斯表示，他希望《沙丘：觉醒》主机版的发布能够吸引“一大波”新玩家。“与此同时，我们也一直在思考怎样维持玩家的活跃度，研究如何通过举办更多活动等方式来延长玩家的游玩时间，从而进一步提升玩家留存率。”

在未来，Funcom还有可能尝试不同的变现模式。《沙丘：觉醒》是一款提供付费DLC的买断制游戏，但这家挪威工作室曾经在《流放者柯南》等游戏中尝试过其他模式。“我们曾经采用战斗通行证+游戏内商店模式，后来又取消战斗通行证——它并不太适合《流放者柯南》——但保留了商店。我想，《沙丘：觉醒》也将经历类似的变化。我们会观察市场动态和趋势，然后挑选最合适的方案。”比洛斯说，“在线服务型游戏就得与时俱进，除此之外别无选择。”
“过去几十年间，MMO的商业模式就曾数次经历巨变：起初，几乎所有网游都需要付费订阅，后来各大厂商纷纷取消订阅，转而采用买断制，如今免费游玩+内购变现的模式又成了主流……随着时间推移，游戏产品的商业模式必将经历升级和变革，谁都无法预知未来会发生什么。”
“作为一种商业模式，‘游戏内广告’似乎也有卷土重来的势头。”比洛斯补充，“鲜为人知的是，早在2001年问世的老游戏《Anarchy Online》中，我们就曾利用广告变现。那是一款以未来都市为背景的科幻题材游戏，我们与外部公司合作，在游戏世界的醒目位置亮出大量广告横幅，通过这种方式赚了不少钱。”
■ 展望未来
2025年10月，Funcom宣布进行裁员重组，并声称目的是集中内部资源，为《沙丘：觉醒》开发新内容。随后不久，媒体爆料称Funcom旗下《重金属：地狱歌手》的瑞典研发工作室The Outsiders将被关闭。那么，Funcom目前是否只有《沙丘：觉醒》一款在研游戏？
“不，我们仍有人手负责《流放者柯南》。”巴洛斯透露，“《流放者柯南》的增强版已于今年5月在Steam上线。 此外，我们公司也有极少数同事跟我一样，正在为Funcom的未来发展制定计划。但我必须承认，公司的大部分成员确实都忙着开发《沙丘：觉醒》，而且这种情况在相当长的一段时间里不会改变。在现阶段，我们还没有为开发一款新游戏做好准备，脑子里只有一些模糊的想法。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-14/4366acf54242cbde.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“在游戏开发领域，创作者总是需要预测技术的未来，尝试预判5年后的技术走向。但如今AI发展速度太快，别说5年后，你恐怕连5个月的技术面貌都很难看清。这种现状导致预测未来变得极其困难……从某种意义上讲，正是由于游戏行业的未来充满变数，大家都在静观其变，许多团队难以获得投资。”
与Funcom同样隶属于腾讯的天美工作室群即将推出“怪猎”正版动作手游《怪物猎人：旅人》，Funcom是否也会考虑将《沙丘：觉醒》移植到移动平台？当谈到这个话题时，巴洛斯直言：“我认为那并非我们的强项，腾讯拥有很多比我们更擅长开发手游的工作室。我们另有所长。”

不过，巴洛斯留意到，人们随时可以游玩的便携式游戏正变得越来越流行。与此同时，巴洛斯还建议游戏厂商做好产品的优化和适配工作，使它们能够在低端设备上运行。“我认为，市场上将会出现越来越多与Steam Deck类似的设备。”他解释，“在可预见的未来，我们需要确保游戏能够在核心平台上流畅运行。现有的主机将会逐渐老化，但在内存问题得到解决前，平台方很可能不会推出新一代主机，因为那样做根本不赚钱。考虑到这些情况，我估计越来越多的游戏会逐渐把重心转向风格化设计，并降低对内存的占用。”
“我的看法是，我们没有必要一味地追求逼真画质。”巴洛斯说，“这一代孩子从小玩《Roblox》，他们根本不在乎画质，一点都不在乎。我自己的几个孩子就只看重玩法，不太在意游戏的画面怎么样。因此，我认为‘玩法为王’的道理比以往任何时候都更立得住脚，开发者应当针对性能较低的设备对游戏进行优化。Steam Deck就是个绝佳例子。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-14/3136acf54ccce5e1.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“在未来，与追求高保真画质相比，我们或许应当选择更具辨识度的独特美术风格。”巴洛斯说，“《魔兽世界》问世至今已经超过20年，其独特的风格化画面经受住了时间考验。虽然暴雪确实对《魔兽世界》的画面进行了一些升级，但这款经典网游的美术风格本身就拥有超越时间的魅力。”
Funcom的下一款游戏或许还处于构思阶段，但鉴于游戏行业的发展趋势，这家挪威工作室大概率会在其新作中采用独特的美术风格，而非试图实现照片级的逼真画质。与此同时，Funcom或许还会想方设法降低新游戏的技术门槛，使它能够适配尽可能多的设备。毕竟，在未来的很长一段时间里，大多数玩家很可能仍将使用旧设备玩游戏。
本文编译自： Games Industry
原文标题：《Dune Awakening's creative director on copying Hollywood, in-game advertising, and why style beats photorealism 》
原作者：Lewis Packwood

items.title: 中国玩家占据Steam半壁江山 社区评论区却不见中文？
items.summary: 中国玩家如今已成为Steam平台的重要用户群体，但一个有趣的现象是，在不少热门游戏的更新公告和新闻动态评论区，中文留言却并不常见…

content.v: 由你来说： 中国玩家明明是Steam大户，游戏公告评论区却常年少见中文玩家留言，有人觉得是国内玩家更习惯去论坛和社交平台讨论，也有人认为访问门槛和本地化不足劝退了留言欲望。你觉得中文评论少，真正原因是什么？
中国玩家如今已成为Steam平台的重要用户群体，但一个有趣的现象是，在不少热门游戏的更新公告和新闻动态评论区，中文留言却并不常见。随手打开一些游戏的公告页面，评论区往往以英文及其他语言为主。
根据Steam官方开发者文档，Steam不会自动为开发者发布的公告和动态提供机器翻译服务。公告的多语言文本及本地化素材，需要由开发团队自行准备并提交。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141950261355.png
即便是《影之刃零》这样的热门国产游戏，其Steam公告评论区也经常能看到大量英文留言，中文玩家的讨论并不总是占据主导。事实上，公告提供中文翻译，并不意味着中国玩家就会习惯在Steam社区留言。这背后可能存在多方面原因。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141950419107.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141950425956.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141950441363.png
首先，国内玩家已经形成了相对成熟的游戏资讯获取和交流习惯。游戏相关新闻、更新内容和官方消息，往往会第一时间出现在国内游戏媒体、论坛及社交平台上。相比之下，Steam社区并不是所有玩家日常交流的首选渠道。
其次，过去部分游戏的公告主要以英文发布，中文本地化并不充分，这也可能影响了一些玩家浏览Steam公告的习惯。
此外，访问Steam社区页面对部分国内玩家而言也不够方便，网络连接等因素可能增加使用门槛。即便Steam加速器不涉及付费，额外的访问步骤也可能影响玩家参与讨论的意愿。

items.title: OpenAI 员工因涉嫌使用人工智能和卫生纸记录机密会议而被捕 - FBI 局长卡什·帕特尔 (Kash Patel) 抓住机会表示人工智能公司对国家安全“至关重要”
items.summary: AI and toilet paper: the joke writes itself, doesn't it?

content.v: An OpenAI engineer has been arrested and charged for using (or endeavoring to use) an audio recording device to spy on confidential company communications. That's according to the US Department of Justice , and while commercial espionage is nothing new, there's a certain sardonic twist to this one: it seems the accused employee did so with the help of AI. Oh, and some toilet paper.

According to FBI director Kash Patel's summary of the complaint, Saudi Arabian national Abdulrahman Alfozan "allegedly concealed a covert recording device inside his employer’s executive conference room to secretly capture sensitive communications about the company’s super intelligence technology."

In case you hadn't heard, that's what the US bigwigs are calling AI now: superintelligence. Courtesy of President Trump, of course, who said last month that the Administration will use this term in place of artificial intelligence "in any applicable setting."

The FBI director also said, "Protecting American SI innovation is essential to safeguarding our nation’s economic strength and national security, and the FBI views that mission as one of our highest counterintelligence priorities."

The complaint says that Alfozan had worked for OpenAI since July 2025 as an engineer, and at the end of last month OpenAI discovered a USB audio recording device plugged into a conference room TV. According to the Justice Department, the device, which had been installed for a couple of days before discovery, was "concealed in toilet paper."

The complaint also alleges that Alfozans' spouse's "chatbot" account (no mention of whether that's a ChatGPT account or something else) submitted prompts related to things such as "build[ing] a continuous audio recorder", "improv[ing] audio and live listening", and "encrypt[ing] the SD card." There were allegedly also prompts relating to the specific recording device that was found.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/AnPQbbV754ubEA9wMwz62Y-1920-80.jpg
The conference room in question seems to have been an important one. The Department of Justice explains:

"According to the complaint, meetings in the executive conference room where Recording Device 1 was discovered frequently involved discussions of highly confidential technical, commercial, and strategic information, including proprietary research, product plans, and business-development opportunities, as well as nonpublic information about Open AI’s technical progress and strategic decisions, capabilities, priorities, government engagements, and commercial relationships."

Various appendages of the state seem to be taking this very seriously. Which isn't surprising, of course, given AI development—no, I'm not calling it 'SI'—is deemed important to national security and prosperity.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/toD7dricW9DJqnsPdwk9XH-1920-80.jpg

Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said: "This serious situation underscores why winning the global super intelligence race is a national security prerogative... The intelligence community remains committed to safeguarding America’s cutting-edge intellectual property from foreign threats."

US Attorney Craig H. Missakian for the Northern District of California seems to agree: "For us it is a matter of national security. This arrest highlights our relentless efforts in partnership with the FBI to identify and prosecute those who seek to steal our technology, as alleged in the complaint."
My question, however, is this: If the allegations are true, would Alfozan have been able to do this without the use of an AI chatbot? Snakes and tails, and all that.

items.title: 亚马逊现推出 MTG x Marvel 超级英雄助推器促销，价格大幅下降
items.summary: Save big bucks on Magic: The Gathering’s Marvel Super Heroes set at Amazon, including Commander precons, Play

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/marvel-super-heroes-amazon-sale-ign-1791977964819.png
Magic: The Gathering’s Universes Beyond crossovers remain contentious within the community, but there’s no denying they bring more eyeballs to what is, by any measure, a very fun and deep card game.

If Marvel Super Heroes has drawn you in, you’re in good company. It’s a big step forward from last year’s Spider-Man-centric set, bringing the Avengers, Fantastic Four, and plenty more iconic characters into the game. And with Wizards of the Coast already announcing Marvel: Darkhold Destiny for April 2027 , featuring a darker, supernatural side of the Marvel Universe, there’s plenty more to look forward to if you’re enjoying this latest crossover.

Whether you're looking to build your collection, crack open some booster packs, or jump straight into a preconstructed Commander deck, we've rounded up the best deals on Magic: The Gathering's Marvel Super Heroes set.

The humble Play Booster is the backbone of any Magic: The Gathering set, offering one of the more affordable ways to build up your collection. Over at Amazon, you can save 28% on a Play Booster box , bringing it down to $147.95 from $209.70. That works out at $4.93 per pack, rather than the usual $6.99 MSRP, and you're getting 30 of the things in one fell swoop. Not bad at all.

Play Boosters are much less likely to cough up the big-money cards in Marvel Super Heroes , mind you. If you're hoping to strike gold, you'll want to look at the pricier Collector Boosters instead, currently back in stock at Amazon for $44.99 each, or $449.99 for pricey booster display box.

While we're on the premium options, as well, I'd like to call out the Collector's Edition Commander Decks, which are now down to $448.26. That's below market price compared to TCGplayer ($487), and a fairly good deal if you don't mind paying about $112 per deck. Seems like a lot, but it's still much better than paying the $640 ($160 per deck) that it was listed for before the sale.
If you want to find the most valuable cards in the set, you'll need to pay a premium to find them.

Amazon doesn't have individual Play Boosters available right now, but there are a couple of alternatives worth a look. The Marvel Super Heroes Gift Bundle includes nine Play Boosters and a Collector Booster, and it's currently $10 off , bringing it to just under $80. The Play Boosters alone would set you back around $63, so you're essentially getting that Collector Booster for a much more agreeable price.

Then there's Draft Night, which is currently discounted by 25% at Amazon . You get 12 Play Boosters for a spot of sealed Magic, plus a Collector Booster thrown in for good measure. At $89.99, we've crunched the numbers , and you're effectively paying just $6 for the Collector Booster. That's a pretty tidy deal.

If you'd rather skip the Collector Booster altogether, the Marvel Super Heroes Bundle is 27% off . Think of it as the modern equivalent of the old Fat Packs, giving you a nice stack of boosters without having to commit to a full box or settle for just a couple of packs.

Of course, Commander remains one of the most popular ways to play Magic: The Gathering, and three of the four Marvel Super Heroes preconstructed decks are discounted right now. Sorry, Black Panther fans.
I'd start with Avengers Assemble, which features familiar faces like Captain America and makes for a fun way to learn the ropes. It's currently $54.90, down from $74.99 .

I was less taken with Doom Prevails, but there's still plenty to like if you're a fan of Marvel's villains and fancy adding them to your collection. It's currently 10% off at $67.38 . With Wakanda Forever missing out on a discount, I'd personally go for Fantastic Four instead. It's had a full $30 knocked off its MSRP, bringing it down to $44.99 .
Marvel: Darkhold Destiny
What makes Darkhold Destiny particularly interesting is that Wizards of the Coast has more room to tell its own story with Marvel's characters and settings.
Rather than simply transplanting familiar comic book heroes into Magic, the set looks to be building something that feels more at home in the game's multiverse.
That's a promising direction for Universes Beyond, especially for those who'd like these crossovers to feel like more than a collection of recognisable faces on Magic cards.

We'll have to wait until April 2027 to see how the full set comes together, but Darkhold Destiny is already shaping up to be an intriguing next step for Magic's Marvel crossovers. And if Marvel Super Heroes has been your gateway into the game, there could be plenty more to look forward to.

For more on Magic: The Gathering, check out our thoughts on how The Hobbit set compares with The Lord of the Rings , the most valuable cards in Reality Fracture , and the latest update on the postponed Monster Hunter Secret Lair .

items.title: 《战地 6》皮肤有太多手枪和拼写错误引发 AI 指控
items.summary: Battlefield 6 has come under fire from fans after its latest battle pass was found to include new character sk

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/bf6-1791976768352.png
Battlefield 6 has come under fire from fans after its latest battle pass was found to include new character skins with some pretty clear design flaws.

The first that stands out is the soldier wearing some kind of Batman mask, but minus the ears. He has five pistols attached to the chest pockets of his tac vest, for when you positively, absolutely have to go Shiva mode on some clowns. “Because switching to your pistol, secondary pistol, tertiary pistol, quartenary (sic) pistol, and quinary pistol is faster than reloading, soldier!” one Reddit poster joked .
💀 BRO IS CARRYING 5 PISTOLS! WHO APPROVED THIS SKIN? 😭 #Battlefield6 https://t.co/b6o94OkV1o

Illogical pistol placement isn’t the only thing weirding fans out. Some are convinced some of the skins were actually created with generative AI, after noticing weird spelling errors and other inconsistencies. One of the skins has a patch that says “secuty” on it, which is presumably supposed to say “security.”
Secuty 😭 It's AI #Battlefield6 https://t.co/8DVphghCSU

"I believe it’s almost impossible to deny anymore that EA/DICE is using AI for the skins in #Battlefield6,” said one X / Twitter poster . “At least in the concept phase — and then anything that looks even remotely 'cool' just gets rubber-stamped.”
IGN has asked EA for comment.

Another skin features a bomb disposal juggernaut with thick body armor and a completely exposed head, like a cheeky little turtle poking out of its shell. Imagine aura farming when the shrapnel starts flying. It doesn’t help that he’s carrying magazines for small game hunting rifles that don’t exist in Battlefield 6.
“Fps .22s probably take like 2 full mags to kill someone,” one X / Twitter user said . “Not to mention he's carrying super finicky mags for a .22 varmint rifle,” joked another .

While it's possible that these skin issues are the result of human error, fans aren't giving DICE the benefit of the doubt. Perhaps that shouldn't come as much of a surprise; AI is perhaps the hottest topic in the video game industry, and with the likes of Fortnite developer Epic Games going all-in on generative AI , there is an intense scrutiny and a healthy dose of skepticism around video game assets that contain clear errors, particularly when they cost money to buy.

Elsewhere, fans are feeling misled over the inclusion of more whacky cosmetics. As well as a reactive weapon skin , there are crossover cosmetics with other EA series, allowing Battlefield 6 players to do some Dead Space cosplay. These land ahead of the Battlefield 6 Dead Space event .

It’s not quite Nicki Minaj, but the inclusion of these skins goes back on what the developers said prior to launch. Developers at DICE had gone on the record to say Battlefield 6 won’t feature goofy, immersion breaking skins .

《吉伊卡哇》这几年很火，韩国姑娘小梅（X：i_melody_you）就是吉伊卡哇的忠实粉丝，她有一个《吉伊卡哇》里面吉伊的娃娃，经常带着它在全球各地旅行，拍下各种各样的照片和视频。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_5494539_4879372.gif
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_5494539_4879369.gif
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_5494539_4879373.jpg
2022年10月21日，她带着吉伊来到了日本镰仓和江之岛旅游，准备和吉伊留下美好的回忆。
“带着吉伊来镰仓旅行啦~”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_5494539_4879375.jpg
然而……观鸟者看鹰的圣地江之岛有大量的野生鹰盘旋在天空中，有些会抢人类的物品，诸如食物、帽子。
百度：如初久不知梦
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_5494539_4879370.jpg
隔了没多久，她在X上发了一条和吉伊一起畅游海边的短视频，不过吉伊好像还购买了飞机票去畅游江之岛上空欣赏美景了。
“大家千万别在海边拿玩偶拍照啊…… 我也不想知道，在镰仓我的吉伊卡哇被鹰叼走了…… 呜呜 旁边的日本朋友一起帮我找它……ㅠㅠ”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_5494539_4879371.jpg
第一次听到鹰叫（小声。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_5494539_4879377.gif
虽然小梅没有受伤，但窜出来的猛禽和被抓走的娃娃，都足以让她感受到来自大自然的震撼。
对于网友们，这种视频多少有些戏剧化了，而且这剧情……真的好像某一集啊，虽然被叼走和叼东西的鸟都换了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_5494539_4879376.jpg
视频开始疯狂在网上传播。
“这视频看多少次都看不够啊。”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_5494539_4879374.jpg
“传说”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_5494539_4879379.jpg
“不敢相信这段画面居然是真的”
X：JAZZ JACK
X：Ocean_ddz
X：あずまわり
有姬友可能会说：小姑娘虽然没受伤但是玩偶被叼走了，这不算消费苦难吗？！首先小梅对二创持欢迎态度，其次，小梅的吉伊被叼走后，她似乎就持有一种“想哭但是笑出来了”的态度。
“快看鹰爪上晃悠悠吊着的白色吉伊……我当时好想放声大哭”
视频中鹰还时不时啃一口吉伊。
也许是吉伊不太好吃的原因，奇迹发生了，飞了没多久，鹰就把吉伊丢下去了，小梅在朋友们的帮助下，顺利捡回了掉在马路上的吉伊。
“妈妈！我被鹰朋友选中，去天上旅行回来啦！”
值得一提的是，海边早就有告示，提醒大家小心，但小梅没注意，为了提醒大家去海边注意安全，小梅特地返回让吉伊和告示牌拍了一张。
而她手中都要露馅儿了的吉伊，在她奶奶的缝补下，获得了新生——毕竟这也算是传奇吉伊了，怎么可能舍得丢掉呢？
“跟大家播报消息：结束漫长旅途的旅行款吉伊卡哇，刚刚终于回到我房间的床上啦……在镰仓和鹰一起上天旅行，还被奶奶做了大手术，最后平安到家的圆满结局..´◡`♡♡”
后来，这只吉伊一直陪着小梅继续旅行，2026年10月11日，也就是前几天，他们故地重游，这次，小梅使出了死亡之握，誓死保护自己的吉伊。
不过吉伊这个表情好像有点要死了。
X：JAZZ JACK
X：나니망 | 중세버튜버
这条视频，再次在网上获得了几千万的浏览量，小梅的吉伊也再也不怕被鹰抓走，开开心心地结束了旅行。不得不说，小梅没有被鹰抓伤可以说是非常幸运的了，要知道，那可是鹰啊，猛禽啊，被普通的鸟抓伤都可能见红，更别说是鹰了。
大家旅行时候要注意防范野生动物哦！
晚安。

items.title: 花7999元享优先购买iPhone Duo资格！名额闪电售罄
items.summary: 快科技10月14日消息，日前京东平台上架了一款售价7999元的iPhone早鸟先享权益包，一经开售就被抢购一空。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141912217242.jpg
快科技10月14日消息，日前京东平台上架了一款售价7999元的iPhone早鸟先享权益包，一经开售就被抢购一空。
用户支付7999元后即可获得iPhone Duo早鸟先享资格。同时还可享有999元复购补贴、90天免费换新、1年免费维修以及5年电池免费换新服务。此外，京东还提供了实物赠品，包括手机壳、手机膜以及快充头。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141912418394.jpg
当然，购买iPhone Duo时用户还需要单独支付手机费用，并且在收到货时必须当场激活。
根据此前爆料的消息，iPhone Duo首批备货量比较有限，可能是最近几年备货量最少的一款iPhone。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141912524923.png
这意味着iPhone Duo首销时大概率会出现溢价情况。与其溢价购买iPhone Duo，不如花7999元抢购权益包。这样不仅能第一时间拿到iPhone Duo，还能享有额外的权益，这也是不少人对此感兴趣的重要原因。
据产业链消息，iPhone Duo由代工厂富士康负责组装。其整机组装良率仅为60%出头，远低于常规iPhone的成熟水准，接近四成产品无法达标。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141912594851.jpg
iPhone Duo的良率瓶颈主要来自核心部件铰链。这款铰链由上百个精密零件组成，初期零部件的良率较低。而且，iPhone Duo的良率爬坡至少还需要半年时间，因此短期内大概率会供不应求。
售价方面，iPhone Duo的起售价为15999元，将于10月16日开启预售，10月23日正式发售，并提供256GB、512GB、1TB和2TB四种存储版本。

items.title: 车企想摆脱宁德时代！赔车都比用他们电池划算

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878973.jpg
说了很久 “ 苦宁王久矣 ” 以后，车企们终于选择摆脱宁德时代了。
最近这一阵，有不少新势力品牌发布了自己的新车型。
有意思的是，里头有不少曾和宁德时代电池深度绑定、甚至把后者当成招牌的车企，好像已经被 摆脱了 “ 宁王迷信 ” ， 用上其他品牌的电池了。
就比如理想和小米，哥俩之前都曾对着麒麟电池大吹特吹，结果前者高调宣布了自己全 自研电池 的战略，代工厂是欣旺达和中创新航。
后者的则主导了自己龙甲电池的设计，再交给 欣旺达和中创新航 生产。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878974.jpg
再加上零跑、小鹏、吉利甚至是宁德时代的老客户宝马都开始 转投二三线品牌 ，虽然说 “ 车企正在抛弃宁德时代 ” 并不准确，但宁德时代在新车上的出场率，确实在肉眼可见地降低。
所以说，为什么曾经吹爆宁德电池的车企们，集体选择了光速变脸？
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878978.jpg
其他品牌的电池质量相比宁德时代，又到底是什么水平呢？
在问了几个电池行业的资深老哥以后，脖子哥可以肯定的是， 车企们这样做的原因有且仅有一个，那就是宁德的电池真的太贵了。
李哥是宁德时代某核心供应商的高级工程师，他表示电池包里 利润最高 的，就是电芯本身。“ 一个电池包如果卖 1000 块，里面电芯值 700-900 。”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878975.jpg
放眼全世界，宁德时代就是那个 最会卖电芯 的企业。靠着自己起步早、技术积累多，宁德时代在最近几年可以说是挣得盆满钵满。
要知道，类似理想、赛力斯这样的头部新势力，去年全年的收入也就只有不到 2000 亿人民币。
可从 2020 年到现在，宁德时代在动力电池上的总收入就已经达到了 1.414 万亿元人民币，并在今年上半年达到了 1921.2 亿的顶峰， 收入数据远超单一的新势力车企。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878976.jpg
更夸张的是它的利润。
去年宁王在动力电池业务上的利润达到了恐怖的 754 亿，毛利率高达 23.84% 。作为对比，年营收超过 8000 亿的比亚迪，最后的利润却只有 326 亿，不到宁王的一半。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878977.jpg
所以也有说法，说新能源车企卷了半天，其实都是在给宁德时代打工。
李哥说，整车厂会选择换电池品牌甚至是自研，最大的原因就是想要 省下这笔 “ 宁德税 ” 。因为除去宁德时代，其余电池品牌的利润率其实并没有很高。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878979.jpg
他给脖子哥举了个例子，宁德时代目前的价格大概是 0.585 元/Wh ，而主流的二线品牌报价则是 0.52元/Wh 甚至是更低。
假设一台车的电池大小是 60 度，每年能卖出 20 万台，那光是从这一台车上，车企就可以通过切换供应商省下 7.8 亿的成本。
更进一步的，比如理想，干脆直接就 和 欣旺达 成立了合资公司 ，所有电池都由合资公司生产，深度参与电芯的研发采购和生产，这就又能从流程里抠出一些成本。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878987.jpg
动辄大几亿十几亿的成本缩减，对于本就极度渴望降本的新能源车企来说，吸引力不是一般的大。
当然，这是比较好理解的部分。
毕竟车企降本增效这个事情脖子哥已经说了远不止一次，通过切换供应商来降低生产成本的事情也不是只发生在动力电池上。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878980.jpg
作为消费者，车企省不省钱、能挣多少钱说白了关我啥事。
更换供应商会不会 对产品的质量产生影响 ，才是我们最关心的。
这种担忧在动力电池上尤为突出，一方面是因为动力电池是电车上最贵同时也是最危险的系统，只要发生热失控，就只有烧的只剩车壳这一个结局。
电池的质量好不好，可是要命的大事。
而另一方面，作为动力电池领域的 GOAT ，宁德时代的电池不仅是很多人心里的高端车型标配，宁德自己也一直在营销 “ 选车认准宁德电池 ” 这种很好记的口号，口碑和地位这一块确实是实打实的。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878998.jpg
车企们的省钱行为背后有没有代价？如果有，又是什么呢？
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878988.jpg
可以确定的是，这个代价并不是电池的性能。
阿吉是某二线电池品牌的研发工程师，他跟脖子哥说虽然现在和动力电池相关的技术，比如材料、结构、电解液配方等都已经非常成熟 ，友商相互之间也几乎没有秘密。
特别是磷酸铁锂电池，宁德时代能做出来的性能指标，二三线厂商同样能做得 大差不差 。即使是中端车型，也能拥有曾经高端车型独享的高电压平台和 5C、6C 的超充倍率。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/14/origin_4630187_4878981.jpg
“ 从技术上面来说，假设宁德是 100 分，比亚迪是 90 分，那其他家至少也能做到 80 分。”
可即使是这样，阿吉却依旧表示， “ 二线平台和宁德时代的差距是没有办法解决的 ” 。
这主要体现在 生产工艺和质量管控 上。
他说电池企业内部都会有一套质检标准，用来保证生产出来的电池质量够好并且一致性够强。但一些二线品牌有时候为了满足出货速度和出货量的需要，会在交付时偷偷降低标准。
“ 比如说用来超声波焊接电芯极耳的设备，它的焊头和焊座按道理每工作 10 万次就应该更换，但一些电池厂的设备会现场偷偷清零，省下更换的时间和物料成本。”
此外，如果电池整包在下线质检的时候遇到问题，某些厂商还会先评审问题的大小再考虑要不要解决。如果问题不大就有概率放行，甚至还会出现 “ 电池包发现了问题，只要和整车段打个招呼就能正常上车 ” 的情况。
宁德时代这头，画风却完全不一样。
李哥表示，宁德时代在质量控制上的成本远超其他电池厂。
“ 宁德时代不在乎厂内报废率，同样是遇到下线有问题的整包，只要出现异常就是报废，报废率 99% ，其他公司接受不了。”
这源自宁德内部的 质量控制体系 。
李哥表示，宁德时代的内部质量体系标准已经太过成熟，标准文件几乎已经写死。同时，宁德基本也不会接受客户外部输入 （ 更低的 ） 标准，也就导致质量控制的成本根本下不来。”
虽然因为涉密，李哥没法跟我们直接对比宁德和其他电池品牌的内部标准，但他表示 质量控制在 每个环节的叠加 之后，带来的效果差距就是巨大的。
按照宁德的标准，如果每个电芯是 1 PPB （ 每 10 亿个电芯有 1 个会失效 ） ，那用了 300 个电芯的整包总共就是 300 PPB 。
为了管理电芯失效还需要监控系统，宁德的电芯失效概率比较小所以整包只需要 9 套监控，而部分友商则是 20 多套，但 监控系统本身也有失效概率 。
“ 叠加之后，宁德时代的电池包整包可以做到 1 PPM （ 每百万电池包有 1 个会失效 ） ，而其他厂家大都在 35 PPM 左右。”
这还只是整包层面，如果单看电芯的话，李哥表示宁德时代已经做到了 1 PPB，而友商们大多在 100~1000 PPB（ 0.1~1 PPM ）之间。

items.title: Rockstar 建造了整个工作室只是为了制作 GTA 6 NPC
items.summary: Rockstar Games reportedly established an entire studio in Los Angeles dedicated to creating NPCs for Grand The

content.v: Rockstar Games reportedly established an entire studio in Los Angeles dedicated to creating NPCs for Grand Theft Auto 6 after realizing the game's ambitious world would need far more production resources than initially expected.

Speaking to Bloomberg , Rockstar development lead Rob Nelson explained that the team had struggled to meet its targets for the number of NPCs that needed to be written and animated. That makes sense when you consider how much more interactive they're reported to be, even noticing and reacting when you're carrying a weapon. The numbers were so concerning that they were a large reason for the first GTA 6 delay.

"The projections they were giving us were horrifying," Nelson said. To combat the issue, Rockstar subsequently built out a Los Angeles studio staffed with writers, producers, and directors who would exclusively focus on creating NPCs for the game. The decision was part of a wider effort to ensure the game would meet the studio's ambitious goals without sacrificing anything from its vision.

The sheer scale of that reflects Rockstar's approach to making the world of GTA 6 feel more convincing than ever. Instead of treating NPCs like background characters, the studio has worked to give the residents of Leonida more detailed behaviors and interactions.

Those lofty ambitions have contributed to GTA 6's lengthy development. It's been in production for more than eight years, with Rockstar having to navigate pandemic-related disruptions, changes in leadership, and decisions about how much realism to include .

Rockstar ultimately delayed GTA 6 twice, moving its planned release from 2025 to May 2026 before pushing it back again to November 19, 2026. Development lead Phil Hooker said that the team could have met an earlier deadline, but it would have compromised on the game it wanted to make.
However, the legwork in building a solid foundation for GTA 6 means that Rockstar says you won't have to wait another eight years for its next title.

items.title: Rockstar 的 GTA 6 现实主义实验从啤酒和三明治开始
items.summary: Compared to previous games in the series, Grand Theft Auto 6 is aiming to add new layers of realism to the fra

content.v: Compared to previous games in the series, Grand Theft Auto 6 is aiming to add new layers of realism to the franchise. As the criminal couple Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, players will explore a city where actions have consequences , and it's not easy to shake the long arm of the law when you cause chaos. It continues ideas that developer Rockstar Games began experimenting with in Red Dead Redemption 2, but the studio says it initially struggled to figure out how realistic it wanted GTA 6 to be while still offering a fun gameplay experience.

As detailed by Bloomberg's Jason Schreier , Rockstar had a foundation to build on for GTA 6, as it would once again be a satirical open-world game in which you could commit all manner of crime. But the small details proved tricky, as Rockstar Games wanted players to feel immersed in the game's world. At one point, the developers debated whether players would need to fetch a case of beer from a liquor store fridge and take it to the counter before they could buy it, or visit a supermarket to buy ingredients to make a stat-boosting sandwich. "Making each of these decisions required a lot of guesswork because so much of the game wasn’t yet finished," Schreier wrote.

By 2022, GTA 6 began to come into focus, even though much work remained on the ambitious game. "You go through a period where things don't work, but you see snippets," GTA 6 head of development Phil Hooker said to Bloomberg.

From what Rockstar has shown off so far, GTA 6 appears to both look and feel realistic thanks to various gameplay systems. Characters will react to Jason and Lucia's antics, and the two protagonists are at the center of a relationship gameplay system that can let their partnership blossom romantically, or you can ignore it entirely and keep them as platonic partners in crime. Players won't feel "all-powerful" in the game either, as Rockstar boss Rob Nelson said that the world can react in a hostile manner to your actions.
GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and while a PC port hasn't been announced yet, it's rumored that it might arrive in Q1 2027 .

items.title: NS2改良款太方便！电池轻松取下 官方演示毫不费劲
items.summary: 近日，任天堂发布Switch 2欧盟改良款的官方更换电池操作指南。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141900111682.png
近日，任天堂发布Switch 2欧盟改良款的官方更换电池操作指南。
改良款是专门在欧洲市场推出的特殊版本。该版本最大的特点是允许用户自行更换内置电池，以满足欧盟关于消费电子产品电池易拆卸、易更换的法律要求。
根据任天堂公布的官方指南，更换电池只需要一把十字螺丝刀和一块替换电池。适用的电池型号为“BEE-003(-01)”，任天堂未来还计划提供包含所需零部件的电池更换套件。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141859505593.png
更换时，用户需要拆下固定机身的9颗螺丝，分别位于左右两侧、底部、背面以及顶部。卸下螺丝后，即可取下后盖并接触到内部电池。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141859516137.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141859526959.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141859536909.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/small_202610141859538573.png
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/origin_202610141900239350.gif
新改良版的一大特点，是电池采用金属触点连接，而非传统的线缆或插头。因此，拆卸电池时不需要断开内部线路，而且电池也没有使用胶水固定，进一步降低了更换难度。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/14/origin_202610141900298651.gif
对于智能手机和游戏机而言，电池老化往往会导致续航时间缩短，用户可能因此考虑维修甚至换新。如果设备能够更方便地更换电池，即使电池性能随时间下降，用户也能更轻松地继续使用原有设备。

content.v: I (don't) want to hold your hand.

Of all the discourse to hit the gaming industry in the past month, the conversation around AAA game design has been one of the most interesting. Insomniac’s Wolverine has been the final straw for a lot of gamers, turning the public tide against claustrophobically linear games that spoon-feed progression, whether that be through yellow paint or stink trails .

Rogue Factor's Hell Is Us slots perfectly into this discourse, a game whose design is antithetical to Wolverine, one that encourages the player to trust their instincts and not be afraid of getting lost. Through this design and its story, Hell is Us makes a grand statement about humanity, sometimes at the cost of fun moment-to-moment gameplay.

items.title: 据报道，黑客仅需要“123456”密码即可泄露超过 800 万人的个人数据
items.summary: A department where just a little bit of creativity doesn't go amiss.

content.v: Please, please, please do not use '123456' as any kind of password. I know that may seem obvious, but apparently it bears repeating if a recent hack of Denmark's Central Register of Persons (CPR) is anything to go by.

To recap, the CPR administration said earlier this month that it had become aware of a breach that took place in September (PDF warning). This exposed personal details—names, addresses, ID numbers—of 8.8 million people, both living and deceased. It was confirmed at the time that the legitimate access of a private Danish firm had been exploited by the attacker.

A person claiming responsibility for the attack has come forward this week. Not only that, they say that they gained access to the CPR via an account which had the password '123456'. According to Danish newspaper Politiken , this was one of three accounts held by the private firm with that same password. One of these was an administrator account. Talk about a cybersecurity boo-boo.

The self-identified attacker claims they have no intention of leaking or selling the data they lifted, so that's something. Still, we're left with the uncomfortable reminder that those who should know better don't always have the best password management.

The Danish firm at the heart of this attack has been identified as Pays ApS. This company was granted access to the CPR in order to provide various services, like validating business customers' records.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SM8hnsh8PPqNMXUJSPvVmW-1920-80.jpg

The self-identified attacker gained access to the Pays ApS account on September 10, and then ran 14 million automated searches of the CPR between then and September 20 . The attack was only discovered on October 2 when an employee at the Ministry of Research, Education and Digitalisation noticed an unusually high invoice, which indicated that many more searches than the norm were being made by Pays ApS.

Hackers are all too aware of the most common passwords, with ' 123456' often bafflingly popular among them . Bottom line, now might be a good time to update your passwords to something uniquely yours or to otherwise investigate password tools (though not even something like a password manager is completely air tight ).

Not every hacker is rocking a password cracking rig with 12 Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090s —for instance, I was particularly charmed by the password-cracking Game Boy Advance that is ' about thirty million times slower than a modern cracking rig '. But if your password is '123456', a hacker won't need hardware any more dedicated than their brain to crack open your account like a coconut.

items.title: Xbox 正在进军人工智能游戏领域，尽管它没有明说
items.summary: Vibe-coded games playable in web browsers have exploded in popularity recently, and amid a deluge of ports and

content.v: Vibe-coded games playable in web browsers have exploded in popularity recently, and amid a deluge of ports and remasters created with generative AI, Xbox is responding by creating Xbox Labs. The new branch of Xbox is described as an initiative designed to get more people playing games--especially on web browsers--but curiously, there's no mention of AI at all in the announcement.

"In recent weeks, we've seen games rapidly decompiled and rebuilt to run on hardware they were never originally designed to support," Xbox CEO Asha Sharma wrote . "Windows PC builds have been translated to run on Apple Silicon or ported to run inside a browser through WebAssembly and WebGPU, the latter now approaching 90% global browser support. Perhaps more surprisingly, we’ve seen many of the biggest games in the world have been remixed into the source code of another. These experiments challenge long-held assumptions about our industry: the tether between software and hardware, the boundary between creation and play, and how people discover and experience games."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Xbox-Labs.jpg?w=636

Sharma added that Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet and a small team have been tasked with turning "turn emerging ideas" into experiences for consumers and developers. The idea of banking heavily on AI to create games is still a controversial topic in the west--whereas Asian markets have heavily pivoted toward it. Dragon Quest creator Yuji Horii is a big proponent of the technology, and other studios have begun incorporating it into their workflows to help combat the rising development times and costs of making a video game in the modern age.

Xbox Labs could be an effort to change public opinion on AI, given that many of the projects popping up online are vibe-coded remasters of older games like The Simpsons: Hit and Run, or mash-ups creating a chimera out of IP like Minecraft and Elden Ring . Xbox's parent company, Microsoft, also has a stake in the AI arms race, as its significant investments in the tech have seen a surge in profits . Alongside Xbox Labs, the company also announced the formation of XP , a new subdivision dedicated to expanding Xbox's presence through film, television, and live events.

Unreal Engine and Fortnite maker Epic Games is also making a huge pivot toward an AI-first game-development model, and the company has reportedly delayed an unannounced shooter featuring Marvel and Star Wars characters.

items.title: Pokémon TCG：Delta Reign Booster Bundle 预购已在沃尔玛降价 25 美元——现在 6 包 55 美元
items.summary: Preorder the Pokémon TCG Delta Reign Booster Bundle for $54.49 at Walmart, nearly $20 below market price and $

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/pokemon-tcg-delta-reign-booster-bundle-walmart-preorder-deal-cover-1791905182601.jpg

Delta Reign preorders only started dropping at Pokémon TCG retailers last week, with the Booster Bundle at best being $74.95 on Amazon as of last Friday ; to my surprise, though, a third-party seller on Walmart has been quick to drop prices and even go well under market price.
At Walmart right now, seller Cataclysm Games has knocked the price of Delta Reign’s six-pack Booster Bundle to only $54.49 , after slicing off $25.50 from its original $79.99 price tag.
That approximately 32% price drop is an astonishing deal for multiple reasons, depending on how you look at it.
First, its current market price, estimated by trading card marketplace TCGplayer, is currently a much higher $73.10 — almost $20 more.
Granted, it’s standard for modern Pokémon TCG Booster Bundles to steadily drop below $55, and even $45, over time (like with Perfect Order and Pitch Black), but almost never during pre-release.

Even on the Delta Reign Booster Bundle’s TCGplayer page , where you can also find available listings from as low as $72.31, its value has been slowly dropping over the last week, but any seller who jumps straight to under $55 from the get-go is really trying to earn sales fast.

If it were an unheard-of, or at least poorly rated, seller, we’d encourage anyone to stay away, but Cataclysm Games has been a regular Pokémon TCG seller we’ve seen over previous months and currently boasts four and a half out of five stars.
Of course, if you only prefer listings directly sold and shipped by the retailer itself, that’s completely fair enough.

That said, going with this Walmart price will also be saving you almost $10 compared to Amazon, too — where its best listing, which is also on sale, is for $64.45 , also via third-party seller Collectors Expedition.

Among the prices we’ve seen right now, this Walmart booster bundle is the best way to get the lowest price-per-pack without buying a display box; with this six-pack box, you’ll be paying around $9.08 each — which is $4.32 cheaper than packs on TCGplayer, currently $13.40 each .

if you're looking for anything else Delta Reign, the lowest price for the Elite Trainer Box at Amazon right now is $139.94 , through third-party sellers Collectors Expedition or Kings Games. However, Walmart has also recently undercut that just-shy-of-$140 price by nearly $20 .

Right now, the Delta Reign ETB is just $119.99 at Walmart via Cataclysm Games (another notable third-party seller). That’s not only the lowest price we’ve seen so far, but also under TCGplayer’s estimated market price of $122.17.

items.title: 《龙之信条 2：黑暗觉者》Fami 通评测：停不下来的刷宝体验
items.summary: 2024 年发售的开放世界动作游戏《龙之信条 2》的全新扩展内容《龙之信条 2：黑暗觉者》已于 2026 年 10 月 9 日正式推出，登陆任天堂 Switch 2、PS5、Xbox Series X|S 以及 PC（S

content.v: 2024 年发售的开放世界动作游戏《龙之信条 2》的全新扩展内容《龙之信条 2：黑暗觉者》已于 2026 年 10 月 9 日正式推出，登陆任天堂 Switch 2、PS5、Xbox Series X|S 以及 PC（Steam）平台。开发团队在倾听并吸纳了大量玩家反馈之后，不仅在该 DLC 中带来了全新区域“诺根”，还引入了刷宝玩法。在提升游玩便捷性的同时，游戏的可玩性与内容深度也得到了极大的扩展。
在游戏发售前，《Fami 通》编辑有幸提前玩到了游戏正式版的内容，下面将为大家带来详细的评测文章。值得注意的是，本次试玩到的《龙之信条 2：黑暗觉者》为 PS5 版，下文中提到的按键标注均以 PS5 版为准。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/3dc9497230134ba299295898e387e564/
在“诺根”重温探索未知大陆的乐趣
《龙之信条 2：黑暗觉者》中最核心也是体量最大的内容，莫过于在极北之地“诺根”展开的全新冒险。 在被世人认为早已覆灭的诺根，意外传出了发现“另一位觉醒者”的消息。为了查明真相，主角将与自己的追随者一起共同踏上这片极北之地……这便是该 DLC 的大致主线剧情。
进行完试玩体验后，我首先要强调一点，那就是“玩家在这部 DLC 里依然能收获满满的探索和冒险乐趣”。放眼望去皆是未知的风景，心里总会忍不住嘀咕“那边好像有个遗迹”、“这里居然能捡到这种道具”。这种一点一点拓宽探索版图的感觉，不由得让人回想起了初次游玩《龙之信条 2》本篇内容时的激动心情。
至于新地图的面积，据木下所述，大概和巴达尔地区那片褐色区域的总和差不多大。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/76b3d9a09efbc0e7174fe05637c6e7ec/
从我实际的游玩感受来看，地图面积的确如他所言。不过诺根地区整体的地形存在大量高低落差，不仅有地下错综相连的洞窟，还遍布着不做好防寒措施就寸步难行的严寒地带。地图上的内容密度很高，想要完整探索绝非易事。
在暴风雪天气下待在室外会进入“冰冻”状态，持续减少角色的体力上限，因此必须装备带御寒性能的防具或者使用“暖石”等防寒道具。顺带一提，暴风雪来临时画面左下角的小地图几乎会被完全遮挡，甚至无法使用飞石
为了凸显地形上的高低差，游戏新增了一个非常实用的道具“钩绳”。玩家可以朝带有固定桩的位置抛出钩绳，将其变成一道绳梯，借此在高低错落的地形间自由穿梭，扩展自己的可探索范围。不过需要注意的是，钩绳是一种消耗品，如果库存储备不够充裕的话，最好还是精打细算，等到关键的时候再用。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/f917aa88e2399f2d837411c89ce25b50/
此外，在诺根玩家无法放置常规的“返回的基石”，取而代之的是可以设置“诺根的基石”作为传送点。玩家最多可以自由放置 5 个诺根的基石，至于具体要选哪些地图上的战略要地作为传送点，可能会让不少玩家陷入纠结。
当然，在探索的路上也少不了遇到各种魔物，你必须一路披荆斩棘才能继续前进。
别说大型魔物，就连生活在诺根的小型魔物也比本体的敌人强上好几个等级。一旦被怪物们包围，就必须和追随者打出精妙的配合才有可能化险为夷。对于那些早就在本体中游刃有余的老觉醒者们来说，这无疑是一个绝佳的试练场地。
沦陷在刷宝的泥沼之中
令人欲罢不能的刷宝要素是本作引入的一大核心玩法。
每当玩家击杀栖息在诺尔甘的魔物，或者在野外进行采集时，都有几率获得“战遗物”或“遗留物资”等未鉴定的道具。经过鉴定之后，前者能变成强力的武器防具，后者则是各种实用的道具。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/e34c4a5e1bdb0e5c74169c22df4e7ff0/
进行鉴定需要消耗“异界石”，但玩家也可以把不需要的战遗物直接转化成异界石资源。整个 DLC 中最令人沉迷的游玩体验就是先打怪掉落战遗物，然后花费异界石进行鉴定，等换上更强的装备后再朝更深处探索并讨伐更多魔物。
鉴定战遗物后获得的装备可能会附带特殊词条，除了“对特定魔物的伤害增加”和“提升体力上限”这类的被动技能，甚至还有几率刷出对应职业的超强技能“EX 技能”。在设定上，只有装备了附带特定 EX 技能的武器，玩家才能在战斗时使用同名的 EX 技能。
除了武器的专属技能外，其他的特殊词条都是随机生成的。这就意味着能刷出什么技能，怎么组合装备，全都取决于玩家自己的运气。更让人纠结的是，有时明明技能词条非常完美，但却偏偏出现在一把基础面板数值极低的武器上。想要刷出一把词条和面板属性完美契合的“毕业神装”，绝对需要玩家投入大量的时间和精力。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/4c330c6e0753f232aa6c3f2974a8237c/
战遗物也有稀有度之分，高稀有度的装备会自带“上等”、“稀有”等前缀。如果鉴定出“稀有”级别的装备，还会出现特殊的动画演出
可能是因为笔者本身就比较喜欢刷宝类的游戏，所以整套系统真的是让我一上手就停不下来。虽然极品词条的掉落几率很低，但当这样的装备真的出现时，那种多巴胺疯狂分泌的感觉简直让人欲罢不能。立刻穿上刚刚刷出的神装前去暴揍魔物时的爽快感更是妙不可言。
不仅如此，由于 EX 技能大多都很强力，所以一些在本篇中相对冷门或不太起眼的技能也有了重新发光发热的机会，能够开发出全新的战术和策略。这也促使玩家不断想要前去尝试不同的武器与技能组合，在四处摸索的过程中，时间不知不觉就凭空蒸发了，而这恰恰也是本作最大的魅力之一。
顺带一提，鉴定需要前往诺根小村落与一位名叫吉耶拉的 NPC 对话才能进行。这个小村落里还有旅馆和大型异界石，估计会是大家刷宝旅程途中的重要据点。
本篇世界中追加的 12 个地下城
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/1026c8b9c4954b1c36ef12dc0c0529e3/
除了新区域外，该 DLC 还在《龙之信条 2》的本篇世界中加入了名为“被遗忘的试炼”的全新内容。
玩家可以在本篇世界中挑战 12 个机制各异的特殊地下城。据说在这些地下城的最深处，都遗留着历代觉醒者使用过的绝世稀有装备。
每一座地下城的核心机制都大相径庭，有的需要玩家抵挡住源源不断涌出的怪物群，想尽办法生存下来，有的则是需要解开各种机关谜题才能去到最深处。
部分地下城甚至还设置有特定的挑战门槛，建议大家在前去挑战前最好先在地图界面确认一下开放地下城的条件，提前搭配好装备和技能。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/d4c16171e648b3cc354bc8f89d2abb99/
来到地下城最深处后，除了强力的装备外，玩家还能获得一种名为“恩宠火种”的道具。拿着恩宠火种前往散布在诺根各地的“恩宠石塔”处即可获得增益。将恩宠火种献给石塔后，不仅能记得各职业的全新技能，还可以获得各式各样的属性强化增益。
也就是说，一边探索诺根，一边挑战被遗忘的试炼才是强化己方队伍最高效的方式。这两种玩法之间的巧妙联动很好地缓解了游玩时的单调感，让玩家能时刻保持新鲜感。
不负众望的最新 DLC
作为一部体量堪比续作的 DLC，无论是新地图还是新技能等元素的引入，都绝对称得上是在原作基础上的正统进化。冒险探索玩法与动作战斗系统的强化，搭配上新增的刷宝要素，让这部作品玩起来极为上头，代入感拉满。
要知道，初代《龙之信条》的 DLC“黑暗觉者”也是一步以巨型地牢“黑咒岛”舞台，把重心放在刷宝玩法上的 DLC。但这次同名 DLC 的舞台却变成了一块面积足以媲美本体中一个国家的广阔区域，极大地提升了探索和冒险感。笔者始终认为“能凭双脚丈量辽阔的大地，才是真正的开放世界”，而这无疑是本作对比初代 DLC 最明显的进化之处。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/b598e20f64f39c01d8711c087e1d035e/
而在刷宝要素方面，本作最令人印象深刻的地方莫过于极低的上手门槛。即便是清理路边的杂兵或在野外进行采集，也有几率获得战遗物，鉴定后同样能转化为强力装备。究竟是专注于打倒各种魔物，还是成为一个避开战斗专心挖宝的潜行采集大师，完全取决于玩家自己的喜好，每一位玩家都能在其中找到最适合自己的游玩方式。
话虽如此，在敌人的强度方面，可能还是会有玩家觉得缺乏挑战。为了满足那些早就把本体玩得滚瓜烂熟的老兵们，官方还贴心地推出了“困难模式”。该模式怪物强度远高于普通模式，追求刺激的高手玩家可以来尝试挑战一下。笔者曾试着开了一个新档来挑战困难模式，结果就连出门遇到的第一只哥布林应对起来都十分棘手，要是还像以前那样随意出手，分分钟就会被打倒在地。如果你想要体验一把心跳加速的刺激感，不妨来试一试。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/077b6c53586a50d3ab8ad51dc1638057/
早在当年游玩初代 DLC“黑暗觉者”时，我就已经领教过这套系统和刷宝玩法有多契合了。但即便如此，该 DLC 的乐趣依然远远超出了我的预期。尤其是当你开始执着地追求极品词条时，简直像是掉进了一个时间的无底洞。在此我也要奉劝各位觉醒者同僚们，玩的时候可千万别太过沉迷，无法自拔了。
原作者：ぽんきち 翻译：Bluestoon 编辑：熊猫命

items.title: 罗技原本是软件公司：鼠标只是副产物 却意外救活公司
items.summary: 全球最大的电脑外设厂商罗技最初其实最初是一家软件公司，鼠标只是开发图形化软件时顺手做的辅助工具，却因为一场订单取消意外成了主业，把公司从破产边缘拉了回来。1981年10月，两位斯坦福毕业生Daniel Borel(瑞士籍

content.v: 全球最大的电脑外设厂商罗技最初其实最初是一家软件公司，鼠标只是开发图形化软件时顺手做的辅助工具，却因为一场订单取消意外成了主业，把公司从破产边缘拉了回来。
1981年10月，两位斯坦福毕业生Daniel Borel(瑞士籍)、Pierluigi Zappacosta(意大利籍)和曾在Olivetti任职的工程师Giacomo Marini在瑞士伊韦尔东郊外一间农庄谷仓里创立了Logitech。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791973934_354641.jpg
公司名字来自法语的Logiciel(意为软件)加上Tech后缀，创始团队的愿景是打造一套革命性的图形化文字处理软件，压根没把硬件制造当核心业务。
开发图形化软件时，团队意识到传统键盘没法满足图形操作的需求， 于是他们和洛桑联邦理工学院教授Jean-Daniel Nicoud合作，做出了一款半球形、光机感应的鼠标原型，作为软件的操作辅助工具。
转折发生在1982年，Logitech原本给工作站厂商Apollo Computer开发专属软件，Apollo中途突然取消合同，只对鼠标表现出一点兴趣。
这一变故直接把创始团队推入财务危机，为了活下来，Logitech破釜沉舟，把原本只是副产物的鼠标转为主力业务，同年推出首款商用鼠标P4。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791973934_211475.jpg
P4采用光机技术，底部滚珠带动滚轴，但用光学编码盘计算位移脉冲，比纯机械接触式更精准更耐用，这款产品成了罗技进军硬件的第一步。
惠普率先采购罗技鼠标作为高端工程工作站配件，随后团队陆续打入工作站市场，并在1980年代中后期拿下IBM个人电脑的关键OEM订单。
创始人Daniel Borel深知只靠高端OEM无法真正普及，于是把制造重心全面移至中国台湾新竹科学园区，借此大幅压低生产成本，把鼠标从数百美元的专业配件变成几十美元就能买到的个人电脑标配。
1985年推出首款自有零售品牌鼠标C7，定价99美元，短时间内卖出数十万只，在消费市场站稳脚跟。
此后罗技在PC输入设备史上留下多项里程碑，最终一个瑞士山区谷仓里濒临破产的软件工作室，成为了全球电脑外设龙头。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg
