items.title: Xbox 宣布成立 Xbox 实验室，部分目的是改进可在网络浏览器中玩的旧一代游戏
items.summary: Xbox has announced Xbox Labs, a new initiative aimed at getting games to more people in more places — with a p

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/12/halospeedrunblogroll-1533336736758-1717694718988-1791846824130.jpg
Xbox has announced Xbox Labs, a new initiative aimed at getting games to more people in more places — with a particular emphasis on web browsers.

No doubt seeing the growing community of games getting improved versions ported into web browsers (like the 94fps browser version of Halo: Combat Evolved), Microsoft itself is keen to get in on the action in support of new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's goal of reaching 1 billion players per day .

Xbox has been tinkering with running Xbox and Xbox 360 games in browsers, and the Xbox Labs initiative is a formalization of those efforts that will see a small team of engineers playing with emerging technologies in order to find new ways for games new and old to be distributed and even created. And IGN understands that this won't just be an R&D effort; rather, Xbox Labs is tasked with shipping products – Sharma says, "We'll build in the open" – and getting gamers to engage with them.

I'd suggest thinking about it as a next phase of the backward compatibility efforts that started at Xbox over a decade ago, which the recent disc-to-digital program built on (which, side note, is a much more consumer-friendly path towards the seemingly inevitable digital future than what Sony is doing ), and now Xbox Labs aims to take it even further. It remains to be seen if or how Xbox will look to monetize its Xbox Labs offerings, be it via an upfront cost, in-game microtransactions, or in-game-ad-based revenue .
The Xbox Labs announcement continues a busy stretch for Xbox, which revealed its entertainment-industry-focused Xbox XP arm last week.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/xbox-labs-1791917713343.png
Here's Sharma's memo to the team (also posted to Xbox Wire ) in full:
Team,

The first video games emerged some 75 years ago. In the time since, there have been booms and busts, but every year there are more great games to play, more devices to play them, and best of all, more people than ever playing. That growth helped make XBOX what it is today, and we’ve helped shape the industry in return, from bringing hard drives to consoles and online gaming through Xbox Live to Game Pass and cloud gaming, alongside franchises that have brought millions of people together.

In recent weeks, we’ve seen games rapidly decompiled and rebuilt to run on hardware they were never originally designed to support. Windows PC builds have been translated to run on Apple Silicon or ported to run inside a browser through WebAssembly and WebGPU, the latter now approaching 90% global browser support. Perhaps more surprisingly, we’ve seen many of the biggest games in the world have been remixed into the source code of another.

These experiments challenge long-held assumptions about our industry: the tether between software and hardware, the boundary between creation and play, and how people discover and experience games. While it is hard to predict the future of gaming, it is easy to see the possibilities in making great games easier to access, giving old games new life and allowing more players to become creators and co-creators. These are unmistakably good outcomes for players, even when (and sometimes because) they challenge our existing business models. To explore these possibilities, I’ve asked Scott to stand-up XBOX LABS, a small group of game makers, engineers and scientists whose job is to turn emerging ideas into things our players and developers can experience. We’ll build in the open, learn from what people do, and measure success by whether more people are playing and creating.

I think XBOX has an important role to play here. Coding became the first major workload for agents because they can write, run, and test software. Games share many of those same properties, and people spend more than 72 billion hours a year playing XBOX games, roughly five times the estimated time spent writing code worldwide. We’ve spent 25 years learning how to make great games, and I want our game makers to help shape what these new technologies make possible. As we learn, we’ll share the tools we build with developers across the industry, just as we always have.

Our priorities aren’t changing. We remain committed to the 4Cs, to making great games, to our hardware and to being responsible stewards of IP and the communities built around it. LABS gives us a way to explore new technology without abandoning the work already underway.
Asha

items.title: 据报道 EA Sports 的大学橄榄球开发人员担心该系列可能会在 2030 年消失
items.summary: Developers working on EA Sports' College Football franchise reportedly fear that the series may not live to se

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/05/27/cf25-blogroll-1716836985997.jpg
Developers working on EA Sports' College Football franchise reportedly fear that the series may not live to see the end of the decade.

The report comes from Insider Gaming's Mike Straw , who spoke to senior-level sources working on or around the football series. He noted that, although the series is performing well, sales have gradually declined entry to entry since its highly-anticipated debut in 2024. While this isn't inherently a bad thing (or unexpected, given the extreme hype around the 2024 title), costs associated with the game have been rising.

Per the report, in 2024, EA paid each player featured in the game $600, amounting to roughly $7 million total. Those costs have tripled, with NIL (name, image, likeness) rights for college athletes now costing $1,500 per player. As a result, EA spent roughly $20 million on its players with its latest game. EA also pays boatloads of cash to license bowl games, universities, and more, meaning tens of millions of dollars goes into just having the right to use certain elements in the game as opposed to raw development costs.

This has led to EA trying to monetize key areas of the game, including College Football's single-player modes. This led to extreme backlash earlier this summer due to the fact players felt they were being pushed to pay to efficently play single-player content. EA eventually bent the knee and reversed course , but noted that it would retool these options and bring them back in future entries.

One source told Insider Gaming that microtransactions were planned to return in future College Football single-player titles, and feared that it would anger players, pushing them away from a game that is trying to grow. While there are College Football games planned for the next few years, sources reportedly fear that the franchise may be on its way out.

"We’re not FC. We’re not Madden. We don’t make the money they do, and everyone knows it," a source told Insider Gaming. "But it’s at the point where if we don’t find a way to keep players around and, in turn, make more, we won’t have anything. Forget in 10 years, I’m scared about if we have a game by the end of the decade. Games aren’t getting cheaper to make, and there’s the real concern with all of us that EA’s going to streamline and just have a few key franchises and dump everything else."

Insider Gaming noted that not all of its sources shared these fears and some believed there is a strong future with the franchise. EA Sports' College Football brand is a spiritual successor to EA Sports' highly popular NCAA football series that thrived in the 2000s and early 2010s before legal issues surrounding NIL rights effectively killed it. There was a 14-year gap between NCAA's final game and the debut of the new College Football series, which led to an extreme level of enthusiasm from fans.

It led to College Football 25 raking in big bucks and becoming the second best selling game of 2024 in the United States, though it hasn't sustained that momentum year-to-year. College Football 26 was the seventh best selling game in the United States in 2025, with College Football 27 currently placed in 10th this year. Of course, College Football also doesn't have as much global appeal as something like EA's FC series, which means its sales are primarily made up in the US.

items.title: 尽管该系列发生了巨大变化，2026 年光环节仍在继续，消息即将发布
items.summary: The big Halo Fest event planned for December is going ahead as planned, despite mass layoffs and other major c

content.v: The big Halo Fest event planned for December is going ahead as planned, despite mass layoffs and other major changes at developer Halo Studios.

Halo Studios director of competitive engagement, Tashi, confirmed this and said there will be news about Halo Fest this week. Additionally, Halo Studios will release materials "celebrating the community and 25 years of Halo," while fans can also look forward to "relevant game info" about in-market Halo games.

"There's a huge amount of Halo fans who are looking forward to the event to attend or watch from home, and we're looking forward to providing a platform for the community to celebrate 25 years of Halo and each other," Tashi said of Halo Fest.

Halo Fest takes place December 11-13 in Seattle--the event is totally sold out. "No matter why you love Halo, whether it’s the story and characters, the music, the art and universe, or just playing with friends--Halo Fest will have something for you," Microsoft said of the event.

The voices of Master Chief and Cortana, Steve Downes and Jen Taylor, will appear at Halo Fest, while there will also be a range of community events celebrating the series. Some had expected Halo Studios to announce the next big Halo game at Halo Fest, but it's not unreasonable to think that plans may have changed.

Halo Fest is happening against a major shift for the Halo franchise following the gutting of Halo Studios and the transition of the series from Halo Studios to Activision. Halo Studios now employs a significantly smaller team that will support already-released Halo games like Halo: The Master Chief Collection and Halo Infinite, but future games in the series-- including the rumored reboot --will be made at Activision.

Halo Studios was rumored to be working on Halo 2 and Halo 3 remakes, as well as a new live-service Halo game. That was before the big changes, however, and it's been reported that Activision is working on a Halo reboot.

items.title: Brandon Sanderson 的 Roshar 之战 Kickstarter 活动首日突破 100 万美元

content.v: Brandon Sanderson 和 Brotherwise Games 已正式启动新策略棋盘游戏 War of Roshar 的 Kickstarter 众筹活动。桑德森在本次竞选前一直称其为“重大事件”，球迷们似乎也同意这一点。第一天就已经认捐了超过 100 万美元，距离活动还剩 23 天。
《War for Roshar》将加入与 Brotherwise 合作的不断壮大的 Cosmere 棋盘游戏阵容。 IGN 在今年早些时候独家首次展示了这款游戏，并且非常喜欢我们所看到的内容。这是一款大型桌面战争游戏，在战略分析和抽象游戏玩法之间取得了平衡。游戏的主题深深植根于 Sanderson 的 Stormlight Archive 系列，包含来自 30 多位不同艺术家的丰富艺术作品。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/07/27/o6ebk3lg-1785167443134.png
如果您想支持该项目，有多种选择。这个名为“第五理想”的特色承诺将为您带来几乎一切。该级别售价 295 美元，包括基础游戏、冠军扩展、3D 组件、定制卡套和木制代币。您还将获得 Cosmere RPG 的一些不同微缩模型，包括来自 Era 1 和 Era 2 的 Mistborn 模型，以配合该游戏即将推出的扩展包。
如果您不关心 Cosmere RPG 的额外附加组件，其他四个级别将为您提供这些物品的一些变化。对于基础游戏，您可以承诺 90 美元，以便在零售版本发布后立即访问。
至于游戏实际发布的时间，该活动包括预计的交付日期为 2027 年 11 月。这可能会根据游戏的运送目的地而有所不同，但桑德森以按时为其所有众筹项目交付高质量产品而闻名。
这远不是桑德森取得巨大成功的第一个众筹项目。就在今年早些时候，他发起了一场大规模的 Hoid 故事书收藏活动，最终筹集了超过 1100 万美元。这些书到达后，IGN 的乔丹·康斯托克 (Jordan Comstock) 亲自试用了这些书，并且毫不后悔自己选择支持该项目。
在该项目之前，Brotherwise game 最初于 2024 年通过 kickstarter 为 Cosmere RPG 提供了高达 1500 万美元的资助。因此，虽然“罗沙尔之战”有了一个良好的开端，但我们必须拭目以待，看看它是否有可能成为桑德森在他的 Cosmere 宇宙中有史以来最成功的众筹活动。

items.title: 据传《侠盗猎车手 6》将比任何人预期更快地在 PC 上推出，但我不会抱太大希望
items.summary: If the rumored release window is accurate, it means the new GTA will hit PC just a few months after consoles—s

content.v: A GamesBeat report claims that Grand Theft Auto 6—which still hasn't been announced for PC—will launch for PC sometime within the first three months of 2027. If correct, that means the game will drop, at most, just four months after its initial release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles.
GamesBeat cites "four industry sources familiar with the studio's plans" in its report, all of whom requested anonymity. Rockstar has not yet commented on the claim.
It's a surprising claim. Earlier this year, we predicted that GTA 6 won't likely appear on PC before November 2027 , mainly because that's just how Rockstar rolls. We always have to wait.
The Unfortunate Timeline

Compared to that, a four month break between the console and PC releases, and possibly less, seems downright snappy, especially given how the gaps between GTA games themselves have grown over the decades.
Courtesy of Wikipedia :
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PFaPD7hNPufCBKXjrg9cmL-1920-80.png

Not only would a Q1 release of GTA 6 on PC be an unusually brief break, it also puts the game in the midst of the post-holiday hangover, when we're all doing our best to nurse our bruised and battered bank balances back to health.

And that, I think, would feel especially egregious in the immediate aftermath of this year's holiday season, which for gamers will be driven by the release of GTA 6 on consoles. Rockstar loves the double dip , but punching the button again so soon after the console release would surely be viewed dimly by a not-insignificant number of people who would prefer the flexibility and power of the PC, but really don't want to wait for it.

Of course, if Rockstar or Take-Two confirms the GTA 6 PC release date really is that close—Take-Two's next quarterly financial report takes place on November 9, which might be a time for such a thing—some no doubt would wait for it, cannibalizing launch sales to some extent.

There's no shortage of people on social media saying they will indeed wait to buy GTA 6 if the PC version is indeed coming that quickly. That feeling may be even more widespread than it appears, given how much GTA 6 costs: At $100 for the premium edition and all the exclusive content it contains, you can understand why people might be more reticent about buying it multiple times than they were for earlier games in the series.
How about you?

Anything's possible, of course, and I would never presume to have a better understanding of these things than Strauss Zelnick and the rest of the GTA brain trust. But I also wouldn't bet on it—and for now I'm definitely taking all of this with a grain of salt. I've also reached out to Rockstar to ask about it, and will update if anyone answers.

items.title: 《Red Dead》令人震惊的转折结局激怒了很多人，但 Rockstar 联合创始人表示这是正确的决定
items.summary: Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser has recalled the controversial ending to 2010's Red Dead Redemption in which th

content.v: Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser has recalled the controversial ending to 2010's Red Dead Redemption in which the main character, John Marston, is killed.

He said in an interview that the game's lead designer, Christian Cantamessa was on board with the idea to kill off Marston, but Houser wondered about the production realities of, "How does an open-world game work if you've killed the protagonist?"

"So I said, ‘I think maybe we have to kill him.’ And he goes, ‘That's a great idea. Got to do it.’ I said, ‘I don't know if… let me just think about this,’ because we're just dealing with audio and dialogue," Houser told IGN "The nature of an open-world game is you finish a story, then you go back into the world and wrap up all the side content if you want to. We'd have to play as someone else for that. We could play as Jack, but what does that mean? So I had to think through for a while what it would mean production-wise.”
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/RDR_5701c0.jpg?w=636

How Rockstar handled it was by setting RDR's epilogue years later, in the year 1914, with players taking control of Marston's son, Jack. He said this setup presented challenges, too, in terms of the technical realities of playing as Jack as opposed to John. There were story and mission concerns, too, including how multi-stage missions might play out if players, as John, completed one part and then came back to finish later as Jack.
"How would that work? We had to think through all of that stuff and concluded we could probably make it work, but we were still scared," he said.

The RDR epilogue has Jack hunting down and killing the men who killed his father, and Houser said players "really loved" that feeling of vengeance. Ultimately, Houser observed that there was "broad consensus" that it was the right call in the end to kill off John, even if it was an "unusual and out-there decision." Houser was, however, surprised by "how angry some people were about that decision."

"There were people who were livid with you. And part of you goes, ‘That's fantastic,’ because it means you've really engaged in the story and the characters," he said. "Now, I think it was the right decision because you want those big, strong reactions, but I think people were really confused by it. As a writer, it was like he had to die for the story to have any weight."
Also in the interview, Houser said he wanted to achieve something like this in the GTA franchise, but it never happened due to technical reasons.

He and the Rockstar team did, however, pull it off again with Red Dead Redemption II, which is a prequel to the earlier game. RDR2 famously killed off its own main playable character, Arthur Morgan, though he died from tuberculosis or at the hand of Micah. RDR 2 had an epilogue as well, featuring John and Jack Marston.

Houser left Rockstar in 2020 and now works at Absurd Ventures, which is crafting an open-world comedy game. His brother, Sam Houser, remains at Rockstar and helped lead the team bringing GTA 6 to market on November 19.

items.title: Nvidia 将 DLSS 5 引入霍格沃茨遗产，但一些粉丝无法辨别差异
items.summary: About a month after it debuted in NBA 2K27, DLSS 5 is now being added to Hogwarts Legacy, with a new, faster m

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/06/12/hogwarts-switch-oo-1749763392003.jpg
About a month after it debuted in NBA 2K27, DLSS 5 is now being added to Hogwarts Legacy , with a newer, faster model.

In a blog post, Nvidia announced that it is launching a new model for DLSS 5 that's — according to Team Green — twice as fast as the model that debuted in NBA 2K27 last month . While the basketball game will be getting an update that adds this new model, and thus improves performance, Nvidia is also bringing the neural rendering tech to Hogwarts Legacy and Where Winds Meet in November.

Nvidia has been hard at work getting DLSS 5 to run well enough that people will actually turn it on when they're playing games. It's not hard to see why that's a major focus; when I first tested the tech back in September , I found that it could absolutely cripple my frame rate at 4K on the RTX 5090. It wasn't long ago, either, that Nvidia debuted the technology at GTC 2026 in March , where it needed to run on two RTX 5090s to deliver a playable experience, and even then it was super limited.

Now, though, Nvidia claims the new model is twice as fast as September's model, and ten times faster than it was when DLSS 5 was first revealed. If that's true — and I won't know that until I actually test it — it makes sense that developers are now willing to add the feature to their games.

But unlike some of the deep-fried examples I've seen of DLSS getting modded into games, the Hogwarts Legacy examples Nvidia shared in its blog are a lot more subtle. Rather than completely changing the way characters look, like it did when DLSS 5 was first revealed, it mostly just looks like it balances lighting and subsurface scattering.

And I'm not alone there. Over on X/Twitter, NikTek posted a GIF of him scrubbing through an image comparison with DLSS 5 turned on and off, and noted how small of a difference it makes. He then wonders who would actually use it with such a minor visual change and a big performance hit. However, there were some folks who applauded the subtle changes, with jayv7s replying, "This is the correct way to use it, no exaggerated AI slop filters on top, just normal pure improvement."

However, the subtlety of DLSS 5 will ultimately depend on the developer. There are plenty of dials that devs can adjust to make the game look as natural as possible, or leaning in the opposite direction to make games look like some kind of nightmare ripped straight from Midjourney. However, it is at least a little bit reassuring that in NBA 2K27 and now in Hogwarts Legacy, the developers are at least trying to maintain the same aesthetic.

No matter how subtle it is, though, DLSS 5 does work by using AI to re-draw games , even though it is anchored by the geometry and color data provided by the game. That's definitely enough to turn some people off of this tech, but if the changes are subtle enough and the performance continues to improve at this pace, I can see it eventually getting added to more than one or two games.

Update Day General FAQ:
Q: ‘My game mods broke on PC with this update, why did that happen?’

> A: When Ready or Not or games in general release updates to the game, the files for the game in areas related to new game content or fixes then changes. If mods were using the old files to function that have since changed to new files, those mods will likely need to update in order to work properly with the new version of the game’s files.
Ready or Not Modding Update Tips: https://voidinteractive.net/community-resources/
Q: ‘Why does an update download initially seem frustratingly large in data/gigabytes, even when the game doesn’t actually take up that much more storage when the download finishes’

> A: Game service platforms such as Steam etc. may update games by overwriting the game's files with the new files to replace it. For example, this means a update download that initially shows as 6GB during the download may actually only expand the game by 1GB in size, since it is largely just overwriting old game files for the other 5GB of data.
Q: ‘Why does an update take so long to download despite my fast internet’

> A: Other routine checks that a game service platform does to confirm game file integrity on the local storage device (e.g. your hard drive such as a HDD or SSD) during an update download can extend the perceived download size/time.
Q: ‘Why didn’t my game update yet on my console platform?'
> A: Console platforms do not necessarily support auto-updates, so you may have to trigger the update manually within your game library with an internet connection.

General Lothaire, The Eagle-Bearer, is the first boss in Valor Mortis and is one of those classic starting soulslike fights you're really not supposed to win.

The odds are very much against you, especially as you only have one attempt. Dying will start a cutscene where Lucjan appears to save you and provides a bit of an info dump about the world, but the boss will disappear.

While spending way too long beating Lothaire to find out what happens, I realised you can actually ALT + F4 the moment you die, and it generally puts you outside the boss arena when you load back in, letting you attempt the fight again. If you beat General Lothaire, you'll get:
It's a pretty big bonus in terms of initial levelling. Valor Mortis also doesn't have boss weapons, so you can spend that clot without missing out.

You'll also get the Torn-Banner achievement. Since I beat him, I can't confirm whether Lothaire turns up later, so this might very well be the only way you can get this. Still, is it worth repeatedly ALT + F4ing to fight him until you win?
Use fire to ignite him for DoT damage whenever your Nephtoglobin is full

items.title: 我现在可以在 GTA 5 中从天上召唤大型喷气式飞机和船只，如果我愿意的话，我会在拥挤的十字路口中间这样做
items.summary: And I do want to.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .
What's the greatest moment in a videogame? Finding the truth of what happened at Red Mountain in Morrowind? Catching every pokémon in Pokémon? Something inscrutable in Final Fantasy 14?
All excellent answers. All wrong. The greatest moment in videogames is repeatedly dropping shipping crates on Quiet's head in Metal Gear Solid 5 until she decides to become your comrade for life.

Naturally, I had to bring this experience to Grand Theft Auto 5, and I did it using Just Cause 3 Rebel Drops [.NET] , which allows you to summon Tardis-like containers filled with goodies at any location in Los Santos. Tap the L key, choose from your list of summonables. Bish bash bosh, done.

Of course, what you can summon is guns (I have them all) and vehicles (they speed off over the horizon as soon as they appear), so mostly what I have been using the technology for is to attempt to drop crates on my bodyguard. It's tougher than it might sound: the crates land haphazardly, without much rhyme or reason, and my bodyguard is a wily fella—quick on his feet.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/r3xsAuzGLddTLug3tXUJKn-1920-80.gif

Still, it is great fun to spawn a jumbo jet in the middle of an intersection and watch the world have to try to encompass this new and undesired aspect of its reality. Even the jet isn't into it; as soon as it appears, its wheels fly off like a buck shedding its antlers. It's as if the game knows reality has departed from an acceptable baseline and it's trying, as best it can, to return to it. It fails, but you have to respect the attempt.
Meanwhile, in the background, the furry gang continues to wage war on the vikings.

items.summary: Looking for your next gaming obsession? From relaxing adventures to terrifying horrors, here are 9 newly annou

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/09/ign-next-ff26-blogroll-1791578973123.jpg

IGN Fan Fest: Fall Edition is rolling out all week with a ton of first-looks, exclusive reveals, and deep dives into some of the biggest games for PC, consoles, and mobile. As part of the event, we want to take an in-depth look at what’s next: some games that you haven’t heard of yet but are sure to shoot to the top of your Steam Wishlist.
From co-op survival adventures, brand-new horror games, relaxing survival games, mysteries and even a chess-based shooter, here’s a look at 9 newly announced games that we think are worth a look.
Akiiwan: Relaxing Survival

Fall into a chill survival adventure with a talking campfire as your guide. Explore, craft, fish and hunt during the day, and ask your fire three questions each night. Choose wisely: Winter isn't the only surprise in this beautiful, hand-drawn world. Playable in cozy or realistic mode.
Akiiwan: Relaxing Survival Steam Page
Aquamorta

Something is wrong with the swamp. Aquamorta is a first-person horror adventure set in a forgotten swamp town, where something ancient has twisted a community into hysteria. Explore abandoned buildings and corrupted waterways surrounding the town. Use an old map and compass to find your way, fish for the blood that keeps your airboat running, and learn what lurks beneath the surface. As you venture deeper into the swamp, you’ll uncover the story of what happened here and what is still missing.
Aquamorta Steam Page
Checkmate Protocol

Checkmate Protocol is a chess-themed third-person shooter with unique weapons, chess-themed movement abilities, and unhinged boss battles. Fight alone, or team up with an arsenal of rifles, handguns, and chainsaws to defeat waves of oncoming attackers. Coming soon to Steam.
Checkmate Protocol Steam Page
Crown Must Hold
In most tower defense games you combine towers. In Crown Must Hold you combine empires.

Every empire is a system of its own, with its own buildings and its own rules for how they work together. You take yours into a procedurally generated frontier, equip them with items that pull the run in a direction, and amplify the whole build with the biomes you claim as you expand. Push out for the resources you need and the undead get a longer front to hit you along.
A five-region campaign unlocks a new empire, biome and castle with every region cleared, then opens into Endless Mode.
Crown Must Hold Steam Page
Paper Perjury 2: Shadow of Justice

Return to Azure City and join Justina in solving one of the biggest mysteries yet in Paper Perjury 2: Shadow of Justice. This upcoming detective visual novel is a follow-up to Paper Perjury by Paper Cat Games. Paper Perjury 2: Shadow of Justice is coming soon to PC.
Paper Perjury 2: Shadow of Justice Steam Page
Rotten Crown

Rotten Crown is a twisted real-time settlement manager where no problem ever fully dies. Grow your tiny kingdom, turn opposition into workers, balance the needs of humans and zombies, and make decisions no respectable ruler would ever admit to.
Rotten Crown Steam Page
Silk & Sorrow

Silk & Sorrow is a hand-drawn dark fantasy co-op adventure built exclusively for two players. The game tells the story of two orphans, Silk and Sorrow, who stumble into the Chrysalis, a hidden world where everything humanity has discarded ends up. Together, they must explore a haunting landscape built from the forgotten remnants of the world above, survive its twisted horrors and corrupted inhabitants, and bring light back to the Chrysalis. Silk & Sorrow can be played in both couch co-op and online co-op, with players needing to communicate, solve problems, and trust one another to survive a world where every step brings new dangers and unsettling discoveries.
Silk & Sorrow is coming to PC via Steam, with Chapter 1 releasing as a demo in Winter 2027.
Silk & Sorrow Steam Page
Splizards

Float through the cosmos on a meteor as a Splizard in this cooperative survival adventure. Gather drifting resources, craft tools and expand your meteor into a traveling base. Swarms of bloodthirsty space mosquitoes lurk in the darkness, and powerful monsters guard the secrets of survival.
Splizards Steam Page
The Forge: Steel Frontier

Step into the cockpit as mercenary pilot Ivan and fight alongside mech-with-a-soul Machine Spirit in The Forge: Steel Frontier, a mech action game coming soon. Dormant Dragon holds a strange and rare mineral and when wolves come for the ore, you and your mech must choose, and the planet's fate hangs in the balance.
The Forge: Steel Frontier Steam Page

For more IGN Fan Fest , be sure to check out IGN’s website, YouTube, and social channels throughout the week for more than 90 exclusive reveals across games, movies, TV, comics, and collectibles. It all leads to a massive livestream October 14 packed with game announcements, trailers, exclusive clips, celebrity interviews, and more.

items.title: 《魔兽世界》永久测试版已制作了超过 100 万个角色
items.summary: It's no secret that World of Warcraft Forever has been incredibly popular since entering its beta last month,

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/15/wowoo-1789495563832.png
It's no secret that World of Warcraft Forever has been incredibly popular since entering its beta last month, but now, over 1 million characters have been made.

According to classicplus.io, a community website that snapshots data from WoW Forever, 1,003,125 characters have been made in the Classic Plus mode so far. That's a lot, considering that to even make a character you need to have access to the beta, which is primarily done by buying the $60 Skyborne pack.

But even though most people will have to buy access to the Skyborne race to play in the beta, the Skyborne aren't the most popular race on either faction. For both Alliance and Horde players, the fancy blue elves only represent 18.7% of characters created. Instead, for Alliance players, Humans are much more popular at 32.3%, whereas Horde players seem to prefer Undead characters, at 33.5% of the population.

It's important to remember that while 1 million characters might not seem like a lot in a game that had a peak of 12 million players 16 years ago, WoW Forever hasn't even launched yet. The full game doesn't come out until November 4, and anyone playing the beta now only has access to limited parts of the world. At the time of writing, the level cap in the beta is level 30, and characters will be wiped when the full game launches next month.

So, it's impressive that so many people are playing the game right now, knowing that everything they earn in the game is going to vanish in less than a month. It's a good sign for Blizzard, and suggests that when Forever launches, it's going to be incredibly popular, even if it has to go head-to-head with Grand Theft Auto 6, which launches two weeks later — though I imagine there isn't much crossover between the two games.

Even when WoW Forever first entered its beta last month, Blizzard developers were shocked at how popular it was. One developer even said the beta was putting up "the craziest numbers" they'd ever seen. However, Forever hasn't been free of its own controversies. Blizzard has cracked down on players' names, leading some to think they've been unfairly targeted . And, Blizzard is also cracking down on gold selling, leading to WoW streamers getting caught in the crossfire . But, Blizzard has also added the beloved "Kyle's Gone Missing" quest, even though it wasn't added until Burning Crusade, and everybody seems to love that.

items.title: I was excited by Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons until the protagonist pulled out a sword
items.summary: Can't we just stick to the magic?

content.v: Considering only eight minutes of it were shown at Gamescom's Opening Night Live, I went on a real journey with Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons . At first, I was nonplussed by it. While the production values were impressive, it also looked like every Sony game released in the last ten years, right down to the specific angle of the camera and the quippy NPC companion.

Yet as the reveal unfurled, I found myself growing intrigued by Warlock's invocation-based puzzle-solving and combat. Levitating objects to create platforms, using teleportation spells to swap places with enemies, conjuring a whole-ass storm to make electrical attacks more viable. It's rare to see a game of this scope encourage guile and cleverness from the player, to set its mechanical ambitions slightly beyond timed dodges and grisly executions.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/fEukxGUcaqDrz58wPhyjGY-1920-80.jpg
And then, just as I thought I was sold on Warlock, the main character pulled out a sword.

Well, to be specific, Warlock's magical protagonist Kaatri conjured a sword. After all, why bother lugging around several pounds of sharpened steel when you can just make one appear out of thin air any time you like? It's silly to carry around a sword that you don't need. Which is precisely why I was dismayed to see one appear in Warlock at all .

Now, to be clear, I like swords—to the point where I spent several years training to use one. I also like games about swords, and appreciate how difficult it is to create interesting and authentic swordplay in a videogame context. Despite being simpler weapons, swords are way harder to depict in videogames for a whole bunch of reasons, from the technical demands of animating convincing swordplay to the many nuances associated with different kinds of swordfighting.

But there was something about seeing hack 'n' slash combat crop up in Warlock that really punctured my enthusiasm for it. Admittedly, it probably didn't help that Opening Night Live had already delivered a torrent of Dark Souls knockoffs and identikit Chinese action adventures up to that point. You'd be forgiven for thinking that swords were the only thing holding the games industry up.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tdxWJqeogCtEERANUr8p5Y-1920-80.jpg

But the more I thought about it, the more I realised it wasn't swords per-se that I had a problem with. Instead, what bothered me was the fact that we don't really see games that are about being a Warlock. Or a wizard, or a mage, or a sorcerer, or whichever brand of berobed spell-slinger floats your boat.
It's far rarer to see games that are purpose-built around wielding the arcane arts.

Now don't worry, I've not been struck in the head by a magic missile. I'm aware that there are loads of games that feature mages (which is the umbrella term I'm going to use henceforth). They appear in virtually every fantasy roleplaying game ever made. But mages nearly always appear as an option , one of innumerable roles that players can assume. It's far rarer to see games that are purpose-built around wielding the arcane arts.

I don't know why this is. Perhaps it's a lingering perception that mages are weedy and wet, which goes against what was until recently a very masculine gaming culture. Or perhaps mages simply represent a sterner game design challenge. Certainly, what few mage games exist tend to be first-person shooters that replace the guns with spells. Examples include Lichdom: Battlemage , the potential of which was squandered by aching repetition. More recently, we saw Immortals of Aveum , which offers some decent action if you can get past its infuriating writing, but remains a reductive interpretation of wielding arcane power.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DYvr8GydkLk38mTWww7hJY-1920-80.jpg

There is one exception, however, and that's Magicka , Arrowhead's debut title about cooking up chaos as a bunch of mages. Magicka is probably the best demonstration of what you can do when you ditch all the other bits of fantasy RPGs and focus squarely on the spellcasting. Its spell-customisation mechanic is a great encapsulation of being a wizard, in how it encourages ingenuity from the player which often results in reckless, destructive experimentation. Magicka understands that being an all-powerful wizard is accidentally burning down half a city because you slightly mispronounced a spell.

15 years since Magicka was released, there isn't really another game like it (apart from its sequel). And I think that tells us something quite important. If you drill down on a specific kind of experience, and ask "What would it be like to be X?" you'll probably end up building something more interesting than if you try to make your game cater to absolutely everyone—which is the approach adopted by most big-budget titles.

And that's why I felt bummed out when that sword appeared in Kaatri's hand. It made the game seem less distinctive, and more like every third-person action adventure that I've played in the last 10-15 years. I should point out here that I'm coming at this as a fan of videogames rather than a fan of Dungeons & Dragons, which I like well enough but do not possess any deep knowledge of. Maybe Warlocks use swords all the time in D&D [ They do indeed like flailing around with swords - ed. ], in which case I understand developer Invoke Studios featuring them. But thinking about Warlocks as a general concept, "whacking stuff with melee weapons" is not what I immediately associate them with, and not the reason I would choose to play as one.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/9Au4moZ6jjr8zLBPWZFqHF-1920-80.jpg

In fairness to Invoke, the showcase does prioritise invocations, and I am still keen to play with all the magical abilities it offers. But every time that blade appeared on screen and Kaatri began hacking away, I got the sense that it's a crutch for a developer concerned not enough people will buy into just being a magic wielder, that's anxious about catering to unimaginative players who simply want to wallop enemies with a big metal stick.

Maybe I'll be proved utterly wrong on this, and Warlock's swordplay will turn out to be the best bit of the game. Either way, watching Warlock's reveal has made me realise how much I want a game that goes all-in on being a physically feeble but magically almighty wizard. Maybe for its next game, Arrowhead will give Magicka the Helldivers 2 treatment, in which case I will be there on day one.

items.title: 《全面战争》出了那么多，15年前的这部为什么让玩家格外惦记
items.summary: 用一部作品讲完日本武士阶层兴衰史。 今年9月CA突然宣布，将在10月13日推出《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版。完全版将收录全部的本体与DLC内容，同时将在原版基础上带来一系列现代化改进，包括升级后的视觉表现、完整的中文语

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/9bab9ceb9f6aecf2d9ecf3bfef599920.appmsg_mw680water
用一部作品讲完日本武士阶层兴衰史。
今年9月CA突然宣布，将在10月13日推出《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版。完全版将收录全部的本体与DLC内容，同时将在原版基础上带来一系列现代化改进，包括升级后的视觉表现、完整的中文语音与文本支持、超过50个全新可玩的小派系等。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/f7506a2a4d8e17982821700ce618e1e8.appmsg_mw680water
虽然没有等来新作，但是对历史系全战的粉丝来说，这也算是过了个大年。
目前CA的《全面战争》可以分为两大派别，分别是以《全面战争：战锤》为首的奇幻系全战，还有以《幕府将军2》为代表的历史系全战。
其中的《幕府将军2》不仅是历史系全战中的佼佼者，在历史策略游戏的赛道上也可以说是举足轻重。它是由海外工作室制作过的、最成功的日本战国题材游戏，当时在M站评分高达90，零媒体差评，在Steam也有90%好评率，迄今为止还有数千人保持在线。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/dc46eeb9677e2f13cfab2701437b12f9.appmsg_mw680water
尽管它已经是一款15年前的游戏了，但它有很多放到今天仍不显得落伍的亮点，乃至后来每一部全战新作发售时，玩家们总是会忍不住拿新作跟《幕府将军2》比一比。
《幕府将军2》做得最出色的地方，在于它实现了核心玩法与历史题材的珠联璧合。
很简单的道理，乱世比治世更适合做历史策略游戏；何况《全面战争》策略玩法的实质，就是版图和部队的滚雪球式做大。而16世纪的日本战国，属于真正的字面意义上的“封建割据”，几十家互相看不顺眼的大名争夺领土的混乱局面，贡献了足够破碎的版图，刚好能把这套滚雪球玩法诠释到极致。
其实《全面战争》系列的首部作品就是《幕府将军1》。后来的《幕府将军2》，以及今日的完全版，都可以说是在回归系列的本源。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/7a61de11288c805a733639af22365333.appmsg_mw680water
本文所有截图均来自完全版的媒体测试版
日本战国也是东西方文化产生交流和碰撞的重要时期。欧洲人不仅带来了基督教，还有改变了战争形态的火枪。穿着破烂，但装备了致命长枪与火枪的足轻（低级步兵），开始与身披华丽甲胄的武士势均力敌，冷兵器与热兵器的结合，为这个时代的战争创造了莫大的变数。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/03078d077b6329a476a7960d6b4a43f6.appmsg_mw680water
游戏中的长筱之战，历史上是由织田信长结合火枪齐射与防马栅重创武田骑兵队
《幕府将军2》并非一部全盘还原历史的作品，但它尽可能重现了那种混乱的战场氛围。
在原版的开场动画中，武田家的武士和上杉家的僧兵单挑对决的场面，给很多玩家留下了深刻的印象。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/c38e06d93f3b22d5aa983f5abf6f9ae1.gif_mw680
现在看来，这个场面也是对游戏核心卖点的宣传：推出精致的单兵模型，并且在前作基础上重做战斗动画的微观细节，把小兵的近战动作、弓箭和火枪命中的反馈，都做出了打击感，也为后续全战作品的战斗动画立下了标杆。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/5d4eb129961426c74587402f1feac13d.appmsg_mw680water
将领根据敌我态势发表战前演讲
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/605aa5e9d7131dbd314e3cd74d4d1bcf.gif_mw680
激烈的肉搏战
在战斗玩法层面，《幕府将军2》也足够有趣，易上手而难精通。
《幕府将军2》的基础兵种克制关系并不复杂：枪克骑，骑克刀，刀克枪，远程单位靠远程攻击克制一切，但又会被近战或恶劣天气克制。或许会有超雄长枪足轻“枪衾”反一切之类的平衡性问题，但整体而言，每个阵营的特色兵种都找得到属于自己的用武之地。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/77e3f55c368e935cf9430c2f58a02643.appmsg_mw680water
兵种百科
同时这一作将士气系统提到了前所未有的重要地位：部队士气总是先于兵力数量崩溃；一支部队士气低下被击溃时，还会带动其余部队溃逃。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/a81afe92b44a3188390db52a32082d10.appmsg_mw680water
“我军败了”
这样的设计显著加快了战斗节奏，也强化了兵种克制、将领坐镇、绕侧/绕背、集火敌方将领等微操策略的实用性，从而让玩家方以少胜多的“史诗大捷”正反馈来得更频繁。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/473988010190f3c02bd74fb6bb2db36f.appmsg_mw680water
除了精彩的即时战斗，《幕府将军2》的回合制战役系统相较前作也迎来了进化：大名家谱、将领养成、事务官、科技树、外交贸易、民忠与税收……当年的CA将这些系统巧妙串联在了一起，同时又平衡了各项机制的难度与深度，实现了“简化而不简单”。
再结合地图区划、大名属性等差异化特色，《幕府将军2》也能衍生出多样化的运营流派，外交贸易算正常打法，速攻京都则是高手向选择，喜欢热兵器火力压制的玩家，可以通过尽早改信基督教轻松获取洋枪大炮，只是要面对更多来自民间和其他大名的敌意。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14504/acaf76641a1b38dcbe873d936bd74371.appmsg_mw680water
用好和尚、忍者、目付等事务官，推图会事半功倍
后期随着玩家做大，会触发全图所有阵营都和玩家敌对的包围网机制。这很烦人，特别是在后方城镇被偷渡的敌方小股部队轻取、前线养了好多年才养到6级的目付（治安官兼忍者杀手）被敌方初出茅庐的1级量产忍者捅死，到处都令人疲于应付的时候。
但不得不说，这也缓解了策略游戏占据太多地盘而破局后进入垃圾时间、失去乐趣的问题，时刻紧绷的战役节奏，将翻盘破局那一刻的爽感进一步放大。
放弃幻想，准备暴打全日本
假如日本战国玩腻了，还可以随时换换口味。
《幕府将军2》推出了两部独立资料片，分别是以12世纪源平合战为背景的《武家崛起》，以及以19世纪幕末战争为背景的《武家之殇》，加上本体的战国时代，正好讲完了日本武士阶层的兴衰史。
其中《武家之殇》是全战历史上最成功的独立DLC，这也是因为题材特殊性。市面上很少有做幕末战争题材的策略游戏，更没有能像《武家之殇》那样，允许玩家还原电影《最后的武士》中用先进的加特林机枪扫射落后的持刀武士的场景。
我知道这并不历史，但做进游戏里可太好玩了——当然得是我操控加特林。
这谁不怕
即时战斗的独特玩法，与基于日本三大重要历史事件的回合制战役相结合，共同组成了内容丰富、玩法有趣的《幕府将军2》。哪怕是新系统兼容性差、不支持高分辨率、画质逐渐落后于时代等因年久失修所暴露的问题，都不能阻止粉丝们把原版游戏坚持玩到2026年。
而致力于解决这些问题的《幕府将军2》完全版的推出，可谓重温这部经典全战的良机。
完全版着重升级了游戏的视觉表现，打造了适配2026年分辨率的清晰战斗画面，包括地形、建筑、植被、水体、单位的建模细节都有调整，光照和阴影亦完全重做。
雨天的地面很有质感
“一将功成万骨枯”
完全版还制作了以江户时代浮世绘风格重制的2.5D过场动画，但同时也保留了旧版的3D动画。相比旧版人物动作的夸张演绎，我个人觉得新版动画有一种《南方公园》般的、平静的生草感，可以说新版跟旧版“各有各的美”。
忍者行动失败时的动画往往很搞笑
在游戏玩法上有两点改动值得一提。其一是开局选项中允许玩家自定义包围网（角逐天下）机制出现的时机，甚至完全关掉这项机制。其二是游戏内的次要阵营也变得可选，本体和DLC加起来可选的次要阵营数量达到了50多个，扩充了玩家的开局选择。
“次要氏族”拥有弱一点的专属Buff
完全版也做出了现代化的UI/UX界面，增加了全战后续作品才有的俯瞰视角，以及Alt键一键拖拽部队的功能，调兵布阵方便多了。
俯瞰视角
CA还终于修复了一些影响游戏平衡的Bug，比如某些主要阵营没有吃到自己的专属效果，某些兵种没有享受到对应的加成等。
另外原版游戏是没有官方汉化的，甚至没有日语配音，只有英配。而完全版不仅做了迟到15年的中文本地化，也将汉语和日语配音加进了游戏。我个人倾向于选择代入感更强的日配，但中配个人听下来也没有什么违和的地方，总归是比原版战斗中的那句“My lord, a glorious victory will soon be yours! ”（大人，您即将收获一场辉煌的胜利！）要强太多。
升级完全版唯一要付出的代价，就是原版模组失效。《幕府将军2》原版的创意工坊也很繁荣，因为有不少核心玩家，并不满足于《幕府将军2》的某些历史考据问题（比如一国一城、枪足轻能掏出武士刀等），或者想要追求更深入、更具策略性的游戏体验，会求助于各种模组，比如增加城池、修正兵模、调整单位和阵营平衡性等。
